local function owns(rec):boolean
 local p,s=rec.owner,rec.session
 return active[p]==rec and M.slot(s,p,ROLE,"B")==HIDE and p.Parent==Players
  and s.world==rec.world and rec.world.Parent~=nil and rec.arena.Parent==rec.world and s.swarm==rec.swarm
  and s.rules.phase=="ACTIVE" and s.rules.winner==nil and s.rules.castles[tostring(p.UserId)]==rec.castle
  and rec.castle.alive==true and currentHumanMember(s,p) and p.Character==rec.avatar and rec.root.Parent==rec.avatar
  and rec.avatar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")==rec.root and rec.hum.Parent==rec.avatar and rec.hum.Health>0
  and p:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_Role")==ROLE and p:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_Eliminated")~=true
  and rec.avatar:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_Downed")~=true and GroundMovement.inside(rec.arena,rec.root.Position)
end

local function carrying(rec):boolean
 return (rec.castle.heldEggs or 0)>0 or rec.owner:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_CarryingEgg")==true
end

local function oldStealth(p:Player):boolean
 local untilAt=p:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_StealthUntil")
 return type(untilAt)=="number" and os.clock()<untilAt
end

local function stagePart(rec,item:Instance)
 if not (item:IsA("BasePart") or item:IsA("Decal") or item:IsA("Texture")) then return end
 if rec.parts[item]~=nil then return end
 local old=item.Transparency
 if old<1 then rec.parts[item]=old;item.Transparency=1 end
end

local function show(rec)
 if rec.appearance then rec.appearance:Disconnect();rec.appearance=nil end
 for item,before in pairs(rec.parts) do
  if item.Parent and item.Transparency==1 then item.Transparency=before end
 end
 table.clear(rec.parts)
 if rec.displayBefore~=nil and rec.hum.Parent and rec.hum.DisplayDistanceType==Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None then
  rec.hum.DisplayDistanceType=rec.displayBefore
 end
 rec.displayBefore=nil
 if rec.hiddenUntil and rec.owner:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_StealthUntil")==rec.hiddenUntil then
  rec.owner:SetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_StealthUntil",nil)
 end
 rec.hiddenUntil=nil
end

local function clear(rec)
 if active[rec.owner]~=rec then return end
 active[rec.owner]=nil
 for _,connection in ipairs(rec.connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
 for _,marker in ipairs(rec.markers) do marker:Destroy() end
 show(rec)
 if rec.sequence then rec.sequence.abort("ECLIPSE_RETIRED") end
end

 if rec then clear(rec) end
end

  receiptId=binding.cast..":"..nextStep,phase=nextStep,success=success},os.clock())

 local human=model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 return root~=nil and root:IsA("BasePart") and human~=nil and human.Health>0 and (root.Position-from).Magnitude<=maxReach
  and lineClear(from+UP,root.Position+UP,rec.avatar,model)

local function detected(rec):boolean
 local p,s=rec.owner,rec.session
 local center=rec.root.Position
 for id,other in pairs(s.rules.castles) do
  if other.alive==true and id~=tostring(p.UserId) and (s.mode~="TEAM" or other.team~=rec.castle.team) then
   if other.isAI then
    local bot=s.botActors and s.botActors[id]
    if closeEnough(rec,bot,center,DETECT_RANGE) then return true end
   else
    local uid=tonumber(id)
    local enemy=uid and Players:GetPlayerByUserId(uid)
    if enemy and currentHumanMember(s,enemy) and humanCombatTargetable(other,enemy)
     and closeEnough(rec,enemy.Character,center,DETECT_RANGE) then return true end
   end
  end
 end
 for _,row in ipairs(rec.swarm.projectileCandidates(center,DETECT_RANGE)) do
  if closeEnough(rec,row.token,center,DETECT_RANGE) then return true end
 end
 return false
end

local function marker(rec,base:Vector3,dir:Vector3,side:number,attacking:boolean)
 local cue=Instance.new("Part")
 cue.Name=if attacking then (if side<0 then "EGGRUMBLE_EclipseShadowLeft" else "EGGRUMBLE_EclipseShadowRight")
  else "EGGRUMBLE_EclipseReappear"
 local reach=if attacking then rec.reach else 1.3
 local from=base-Vector3.new(0,1.35,0)
 local mid=from+dir*reach*.5
 cue.Size=Vector3.new(if attacking then .16 else .30,.09,reach)
 cue.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(mid,mid+dir)*CFrame.Angles(0,side*.14,0)
 cue.Color=if side<0 then Color3.fromRGB(217,188,216) else Color3.fromRGB(191,153,204)
 cue.Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic;cue.Transparency=.34
 cue.Anchored=true;cue.CanCollide=false;cue.CanTouch=false;cue.CanQuery=false;cue.CastShadow=false
 cue.Parent=rec.world
 table.insert(rec.markers,cue)

local function strikeOnce(rec):boolean
 if rec.spent or oldStealth(rec.owner) or carrying(rec) or not owns(rec)
  or not GroundMovement.isGrounded(rec.hum) or not rec.swarm.isCurrentRoleCaster(rec.owner,rec.avatar,ROLE)
  or (rec.root.Position-rec.origin).Magnitude>1.15 then return false end
 if rec.sequence and not rec.sequence.expire(os.clock()) then return false end
 local look=facing(rec.root)
 if not look or look:Dot(rec.direction)<.75 then return false end
 rec.spent=true
 local origin=rec.root.Position+UP
 local hits,candidates=0,{}
 local seen={}
 for _,row in ipairs(rec.swarm.projectileCandidates(rec.root.Position,rec.reach)) do
  local part=row.token.PrimaryPart
  if part then
   local delta=part.Position-rec.root.Position
   local flat=Vector3.new(delta.X,0,delta.Z)
   if delta.Magnitude<=rec.reach and flat.Magnitude>.05 and flat.Unit:Dot(rec.direction)>=.62 then
    table.insert(candidates,{row=row,range=delta.Magnitude})
   end
  end
 end
 table.sort(candidates,function(a,b)
  return a.range==b.range and a.row.id<b.row.id or a.range<b.range
 end)
 local damage=CoreAction.SPECS.NINJA.basic.damage
 for index,choice in ipairs(candidates) do
  if index>16 or hits>=rec.cap then break end
  local target=choice.row.token
  local root=target.PrimaryPart
  if not seen[target] and root and lineClear(origin,root.Position+UP,rec.avatar,target) then
   seen[target]=true
   hits+=rec.swarm.damageFromPlayer(rec.owner,root.Position,.02,damage,"CIRCLE",nil,target,origin)
  end
 end
 local accepted=trace(rec,"ATTACK_VALID",true)
 if hits>0 and accepted then ImpactFeedback.attacker(rec.owner,ROLE,rec.slot,hits) end
 return accepted
end

local function reveal(rec,attacking:boolean)
 if not owns(rec) then clear(rec);return end
 rec.phase="VISIBLE_TELL"
 show(rec)
 if oldStealth(rec.owner) then clear(rec);return end
 local dir=facing(rec.root)
 if not dir then clear(rec);return end
 if attacking and rec.sequence and not trace(rec,"STEALTH_ENDED",true) then clear(rec);return end
 if not attacking and rec.sequence then rec.sequence.abort("REVEALED_EARLY");rec.sequence=nil end
 rec.origin,rec.direction=rec.root.Position,dir
 marker(rec,rec.origin,dir,-1,attacking)
 if attacking then marker(rec,rec.origin,dir,1,true) end
 local ends=os.clock()+rec.tell
 task.delay(rec.tell,function()
  if active[rec.owner]~=rec then return end
  if os.clock()<ends or not owns(rec) then clear(rec);return end
  if attacking and strikeOnce(rec) then
   rec.owner:SetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_SkillCastSignature",ROLE..":"..rec.slot..":"..tostring(rec.serial))
  end
  clear(rec)
 end)
end

function M.blockAttack(session:any,p:Player):boolean
 local rec=active[p]
 if not rec then return false end
 if rec.session~=session then return false end
 if not owns(rec) then clear(rec);return false end
 if rec.phase=="HIDDEN" then reveal(rec,false) end
 return true
end

function M.cargo(session:any,p:Player)
 local rec=active[p]
 if not rec or rec.session~=session or not carrying(rec) then return end
 if rec.phase=="HIDDEN" then reveal(rec,false)
 elseif rec.phase=="VISIBLE_TELL" and rec.id~=HIDE then clear(rec) end
end

local function hide(rec,duration:number)
 rec.phase="HIDDEN"
 rec.hiddenUntil=os.clock()+duration
 rec.displayBefore=rec.hum.DisplayDistanceType
 rec.hum.DisplayDistanceType=Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
 for _,item in ipairs(rec.avatar:GetDescendants()) do stagePart(rec,item) end
 rec.appearance=rec.avatar.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(item)
  if active[rec.owner]==rec and rec.phase=="HIDDEN" then stagePart(rec,item) end
 end)
 rec.owner:SetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_StealthUntil",rec.hiddenUntil)
 table.insert(rec.connections,rec.owner:GetAttributeChangedSignal("EGGRUMBLE_StealthUntil"):Connect(function()
  if active[rec.owner]==rec and rec.phase=="HIDDEN" and rec.owner:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_StealthUntil")~=rec.hiddenUntil then
   reveal(rec,false)
  end
 end))
 task.spawn(function()
  while active[rec.owner]==rec and rec.phase=="HIDDEN" do
   if not owns(rec) then clear(rec);return end
   if carrying(rec) or rec.owner:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_StealthUntil")~=rec.hiddenUntil or detected(rec) then
    reveal(rec,false);return
   end
   local remaining=rec.hiddenUntil-os.clock()
   if remaining<=0 then reveal(rec,rec.id==COMBO);return end
   task.wait(math.min(STEP,remaining))
  end
 end)
end

function M.cast(s:any,p:Player,avatar:Model,root:BasePart,h:Humanoid,castle:any,id:string,slot:string,serial:number):boolean
 local swarm=s.swarm
 local world=s.world
 local arena=world and world:FindFirstChild("TacticalBattlefield")
 if active[p] or oldStealth(p) or not swarm or not arena or not arena:IsA("BasePart")
  or not GroundMovement.isGrounded(h) or (castle.heldEggs or 0)>0 or p:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_CarryingEgg")==true
  or not swarm.isCurrentRoleCaster(p,avatar,ROLE) or not GroundMovement.inside(arena,root.Position) then return false end
 local snapshot=swarm.getRoleGrowthSnapshot(p)
 if not snapshot or snapshot.role~=ROLE then return false end
 local hid,slash=Catalog[HIDE],Catalog[SLASH]
 local stage=snapshot.stage
 local duration=hid.metrics[1].values[stage+1]
 local tell=hid.metrics[2].values[stage+1]
 local cap=slash.metrics[2].values[stage+1]
 local spec=M.presentation(id)
 if not spec or not (duration and tell and cap) then return false end
 local plan=if id==COMBO then ComboRecipes.resolve(ROLE,HIDE,SLASH,stage) else nil
 if id==COMBO and (not plan or plan.flow~="REVEAL_THEN_ATTACK" or plan.telegraphMinSec~=tell or plan.limits.neutralMax~=cap) then return false end
 local rec={owner=p,session=s,world=world,arena=arena,swarm=swarm,avatar=avatar,root=root,hum=h,castle=castle,id=id,slot=slot,
  serial=serial,tell=tell,reach=slash.metrics[1].values[stage+1],cap=cap,markers={},connections={},parts={}}
 if id~=SLASH and detected(rec) then return false end
 if plan then
  local now=os.clock()
  rec.binding={actor=tostring(p.UserId),round=tostring(s),cast="NINJA007:"..tostring(serial)}
  rec.sequence=ComboSequence.open(plan,rec.binding,now+duration+tell+.6,now)
  if not rec.sequence then return false end
 end
 local clocks=if plan then {[HIDE]=hid.cd,[SLASH]=slash.cd,[COMBO]=spec.cd} else {[id]=spec.cd}
 if swarm.tryRoleGrowthCast(p,ROLE,spec.cd,spec.energy,clocks)~=stage then return false end
 active[p]=rec
 local function retire() clear(rec) end
 table.insert(rec.connections,h.Died:Connect(retire))
 table.insert(rec.connections,p.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(removing) if removing==avatar then retire() end end))
 table.insert(rec.connections,world.Destroying:Connect(retire))
 table.insert(rec.connections,world:GetAttributeChangedSignal("EGGRUMBLE_MatchPhase"):Connect(function()
  if s.rules.phase~="ACTIVE" then retire() end
 end))
 if id==SLASH then reveal(rec,true) else hide(rec,duration) end
 return true
end

return M
end)()

local function rotate(direction:Vector3,degrees:number):Vector3
 local angle=math.rad(degrees)
 local side=Vector3.new(-direction.Z,0,direction.X)
 return direction*math.cos(angle)+side*math.sin(angle)
end

local function inLane(offset:Vector3,direction:Vector3,choice:any):boolean
 if math.abs(offset.Y)>3.2 then return false end
 local horizontal=Vector3.new(offset.X,0,offset.Z)
 local distance=horizontal.Magnitude
 if distance<.005 or distance>choice.reach then return false end
 if choice.style.kind=="RING" then return true end
 local forward=horizontal:Dot(direction)
 if choice.style.half then return forward/distance>=math.cos(math.rad(choice.style.half)) end
 local side=Vector3.new(-direction.Z,0,direction.X)
 return forward>0 and math.abs(horizontal:Dot(side))<=choice.style.width
end

 if guard then

 elseif choice.style.kind=="RING" then
  table.clear(dirs)
  for i=0,7 do table.insert(dirs,rotate(heading,i*45)) end
 elseif choice.style.kind=="PAIR" then
  dirs={rotate(heading,-72),rotate(heading,-36),rotate(heading,36),rotate(heading,72)}
 elseif choice.style.half then
  dirs={rotate(heading,-choice.style.half),heading,rotate(heading,choice.style.half)}
 end
 for _,direction in ipairs(dirs) do
  local marker=Instance.new("Part")
  marker.Name="Lane";marker.Anchored=true
  marker.CanCollide=false;marker.CanTouch=false;marker.CanQuery=false;marker.CastShadow=false
  marker.Size=Vector3.new(.11,.07,length)
  marker.Color=if guard then Color3.fromRGB(204,182,124) else Color3.fromRGB(219,171,149)
  marker.Transparency=.42
  local at=origin+direction*(length*.5)+Vector3.new(0,-1.4,0)
  marker.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(at,at+direction)
  marker.Parent=folder
 end
 folder.Parent=world
 return folder
end

function M.cancel(p:Player)
 local work=pending[p]
 if not work then return end
 pending[p]=nil
 for _,connection in ipairs(work.links) do connection:Disconnect() end
 if work.cue.Parent then work.cue:Destroy() end
 if work.spear and work.spear.Parent then work.spear:Destroy() end
end

function M.cast(session:any,p:Player,avatar:Model,root:BasePart,h:Humanoid,owner:any,id:string,slot:string):boolean
 local world,swarm=session.world,session.swarm
 local arena=world and world:FindFirstChild("TacticalBattlefield")
 if not arena or not arena:IsA("BasePart") or not swarm or not swarm.isCurrentRoleCaster or pending[p] then return false end
 local function current():boolean
  return M.slot(session,p,ROLE,slot)==id and session.world==world and world:IsDescendantOf(workspace)
   and session.swarm==swarm and session.rules.phase=="ACTIVE" and session.rules.winner==nil
   and session.rules.castles[tostring(p.UserId)]==owner and owner.alive==true and (owner.heldEggs or 0)==0
   and p.Character==avatar and root.Parent==avatar and h.Parent==avatar and h.Health>0 and GroundMovement.isGrounded(h)
   and GroundMovement.inside(arena,root.Position) and swarm.isCurrentRoleCaster(p,avatar,ROLE)
 end
 if not current() then return false end
 local snapshot=swarm.getRoleGrowthSnapshot(p)
 local choice=snapshot and plan(id,snapshot.stage)
 if not choice then return false end
 local kind=choice.style.kind
 local guarding=kind=="GUARD"
 if guarding and not InvulRuntime.canArmFiniteGuard(session,p,avatar) then return false end
 if not guarding and (not swarm.projectileCandidates or not swarm.damageFromPlayer) then return false end
 local origin=root.Position+Vector3.new(0,-.8,0)
 local look=root.CFrame.LookVector
 local heading=Vector3.new(look.X,0,look.Z)
 if heading.Magnitude<.01 then return false end
 heading=heading.Unit
 if choice.style.side then
  local right=rotate(heading,90)
  heading=if h.MoveDirection:Dot(right)<-.12 then -right else right
 end
 if swarm.tryRoleGrowthCast(p,ROLE,choice.cd,choice.energy,{[id]=choice.cd})~=snapshot.stage then return false end
 local warning=cue(world,id,origin,heading,choice,guarding)
 if guarding then
  if InvulRuntime.armFiniteGuard(session,p,avatar,root,heading,choice.pct,choice.life,choice.style.one,warning) then return true end
  warning:Destroy()
  return false
 end
 local work={cue=warning,links={}}
 pending[p]=work
 local function cancel() if pending[p]==work then M.cancel(p) end end
 table.insert(work.links,h.Died:Connect(cancel))
 table.insert(work.links,p.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(old) if old==avatar then cancel() end end))
 table.insert(work.links,world.Destroying:Connect(cancel))
 table.insert(work.links,world:GetAttributeChangedSignal("EGGRUMBLE_MatchPhase"):Connect(function()
  if world:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_MatchPhase")~="ACTIVE" then cancel() end
 end))
 table.insert(work.links,workspace:GetAttributeChangedSignal(FLAG):Connect(function() if not M.enabled() then cancel() end end))
 local function fresh():boolean
  return pending[p]==work and current() and (root.Position+Vector3.new(0,-.8,0)-origin).Magnitude<=3
 end
 local amount=CombatBalance.skill(ROLE,"A").damage
 local rays=mageWorldRay(session,avatar)
 local function line(from:Vector3,to:Vector3):boolean
  return (to-from).Magnitude<.01 or workspace:Raycast(from,to-from,rays)==nil
 end
 local function strike(target:any,from:Vector3):boolean
  local expected=target.center+Vector3.new(0,.65,0)
  if not line(root.Position,expected) then return false end
  if swarm.damageFromPlayer(p,target.center,.02,amount,"CIRCLE",nil,target.token,from)<=0 then return false end
  if id=="WARRIOR-001" and swarm.staggerWarriorNeutral then
   swarm.staggerWarriorNeutral(p,avatar,target.token,from,heading)
  end
  return true
 end
 local function feedback(hits:number)
  if hits>0 then ImpactFeedback.attacker(p,ROLE,slot,hits) end
 end
 if kind=="FLIGHT" then
  local projectile={id=id,name=choice.name,cooldown=choice.cd,energy=choice.energy,reach=choice.reach,
   limit=choice.cap,width=choice.style.width,tell=choice.tell,speed=29}
  local flight=MageProjectiles.newFlight(projectile,origin,heading)
  local start=os.clock()
  local function clip(from:Vector3,direction:Vector3,a:number,b:number):number?
   local solid=workspace:Raycast(from+direction*a,direction*(b-a),rays)
   return if solid then a+solid.Distance else nil
  end
  local function candidates() return swarm.projectileCandidates(origin,choice.reach) end
  task.spawn(function()
   while not flight.done and pending[p]==work do
    RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
    local age=os.clock()-start
    feedback(MageProjectiles.step(flight,age,fresh(),clip,candidates,strike))
    if not flight.done and age>=choice.tell then
     if not work.spear then
      warning:Destroy()
      local tip=Instance.new("WedgePart")
      tip.Name="EGGRUMBLE_WarriorSpearShadow";tip.Size=Vector3.new(.26,.18,1.15)
      tip.CanCollide=false;tip.CanTouch=false;tip.CanQuery=false;tip.CastShadow=false
      tip.Anchored=true;tip.Color=Color3.fromRGB(214,191,140)
      local at=origin+heading*flight.travelled
      tip.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(at,at+heading);tip.Parent=world;work.spear=tip
     else
      local at=origin+heading*flight.travelled
      work.spear.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(at,at+heading)
     end
    end
   end
   cancel()
  end)
  return true
 end
 local seen={}
 local function beat(direction:Vector3,budget:number):number
  local hits=0
  local candidates=swarm.projectileCandidates(origin,choice.reach)
  table.sort(candidates,function(a,b)
   local first,second=(a.center-origin).Magnitude,(b.center-origin).Magnitude
   if first~=second then return first<second end
   return a.id<b.id
  end)
  for _,candidate in ipairs(candidates) do
   if hits>=budget then break end
   if not seen[candidate.token] and inLane(candidate.center-origin,direction,choice)
    and strike(candidate,origin) then seen[candidate.token]=true;hits+=1 end
  end
  return hits
 end
 task.delay(choice.tell,function()
  if not fresh() then cancel();return end
  if kind~="PAIR" then feedback(beat(heading,choice.cap));cancel();return end
  feedback(beat(rotate(heading,-36),math.ceil(choice.cap/2)))
  task.delay(choice.style.extra,function()
   if fresh() then feedback(beat(rotate(heading,36),math.floor(choice.cap/2))) end
   cancel()
  end)
 end)
 return true
end
return table.freeze(M)
end)()

local ROLE,FORM,COVER,COMBO="BUILDER","BUILDER-060","BUILDER-048","COMBO-014"

function M.slot(session:any,p:Player,role:string,slot:string):string?

 if slot=="B" then return FORM end

local function plan(id:string,stage:number):any
 if stage<0 or stage>4 or stage~=math.floor(stage) then return nil end
 local index=stage+1
 local spec=if id==COMBO then ComboRecipes.resolve(ROLE,FORM,COVER,stage) else nil
 if id==COMBO and (not spec or spec.id~=COMBO or spec.flow~="FORM_THEN_PLACE" or spec.hold) then return nil end
 if id~=FORM and id~=COMBO then return nil end
 return {name=if spec then spec.name else Catalog.name,
  choices=if spec then spec.limits.formChoices else Catalog.metrics[1].values[index],
  life=if spec then spec.limits.formSec else Catalog.metrics[2].values[index],
  tell=if spec then spec.telegraphMinSec else .8,recipe=spec,
  cd=if spec then spec.proposedCooldownSec else Catalog.cd,

end

end

local function makeVisual(avatar:Model,root:BasePart,mode:string,warning:boolean):Folder
 local folder=Instance.new("Folder")
 folder.Name=if warning then "EGGRUMBLE_TransformTell" else "EGGRUMBLE_Transform_"..mode
 local count=if mode=="DRIVE" then 4 else 2
 for i=1,count do
  local side=if i%2==0 then 1 else -1
  local part=Instance.new("Part")
  part.Name=mode
  part.CanCollide=false;part.CanTouch=false;part.CanQuery=false;part.CastShadow=false;part.Massless=true
  part.Material=Enum.Material.Metal
  part.Color=if mode=="ARMOR" then Color3.fromRGB(157,146,121)
   elseif mode=="DRIVE" then Color3.fromRGB(105,129,137) else Color3.fromRGB(125,171,166)
  part.Transparency=if warning then .56 else .09
  part.Size=if mode=="ARMOR" then Vector3.new(.41,1.3,.72)
   elseif mode=="DRIVE" then Vector3.new(.34,.55,.55) else Vector3.new(1.35,.15,.8)
  local x=if mode=="GLIDE" then side*1.06 else side*.83
  local y=if mode=="DRIVE" then -.94 else .53
  local z=if mode=="DRIVE" and i>2 then .47 else -.14
  part.CFrame=root.CFrame*CFrame.new(x,y,z)
  part.Parent=folder
  local weld=Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
  weld.Part0=root;weld.Part1=part;weld.Parent=part
 end
 folder.Parent=avatar
 return folder
end

local function glide(root:BasePart,h:Humanoid,model:Folder,current:()->boolean):()->()
 local attach=Instance.new("Attachment")
 attach.Name="EGGRUMBLE_BuilderGlidePoint";attach.Parent=root
 local force=Instance.new("VectorForce")
 force.Name="EGGRUMBLE_BuilderGlideForce";force.Attachment0=attach
 force.RelativeTo=Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World;force.ApplyAtCenterOfMass=true
 force.Force=Vector3.zero;force.Parent=model
 local tick=RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
  if not current() then force.Force=Vector3.zero;return end
  local velocity=root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
  force.Force=if h.FloorMaterial==Enum.Material.Air and velocity.Y<-1
   then Vector3.new(0,root.AssemblyMass*workspace.Gravity*.30,0) else Vector3.zero

end

 if (active[p] and id~=COVER) or not arena or not arena:IsA("BasePart") or not swarm then return false end
 local function current():boolean
  return M.slot(session,p,ROLE,slot)==id and session.world==world and world:IsDescendantOf(workspace)
   and session.swarm==swarm and session.rules.phase=="ACTIVE" and session.rules.winner==nil
   and session.rules.castles[tostring(p.UserId)]==owner and owner.alive==true and (owner.heldEggs or 0)==0
   and p.Character==avatar and root.Parent==avatar and h.Parent==avatar and h.Health>0
   and h.SeatPart==nil and not h.Sit and not h.PlatformStand and GroundMovement.inside(arena,root.Position)
   and swarm.isCurrentRoleCaster(p,avatar,ROLE) and not LandThenAttack.active(p)
 end
 if not current() or not GroundMovement.isGrounded(h) then return false end
 if id==COVER then return session.builderCoverCast and session.builderCoverCast(p,id)==true end
 local snapshot=swarm.getRoleGrowthSnapshot(p)
 if not snapshot then return false end
 local selectPlan=plan(FORM,snapshot.stage)
 if not selectPlan then return false end
 local now=os.clock()
 local previous=selections[p]
 local known=previous and previous.session==session and previous.avatar==avatar
 local index=if known and previous.index<=selectPlan.choices then previous.index else 1
 if id==SELECT then
  if not tool or (known and now-previous.last<.25) then return false end
  index=index%selectPlan.choices+1
  selections[p]={session=session,avatar=avatar,index=index,last=now}
  local title=titles[modes[index]]
  p:SetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_BuilderFormSelection",title)
  tool.Name="技A・形態切替・"..title
  tool.ToolTip="現在: "..title.."｜Bで変形・Dで合成"
  return true
 end
 local effect=plan(id,snapshot.stage)
 if not effect or index>effect.choices then return false end
 local mode=modes[index]
 local function formAllowed():boolean
  if mode=="ARMOR" then return InvulRuntime.canArmFiniteGuard(session,p,avatar,true) end
  if mode=="DRIVE" then
   local _,slowed=CoreAction.walkCurrent(p,avatar,h,session,os.clock())
   return not slowed and h.WalkSpeed==walkBaseline(session,p,h.WalkSpeed)
  end
  return true
 end
 if not formAllowed() then return false end
 local prepared=if id==COMBO and session.builderFormCoverPreview then session.builderFormCoverPreview(p) else nil
 if id==COMBO and (not prepared or prepared.stage~=snapshot.stage or prepared.width~=effect.recipe.limits.width
  or prepared.life~=effect.recipe.limits.life) then return false end
 local binding={round=tostring(session),actor=tostring(p.UserId),cast=tostring(serial)}
 local timeline=if effect.recipe then ComboSequence.open(effect.recipe,binding,now+effect.tell+.6,now) else nil
 if effect.recipe and not timeline then return false end
 local deadlines=if id==COMBO then {[FORM]=Catalog.cd,[COVER]=prepared.cd,[COMBO]=effect.cd} else {[FORM]=effect.cd}
 if swarm.tryRoleGrowthCast(p,ROLE,effect.cd,effect.energy,deadlines)~=snapshot.stage then return false end
 local origin=root.Position
 local work={cue=makeVisual(avatar,root,mode,true),links={},cleanup=nil}
 active[p]=work
 local function cancel() if active[p]==work then M.cancel(p) end end
 table.insert(work.links,h.Died:Connect(cancel))
 table.insert(work.links,world.Destroying:Connect(cancel))
 table.insert(work.links,p.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(old) if old==avatar then cancel() end end))
 table.insert(work.links,p:GetAttributeChangedSignal("EGGRUMBLE_CarryingEgg"):Connect(function()
  if (owner.heldEggs or 0)>0 or p:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_CarryingEgg")==true then cancel() end
 end))
 table.insert(work.links,world:GetAttributeChangedSignal("EGGRUMBLE_MatchPhase"):Connect(function()
  if world:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_MatchPhase")~="ACTIVE" then cancel() end
 end))
 task.delay(effect.tell,function()
  if active[p]~=work or not current() or not GroundMovement.isGrounded(h) or not formAllowed()
   or (root.Position-origin).Magnitude>3 or (prepared and not session.builderFormCoverValidate(p,prepared)) then cancel();return end
  if work.cue.Parent then work.cue:Destroy() end
  local model=makeVisual(avatar,root,mode,false)
  work.cue=model
  if mode=="ARMOR" then
   if not InvulRuntime.armFiniteGuard(session,p,avatar,root,root.CFrame.LookVector,12,effect.life,false,model,true) then cancel();return end
   work.cleanup=function() InvulRuntime.cancelFiniteGuard(p) end
  elseif mode=="DRIVE" then
   local base=walkBaseline(session,p,h.WalkSpeed)
   local at=os.clock()
   local token,speed,slowed=CoreAction.walkEffect(p,avatar,h,session,"WIND",math.min(32,base*1.10),at+effect.life,base,at)
   if not token then cancel();return end
   applyWalkResult(p,avatar,h,speed,slowed)
   work.cleanup=function() applyWalkResult(p,avatar,h,CoreAction.walkRelease(p,avatar,h,session,token,os.clock(),true)) end
  else
   work.cleanup=glide(root,h,model,current)
  end
  if timeline then
   local function receipt(phase:string):boolean
    return timeline.advance({actor=binding.actor,round=binding.round,cast=binding.cast,binding=binding,
     phase=phase,receiptId=binding.cast..":"..phase,success=true},os.clock())
   end
   if not receipt("FORM_VALID") or not session.builderFormCoverCommit(p,prepared) or not receipt("PLACEMENT_VALID") then
    timeline.abort("FORM_OR_PLACEMENT_INVALID");cancel();return
   end
  end
  task.delay(effect.life,cancel)
 end)
 return true
end
return table.freeze(M)
end)()

local M={}
local ROLE="ZOMBIE"
local FLAG="P0D_ENABLE_PRIVATE_ZOMBIE_RUNES"
local WAVE_FLAG="P0D_ENABLE_PRIVATE_ZOMBIE_WAVES"
local UP=Vector3.new(0,1,0)
local COLOR=Color3.fromRGB(201,174,211)
local CAST_POINT=5 -- Reticle offset for the two authored floor-radius abilities.
local MAX_CHECKS=16
local CASTS=table.freeze({
 MARK=table.freeze({B="ZOMBIE-001",C="ZOMBIE-008",D="ZOMBIE-009"}),
 BOLT=table.freeze({B="ZOMBIE-072",C="ZOMBIE-073",D="ZOMBIE-097"}),
 WAVES=table.freeze({B="ZOMBIE-093",C="ZOMBIE-098"}),
})
local kitNames=table.freeze({MARK="印札三技",BOLT="霊撃三技"})
local perCast=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
local marks=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})

function M.enabled():boolean
 return RunService:IsStudio() and workspace:GetAttribute(FLAG)~=false
end

function M.wavesEnabled():boolean
 return RunService:IsStudio() and workspace:GetAttribute(WAVE_FLAG)~=false
end

function M.kitEnabled(kit:string?):boolean
 if kit=="WAVES" then return M.wavesEnabled() end
 return kit~=nil and M.enabled()
end

function M.nextKit(previous:string?):(string?,string?)
 if previous=="BOLT" then return nil,nil end
 local kit=if previous=="MARK" then "BOLT" else "MARK"
 return kit,kitNames[kit]
end

function M.slot(s:any,p:Player,role:string,slot:string):string?
 if role~=ROLE or not s.zombieRuneLoadouts then return nil end
 local kit=s.zombieRuneLoadouts[p.UserId]
 local list=if M.kitEnabled(kit) then CASTS[kit] else nil
 return list and list[slot] or nil
end

function M.presentation(id:string?):any
 return id and Catalog[id] or nil
end

local function plan(id:string,stage:number)
 local row=Catalog[id]
 if not row then return nil end
 local one,two=row.metrics[1].values[stage+1],row.metrics[2].values[stage+1]
 if not one or not two then return nil end
 local shape=if id=="ZOMBIE-001" or id=="ZOMBIE-008" then "MARK"
  elseif id=="ZOMBIE-009" or id=="ZOMBIE-097" then "RING"
  elseif id=="ZOMBIE-072" or id=="ZOMBIE-093" then "PROJECTILE" elseif id=="ZOMBIE-098" then "FAN" else "LINE"
 local warning=if id=="ZOMBIE-009" then .8 elseif id=="ZOMBIE-097" or id=="ZOMBIE-098" then 1
  elseif id=="ZOMBIE-073" then .6 elseif id=="ZOMBIE-093" then .30 else 0
 return {shape=shape,cd=row.cd,energy=row.energy,name=row.name,reach=if id=="ZOMBIE-008" then two else one,
  count=if id=="ZOMBIE-001" then 1 elseif id=="ZOMBIE-008" then 2 else two,
  life=if id=="ZOMBIE-001" then two elseif id=="ZOMBIE-008" then one else 2,
  tell=warning,information=shape=="MARK" or id=="ZOMBIE-009"}
end

local function clear(records,p:Player,record:any?)
 local item=records[p]
 if not item or (record and item~=record) then return end
 records[p]=nil
 for _,conn in ipairs(item.connections) do conn:Disconnect() end
 for _,object in ipairs(item.visuals) do object:Destroy() end
end

function M.cancel(p:Player)
 clear(perCast,p)
 clear(marks,p)
end

local function own(rec):boolean
 local p,s=rec.owner,rec.session
 return M.slot(s,p,ROLE,rec.slot)==rec.id and s.world==rec.world and s.swarm==rec.swarm
  and rec.world:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and rec.arena.Parent==rec.world
  and s.rules.phase=="ACTIVE" and s.rules.winner==nil and s.rules.castles[tostring(p.UserId)]==rec.castle
  and rec.castle.alive==true and (rec.castle.heldEggs or 0)==0 and p:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_CarryingEgg")~=true
  and p.Character==rec.avatar and rec.avatar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")==rec.root and rec.root.Parent==rec.avatar
  and rec.human.Parent==rec.avatar and rec.human.Health>0 and GroundMovement.isGrounded(rec.human)
  and GroundMovement.inside(rec.arena,rec.root.Position) and rec.swarm.isCurrentRoleCaster(p,rec.avatar,ROLE)
end

local function bind(rec,records,record)
 local function retire() clear(records,rec.owner,record) end
 local p,world=rec.owner,rec.world
 table.insert(record.connections,rec.human.Died:Connect(retire))
 table.insert(record.connections,p.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(avatar) if avatar==rec.avatar then retire() end end))
 table.insert(record.connections,world.Destroying:Connect(retire))
 table.insert(record.connections,world:GetAttributeChangedSignal("EGGRUMBLE_MatchPhase"):Connect(function()
  if rec.session.rules.phase~="ACTIVE" then retire() end
 end))
end

local function flat(v:Vector3):Vector3
 return Vector3.new(v.X,0,v.Z)
end

local function cue(world:Instance,id:string,name:string,shape:Enum.PartType,size:Vector3,frame:CFrame):Part
 local mark=Instance.new("Part")
 mark.Name="EGGRUMBLE_ZombieRune_"..id.."_"..name
 mark.Shape=shape;mark.Size=size;mark.CFrame=frame
 mark.Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic;mark.Transparency=.44;mark.Color=COLOR
 mark.Anchored=true;mark.CanCollide=false;mark.CanTouch=false;mark.CanQuery=false;mark.CastShadow=false
 mark.Parent=world
 return mark
end

local function floor(rec,point:Vector3): (Vector3?,BasePart?)
 if not GroundMovement.inside(rec.arena,point) then return nil,nil end
 local zone=rec.arena.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(point)
 local radius=rec.plan.reach
 if math.abs(zone.X)+radius>rec.arena.Size.X*.5 or math.abs(zone.Z)+radius>rec.arena.Size.Z*.5 then return nil,nil end
 local hit=workspace:Raycast(point+UP*4,UP*-12,rec.rays)
 local base=hit and hit.Instance
 if not hit or not base or not base:IsA("BasePart") or not base.Anchored or not base.CanCollide
  or base.Parent~=rec.world or hit.Normal.Y<.65 or math.abs(hit.Position.Y-rec.root.Position.Y)>5
  or (base~=rec.arena and not base.Name:match("^TacticalRoute_")) then return nil,nil end
 local beam=hit.Position+UP*1.55-(rec.root.Position+UP)
 if beam.Magnitude>.02 and workspace:Raycast(rec.root.Position+UP,beam,rec.rays) then return nil,nil end
 return hit.Position,base
end

local function candidates(rec,origin:Vector3,ring:boolean)
 local result={}
 for _,entry in ipairs(rec.swarm.projectileCandidates(origin,rec.plan.reach+3)) do
  local delta=entry.center-origin
  local horizontal=flat(delta)
  local reach=if ring then horizontal.Magnitude else delta.Magnitude
  local admitted=if ring then math.abs(delta.Y)<=4.6
   else horizontal.Magnitude>.05 and horizontal.Unit:Dot(rec.forward)>=.55
  if reach<=rec.plan.reach and admitted and entry.token.PrimaryPart then
   table.insert(result,{target=entry,distance=reach})
  end
 end
 table.sort(result,function(a,b)
  return a.distance==b.distance and a.target.id<b.target.id or a.distance<b.distance
 end)
 return result
end

local function visible(rec,target:Model,origin:Vector3):boolean
 local root=target.PrimaryPart
 return root~=nil and lineClear(origin,root.Position+UP,rec.avatar,target)
end

local function markTargets(rec,items,origin:Vector3):{Model}
 local selected={}
 for i,item in ipairs(items) do
  if i>MAX_CHECKS or #selected>=rec.plan.count then break end
  local target=item.target.token
  if visible(rec,target,origin) then table.insert(selected,target) end
 end
 return selected
end

local function mark(rec,targets:{Model})
 if #targets==0 then return end
 local p=rec.owner
 clear(marks,p)
 local group={connections={},visuals={}}
 marks[p]=group
 bind(rec,marks,group)
 for _,target in ipairs(targets) do
  local root=target.PrimaryPart
  local humanoid=target:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  if not root or not humanoid then continue end
  local sign=Instance.new("BillboardGui")
  sign.Name="EGGRUMBLE_ZombieRune_"..rec.id.."_Mark"
  sign.MaxDistance=32;sign.AlwaysOnTop=false
  sign.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(80,23)
  sign.StudsOffset=Vector3.new(0,3.45,0)
  local label=Instance.new("TextLabel")
  label.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1);label.TextScaled=true
  label.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(40,31,45);label.BackgroundTransparency=.28
  label.TextColor3=COLOR;label.Text=rec.plan.name;label.Parent=sign
  sign.Parent=root
  table.insert(group.visuals,sign)
  local function hide() sign:Destroy() end
  table.insert(group.connections,humanoid.Died:Connect(hide))
  table.insert(group.connections,target:GetAttributeChangedSignal("EGGRUMBLE_NeutralFriendlyOwnerId"):Connect(function()
   if target:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_NeutralFriendlyOwnerId")~=nil then hide() end
  end))
 end
 task.delay(rec.plan.life,function() clear(marks,p,group) end)
end

local function applyHit(rec,target:Model,origin:Vector3,amount:number?):number
 local root=target.PrimaryPart
 if not root or not visible(rec,target,origin) then return 0 end
 return rec.swarm.damageFromPlayer(rec.owner,root.Position,.02,amount or CoreAction.SPECS.ZOMBIE.basic.damage,"CIRCLE",nil,target,origin)
end

local function lineTargets(rec,origin:Vector3,heading:Vector3):{Model}
 local span=rec.plan.reach
 local barrier=workspace:Raycast(origin,heading*span,rec.rays)
 local limit=if barrier then barrier.Distance else span
 local rows=rec.swarm.projectileCandidates(origin,span)
 local contacts=MageProjectiles.contacts(origin,heading,0,limit,.14,rows,{})
 local targets={}
 for i,entry in ipairs(contacts) do
  if i>MAX_CHECKS or #targets>=rec.plan.count or (barrier and entry.distance>=limit-.00001) then break end
  local target=entry.target.token
  local root=target.PrimaryPart
  local along=root and (root.Position-origin):Dot(heading)
  if along and along>0 and along<=span and visible(rec,target,origin) then table.insert(targets,target) end
 end
 return targets
end

local function strikeBudget(rec,targets:{Model},origin:Vector3):number
 local hits=0
 if #targets==0 then return hits end
 local budget=CoreAction.SPECS.ZOMBIE.basic.damage
 local share,extra=math.floor(budget/#targets),budget%#targets
 for index,target in ipairs(targets) do
  hits+=applyHit(rec,target,origin,share+(if index<=extra then 1 else 0))
 end
 return hits
end

local function turn(heading:Vector3,degrees:number):Vector3
 local r=math.rad(degrees)
 return heading*math.cos(r)+Vector3.new(-heading.Z,0,heading.X)*math.sin(r)
end

local function fanTargets(rec,origin:Vector3,headings:{Vector3}):{Model}
 local lanes={}
 for i,heading in ipairs(headings) do lanes[i]=lineTargets(rec,origin,heading) end
 local selected,seen={},{}
 for index=1,rec.plan.count do
  for _,lane in ipairs(lanes) do
   local target=lane[index]
   if target and not seen[target] then
    table.insert(selected,target);seen[target]=true
    if #selected==rec.plan.count then return selected end
   end
  end
 end
 return selected
end

local function launch(rec,record)
 local p=rec.owner
 local origin=rec.origin+UP
 local arrow=rec.id=="ZOMBIE-093"
 local flight=MageProjectiles.newFlight({reach=rec.plan.reach,width=if arrow then .075 else .13,
  tell=0,speed=if arrow then 35 else 28,limit=rec.plan.count},origin,rec.forward)
 local bead=cue(rec.world,rec.id,"Bolt",Enum.PartType.Block,
  if arrow then Vector3.new(.12,.10,1.04) else Vector3.new(.43,.10,.77),CFrame.lookAt(origin,origin+rec.forward))
 table.insert(record.visuals,bead)
 local began=os.clock()
 local function clip(at:Vector3,heading:Vector3,first:number,last:number):number?
  local hit=workspace:Raycast(at+heading*first,heading*(last-first),rec.rays)
  return if hit then first+hit.Distance else nil
 end
 local function scan()
  local rows={}
  for _,row in ipairs(rec.swarm.projectileCandidates(origin,rec.plan.reach)) do
   local dot=(row.center-origin):Dot(rec.forward)
   if dot>0 and dot<=rec.plan.reach then table.insert(rows,row) end
  end
  return rows
 end
 task.spawn(function()
  while perCast[p]==record and not flight.done do
   task.wait(.0417)
   if perCast[p]~=record then return end
   if not own(rec) or (rec.root.Position-rec.origin).Magnitude>4.5 then break end
   MageProjectiles.step(flight,os.clock()-began,true,clip,scan,function(candidate,from)
    local result=applyHit(rec,candidate.token,from)
    if result>0 then ImpactFeedback.attacker(p,ROLE,rec.slot,result) end
    return not arrow or result>0 -- Old 072 remains strictly non-penetrating.
   end)
   local at=origin+rec.forward*flight.travelled
   bead.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(at,at+rec.forward)
  end
  clear(perCast,p,record)

function M.cast(session:any,p:Player,avatar:Model,root:BasePart,h:Humanoid,castle:any,id:string,slot:string):boolean
 if perCast[p] then return false end
 local world,swarm=session.world,session.swarm
 local arena=world and world:FindFirstChild("TacticalBattlefield")
 if not arena or not arena:IsA("BasePart") or not swarm then return false end
 local heading=flat(root.CFrame.LookVector)
 if heading.Magnitude<.01 then return false end
 local snapshot=swarm.getRoleGrowthSnapshot(p)
 local spec=snapshot and plan(id,snapshot.stage)
 if not snapshot or snapshot.role~=ROLE or not spec then return false end
 local rec={owner=p,session=session,world=world,swarm=swarm,arena=arena,avatar=avatar,root=root,human=h,castle=castle,
  id=id,slot=slot,plan=spec,origin=root.Position,forward=heading.Unit,rays=mageWorldRay(session,avatar)}
 if not own(rec) then return false end
 local targets,point,support,aim
 if spec.shape=="MARK" then
  targets=markTargets(rec,candidates(rec,rec.origin,false),rec.origin+UP)
  if #targets==0 then return false end
 elseif spec.shape=="RING" then
  aim=rec.origin+rec.forward*CAST_POINT
  point,support=floor(rec,aim)
  if not point or not support then return false end
 end
 if swarm.tryRoleGrowthCast(p,ROLE,spec.cd,spec.energy,{[id]=spec.cd})~=snapshot.stage then return false end
 if targets then mark(rec,targets);return true end
 local record={connections={},visuals={}}
 perCast[p]=record
 bind(rec,perCast,record)
 if spec.shape=="PROJECTILE" and spec.tell==0 then launch(rec,record);return true end
 local started=os.clock()
 local headings={rec.forward}
 if spec.shape=="FAN" then
  table.insert(headings,turn(rec.forward,-26));table.insert(headings,turn(rec.forward,26))
 end
 if point then
  table.insert(record.visuals,cue(world,id,"Tell",Enum.PartType.Cylinder,Vector3.new(.073,spec.reach*2,spec.reach*2),
   CFrame.new(point+UP*.065)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.pi*.5)))
 else
  for _,direction in ipairs(headings) do
   local middle=rec.origin+direction*spec.reach*.5-UP*1.15
   table.insert(record.visuals,cue(world,id,"Tell",Enum.PartType.Block,Vector3.new(.51,.085,spec.reach),
    CFrame.lookAt(middle,middle+direction)))
  end
 end
 task.delay(spec.tell,function()
  if perCast[p]~=record then return end
  if os.clock()<started+spec.tell or not own(rec) or (root.Position-rec.origin).Magnitude>1.15 then
   clear(perCast,p,record);return
  end
  if spec.shape=="PROJECTILE" then
   for _,warning in ipairs(record.visuals) do warning:Destroy() end
   table.clear(record.visuals)
   launch(rec,record);return
  end
  clear(perCast,p,record)
  if not point then
   local origin=rec.origin+UP
   local targets=if spec.shape=="FAN" then fanTargets(rec,origin,headings) else lineTargets(rec,origin,rec.forward)
   local hits=strikeBudget(rec,targets,origin)
   if hits>0 then ImpactFeedback.attacker(p,ROLE,slot,hits) end
   return
  end
  local activePoint,activeSupport=floor(rec,aim)
  if activeSupport~=support or not activePoint or (activePoint-point).Magnitude>.12 then return end
  local hits=0
  local confirmed=markTargets(rec,candidates(rec,point,true),root.Position+UP)
  if spec.information then mark(rec,confirmed)
  else
   for _,model in ipairs(confirmed) do hits+=applyHit(rec,model,root.Position+UP) end
   local pillar=cue(world,id,"Impact",Enum.PartType.Cylinder,Vector3.new(3.8,.76,.76),
    CFrame.new(point+UP*1.8)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.pi*.5))
   task.delay(.23,function() pillar:Destroy() end)
   if hits>0 then ImpactFeedback.attacker(p,ROLE,slot,hits) end
  end
 end)
 return true
end

return M
end)()

  ring.Anchored=true;ring.CanCollide=false;ring.CanTouch=false;ring.CanQuery=false;ring.CastShadow=false
  ring.Parent=world;cast.cue=ring
  local function groundedCurrent():boolean

  end

    or (plan and (not swarm.trapperReversalReady(p,avatar,stage,energy,clocks)
     or not LandThenAttack.canHover(world,avatar,root.Position,height))) then retire();return end
   local resampled=swarm.trapperReversalCenter(p,avatar,root,aim,radius)

   if not swarm.reverseTrapperNeutrals(p,avatar,point,radius,reversal,cap,groundedCurrent,function(moved)
    if live[p]~=cast then return end
    cast.retire=nil
    if not plan or not trace("CONTROL_VALID",moved) or not rise() then retire() end
   end,function(cancel) cast.retire=cancel end) then retire() end

local NinjaCuts=(function()

local TELL,PAIR_DELAY=.24,.29

local M={}

end

local function yaw(heading:Vector3,angle:number):Vector3
 local a=math.rad(angle)
 return Vector3.new(heading.X*math.cos(a)-heading.Z*math.sin(a),0,
  heading.X*math.sin(a)+heading.Z*math.cos(a))
end

local function cueFor(world:Instance,id:string,mode:string,origin:Vector3,heading:Vector3,reach:number):Folder
 local folder=Instance.new("Folder")
 folder.Name="EGGRUMBLE_NinjaCut_"..id
 local directions=if mode=="PAIRED" then {yaw(heading,-36),yaw(heading,36)} else {heading}
 for i,direction in ipairs(directions) do
  local edge=Instance.new("WedgePart")
  local at=origin+direction*reach*.5-Vector3.new(0,.6,0)
  edge.Name=if i==1 then "FirstEdge" else "SecondEdge"
  edge.Size=Vector3.new(if mode=="FLIGHT" then .17 else .36,.11,reach)
  edge.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(at,at+direction)
  edge.Anchored=true;edge.CanCollide=false;edge.CanTouch=false;edge.CanQuery=false
  edge.CastShadow=false;edge.Transparency=if i==1 then .28 else .62
  edge.Color=if i==1 then Color3.fromRGB(212,185,216) else Color3.fromRGB(175,144,195)
  edge.Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
  edge.Parent=folder
 end
 folder.Parent=world
 return folder
end

function M.cast(s:any,p:Player,role:string,slot:string,id:string,avatar:Model,root:BasePart,h:Humanoid):boolean
 local row=M.presentation(id)
 local swarm,world=s.swarm,s.world
 local arena=world and world:FindFirstChild("TacticalBattlefield")
 local castle=s.rules and s.rules.castles[tostring(p.UserId)]
 if not row or active[p] or not castle or not swarm or not arena or not arena:IsA("BasePart")
  or type(swarm.projectileCandidates)~="function" or type(swarm.damageFromPlayer)~="function" then return false end
 local at=root.Position
 local function current():boolean
  local stealth=p:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_StealthUntil")
  return M.slot(s,p,role,slot)==id and s.rules.phase=="ACTIVE" and s.rules.winner==nil
   and s.rules.castles[tostring(p.UserId)]==castle and castle.alive and (castle.heldEggs or 0)==0
   and p.Character==avatar and root.Parent==avatar and h.Parent==avatar and h.Health>0
   and not h.Sit and not h.PlatformStand and not h.SeatPart and GroundMovement.isGrounded(h)
   and not (type(stealth)=="number" and stealth>os.clock()) and currentHumanMember(s,p)
   and GroundMovement.inside(arena,root.Position) and swarm.isCurrentRoleCaster(p,avatar,ROLE)
   and arena.Parent==world and world.Parent~=nil and (root.Position-at).Magnitude<=3.25
 end
 if not current() then return false end
 local snap=swarm.getRoleGrowthSnapshot(p)
 local look=root.CFrame.LookVector
 local direction=Vector3.new(look.X,0,look.Z)
 if not snap or snap.role~=ROLE or direction.Magnitude<.01 then return false end
 local i=snap.stage+1
 local reach,cap=row.reach[i],if row.cap then row.cap[i] else 1
 local power=CombatBalance.skill(ROLE,"A").damage
 local kind=row.mode
 if swarm.tryRoleGrowthCast(p,ROLE,row.cd,row.energy,{[id]=row.cd})~=snap.stage then return false end
 local heading=if kind=="REAR" then -direction.Unit else direction.Unit
 local origin=at+(if kind=="FLIGHT" then Vector3.new(0,-.45,0) else UP)
 local cue=cueFor(world,id,kind,origin,heading,reach)
 local shot={cue=cue,links={}}
 active[p]=shot
 local function cancel() if active[p]==shot then M.cancel(p) end end
 local function fresh() return active[p]==shot and current() end
 table.insert(shot.links,h.Died:Connect(cancel))
 table.insert(shot.links,p.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(old) if old==avatar then cancel() end end))
 table.insert(shot.links,world.Destroying:Connect(cancel))
 table.insert(shot.links,world:GetAttributeChangedSignal("EGGRUMBLE_MatchPhase"):Connect(function()
  if s.rules.phase~="ACTIVE" then cancel() end
 end))
 table.insert(shot.links,workspace:GetAttributeChangedSignal(FLAG):Connect(function()
  if not M.enabled() then cancel() end
 end))

 local rays=mageWorldRay(s,avatar)
 local function clear(first:Vector3,last:Vector3):boolean
  return (last-first).Magnitude<.01 or workspace:Raycast(first,last-first,rays)==nil
 end
 local function damage(target:any,amount:number,from:Vector3):boolean
  return clear(root.Position+UP,target.center+UP)
   and swarm.damageFromPlayer(p,target.center,.02,amount,"CIRCLE",nil,target.token,from)>0
 end
 local function report(hits:number)
  if hits>0 then ImpactFeedback.attacker(p,ROLE,slot,hits) end
 end
 local function geometry(target:any,dir:Vector3):boolean
  local delta=target.center-at
  local flat=Vector3.new(delta.X,0,delta.Z)
  if flat.Magnitude<.05 or delta.Magnitude>reach or math.abs(delta.Y)>2.7
   or flat.Unit:Dot(dir)<.67 or not clear(origin,target.center+UP) then return false end
  if kind~="BACKSTAB" then return true end
  local targetRoot=target.token.PrimaryPart
  if not targetRoot then return false end
  local facing=targetRoot.CFrame.LookVector
  local horizontal=Vector3.new(facing.X,0,facing.Z)
  return horizontal.Magnitude>.01 and horizontal.Unit:Dot(flat.Unit)>.45
 end
 local function candidates()
  return swarm.projectileCandidates(at,reach)
 end
 if kind=="FLIGHT" then
  local plan={id=id,name=row.name,reach=reach,limit=cap,width=.42,tell=TELL,speed=28}
  local flight=MageProjectiles.newFlight(plan,origin,heading)
  local start=os.clock()
  local edge=cue:FindFirstChild("FirstEdge")
  local function clip(from:Vector3,dir:Vector3,first:number,last:number):number?
   local solid=workspace:Raycast(from+dir*first,dir*(last-first),rays)
   return if solid then first+solid.Distance else nil
  end
  task.spawn(function()
   while not flight.done and active[p]==shot do
    RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
    local age=os.clock()-start
    report(MageProjectiles.step(flight,age,fresh(),clip,candidates,function(target,from)
     return damage(target,power,from)
    end))
    if not flight.done and age>=TELL and edge and edge.Parent then
     local here=origin+heading*flight.travelled
     edge.Size=Vector3.new(.25,.12,1.15);edge.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(here,here+heading)
    end
   end
   cancel()
  end)
  return true
 end

 local seen={}
 local function beat(dir:Vector3,budget:number,amount:number,only:Model?):(number,Model?)
  local ordered=candidates()
  table.sort(ordered,function(a,b)
   local da,db=(a.center-at).Magnitude,(b.center-at).Magnitude
   return if da==db then a.id<b.id else da<db
  end)
  local hits,first=0,nil
  for index,target in ipairs(ordered) do
   if index>24 or hits>=budget then break end
   if (not only or target.token==only) and not seen[target.token] and geometry(target,dir)
    and damage(target,amount,origin) then
    seen[target.token]=true
    first=first or target.token
    hits+=1
   end
  end
  return hits,first
 end

 task.delay(TELL,function()
  if not fresh() then cancel();return end
  if kind=="PAIRED" then
   local portion=power/cap
   local hits=beat(yaw(heading,-36),math.ceil(cap/2),portion,nil)
   report(hits)
   local firstEdge=cue:FindFirstChild("FirstEdge")
   if firstEdge then firstEdge.Transparency=.7 end
   local secondEdge=cue:FindFirstChild("SecondEdge")
   if secondEdge then secondEdge.Transparency=.28 end
   task.delay(PAIR_DELAY,function()
    if fresh() then report((beat(yaw(heading,36),math.floor(cap/2),portion,nil))) end
    cancel()
   end)
  elseif kind=="ECHO" then
   local hits,token=beat(heading,1,power/2,nil)
   report(hits)
   if not token then cancel();return end
   local edge=cue:FindFirstChild("FirstEdge")
   if edge then edge.Transparency=.48;edge.Color=Color3.fromRGB(165,137,189) end
   task.delay(row.delay[i],function()
    if fresh() then
     seen[token]=nil
     report((beat(heading,1,power/2,token)))
    end
    cancel()
   end)
  else
   local amount=if row.bonus then power*(1+row.bonus[i]/100) else power
   report((beat(heading,cap,amount,nil)))
   cancel()
  end
 end)
 return true
end

return table.freeze(M)
end)()

local CommonFooting=(function()
 local FLAG="P0D_ENABLE_PRIVATE_COMMON_FOOTING"
 local COMMON,GUARD,COMBO="COMMON-025","WARRIOR-018","COMBO-003"
 local widths,lives={2,2.5,3,3.5,4},{1,1.5,2,2.5,3}

  [COMBO]={name="光盾踏陣",hint="自分の足場に着地して正面を守る",energy=80,cd=40},
 }
 local M={}

 function M.slot(session:any,p:Player,role:string,slot:string):string?
  if workspace:GetAttribute(FLAG)==false or not session.footingLoadouts or session.footingLoadouts[p.UserId]~=true then return nil end
  if slot=="C" then return COMMON end
  if slot=="D" and role=="WARRIOR" and WarriorTech.slot(session,p,role,"A")==GUARD then return COMBO end
  return nil
 end

 function M.presentation(id:string?):any return if id then names[id] else nil end

 function M.cast(session:any,p:Player,role:string,slot:string,id:string,avatar:Model,root:BasePart,h:Humanoid,
  serial:number):boolean
  local swarm,world=session.swarm,session.world
  if M.slot(session,p,role,slot)~=id or not swarm or type(session.placeCommonFooting)~="function"
   or not currentHumanMember(session,p) or not swarm.isCurrentRoleCaster(p,avatar,role) then return false end
  local snapshot=swarm.getRoleGrowthSnapshot(p)
  if not snapshot or snapshot.role~=role then return false end
  local i=snapshot.stage+1
  local recipe=if id==COMBO then ComboRecipes.resolve(role,GUARD,COMMON,snapshot.stage) else nil
  if id==COMBO and (not recipe or recipe.flow~="PLACE_THEN_GUARD"
   or not InvulRuntime.canArmFiniteGuard(session,p,avatar)) then return false end
  local width,life=widths[i],lives[i]
  local row=names[id]
  local now=os.clock()
  local binding={actor=tostring(p.UserId),round=tostring(session),cast=tostring(serial)}
  local sequence=if recipe then ComboSequence.open(recipe,binding,now+life,now) else nil
  if recipe and not sequence then return false end
  local function trace(phase:string,success:boolean):boolean
   return sequence.advance({binding=binding,actor=binding.actor,round=binding.round,cast=binding.cast,
    phase=phase,success=success,receiptId=binding.cast..":"..phase},os.clock())
  end
  local clocks=if recipe then {[COMMON]=30,[GUARD]=24,[COMBO]=40} else {[COMMON]=30}
  local platform=session.placeCommonFooting(p,role,avatar,root,h,width,life,function()
   return swarm.tryRoleGrowthCast(p,role,row.cd,row.energy,clocks)==snapshot.stage
  end)
  if not platform then return false end
  if not sequence then return true end
  if not trace("PLACEMENT_VALID",true) then return true end
  local function ownsFootContact():boolean
   if not platform.live() or M.slot(session,p,role,slot)~=id or root.Parent~=avatar
    or h.FloorMaterial==Enum.Material.Air or math.abs(root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y)>1.8 then return false end
   local other=platform.part.Position-root.Position
   if math.abs(other.X)>width/2 or math.abs(other.Z)>width/2 then return false end
   local rays=RaycastParams.new()
   rays.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
   rays.FilterDescendantsInstances={avatar}
   rays.RespectCanCollide=true
   local floor=workspace:Raycast(root.Position,Vector3.new(0,-platform.rootClearance-.65,0),rays)
   return floor~=nil and floor.Instance==platform.part
  end
  local function guardWhenLanded()
   if not platform.live() or M.slot(session,p,role,slot)~=id then sequence.abort("PLATFORM_RETIRED");return end
   local seconds=math.min(recipe.limits.guardMaxSec,platform.expires-os.clock())
   if seconds<.60 then sequence.abort("NO_PLATFORM_GUARD_WINDOW");return end
   if not ownsFootContact() then task.delay(.045,guardWhenLanded);return end
   if not trace("OWNER_ON_PLATFORM",true) then return end
   local look=root.CFrame.LookVector
   local heading=Vector3.new(look.X,0,look.Z)
   if heading.Magnitude<.01 then trace("GUARD_VALID",false);return end
   local edge=Instance.new("Part")
   edge.Name="EGGRUMBLE_LightShieldFooting"
   edge.Size=Vector3.new(width*.88,.13,.21)
   edge.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(root.Position+heading.Unit*(width*.46),root.Position+heading.Unit*width)
   edge.Anchored=true;edge.CanCollide=false;edge.CanTouch=false;edge.CanQuery=false
   edge.CastShadow=false;edge.Color=Color3.fromRGB(219,187,132);edge.Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
   edge.Parent=world
   local armed=InvulRuntime.armFootingGuard(session,p,avatar,root,heading.Unit,recipe.limits.mitigatePct,
    seconds,edge,ownsFootContact)
   if not armed then edge:Destroy() end
   trace("GUARD_VALID",armed)
  end
  task.delay(.045,guardWhenLanded)
  return true
 end

 return M
end)()

local GravityOrb=(function()
--!strict
-- TRAPPER-015 target and motion limits. The existing Horde owns mob positions.
local Orb = {}

Orb.radius = table.freeze({5, 6, 7, 8, 9})
Orb.targets = table.freeze({2, 3, 4, 5, 6})
Orb.cooldown = 24
Orb.energy = 40
Orb.tellSeconds = .30
Orb.releaseSeconds = .32
Orb.placement = 5.5

function Orb.motion(at: Vector3, center: Vector3): (Vector3?, Vector3?)
    local radial = Vector3.new(at.X - center.X, 0, at.Z - center.Z)
    local gap = radial.Magnitude
    if gap <= 1.1 then return nil, nil end
    local outward = radial.Unit
    local tangent = Vector3.new(-outward.Z, 0, outward.X)
    local pull = math.min(3.25, gap - 1.1)
    return -outward * pull + tangent * math.min(.3, pull * .12), outward * 1.75
end

-- #796's continuous body sweep with a tangential retry and final overlap check.
-- This variant receives the existing neutral's body dimensions and world filters.
function Orb.safeStep(at: Vector3, step: Vector3, sweep: (Vector3, Vector3) -> RaycastResult?,
        blockedAt: (Vector3) -> boolean): Vector3?
    if step.Magnitude <= .01 then return nil end
    local hit = sweep(at, step)
    if hit then
        local outward = Vector3.new(hit.Normal.X, 0, hit.Normal.Z)
        if outward.Magnitude < .5 then return nil end
        outward = outward.Unit
        step -= outward * step:Dot(outward)
        if step.Magnitude <= .01 or sweep(at, step) then return nil end
    end
    local last = at + step
    if blockedAt(last) then return nil end
    return last
end

return table.freeze(Orb)
end)()

    local displacement=math.sqrt(dx*dx+dz*dz)
    -- Do not count respawn or recovery teleports as movement.
    if displacement>math.clamp(walkSpeed,0,64)*dt+.75
        or math.abs(position.Y-previous.Y)>16*dt+3 then
        state.actionAt=nil
        return
    end
    local qualified=if displacement>=.24 then dt else 0
    if state.actionAt and state.actionAt<=now then
        -- Intersect the sample window with the server-confirmed activity window.
        local actionSeconds=math.max(0, math.min(now,state.actionAt+ACTION_ACTIVITY_SECONDS)
            -math.max(previousAt,state.actionAt))
        qualified=math.max(qualified,actionSeconds)
    end
    if qualified<=0 then return end

    state.activeSeconds+=qualified
    state.energy=math.min(ENERGY_CAP,state.energy+qualified*ENERGY_PER_ACTIVE_SECOND)
    if state.firstS4Activity==nil and state.activeSeconds>=LEVEL_ONE_SECONDS then
        state.firstS4Activity=LEVEL_ONE_SECONDS
    end
end

 local function closeWandTest(pose:CFrame?,center:Vector3,radius:number):((Vector3)->boolean)?
  if not pose or radius~=5 then return nil end
  local look=pose.LookVector
  local length=math.sqrt(look.X*look.X+look.Z*look.Z)

  local ux,uz=look.X/length,look.Z/length

   local x,z=target.X-start.X,target.Z-start.Z
   local forward=x*ux+z*uz
   return forward>=1 and forward<=limit and math.abs(z*ux-x*uz)<=math.min(2,forward*.5)
  end

 -- ACTIVE 16f7bf863f9c TRAPPER-015, adapted to the selected PRIVATE Swarm's
 -- live model ledger and TacticalBattlefield floor. Only Swarm moves NPCs.
 local function gravityCaster(player:Player,avatar:Model):boolean
  return workspace:GetAttribute("P0D_ENABLE_PRIVATE_TRAPPER_015")~=false
   and session.trapperGravityLoadouts~=nil and session.trapperGravityLoadouts[player.UserId]==true
   and api.isCurrentRoleCaster(player,avatar,"TRAPPER")
 end

 local function gravityRays(character:Model):RaycastParams
  local rays=RaycastParams.new()
  rays.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
  rays.FilterDescendantsInstances={character,all}
  rays.RespectCanCollide=true
  return rays
 end

 local function gravityGround(at:Vector3,rays:RaycastParams):RaycastResult?
  if not spawnFloor or not spawnFloor:IsA("BasePart") or spawnFloor.Parent~=session.world
   or not neutralWithinArena(at,spawnFloor) then return nil end
  local ground=workspace:Raycast(at+Vector3.new(0,3,0),Vector3.new(0,-8,0),rays)
  if ground and ground.Normal.Y>=.72 and ground.Instance.CanCollide
   and ground.Instance:IsDescendantOf(session.world) then return ground end
  return nil
 end

 local function gravityMove(model:Model,delta:Vector3,character:Model,straight:boolean?):Vector3?
  local root=model.PrimaryPart
  if not root or model.Parent~=all then return nil end
  local rays=gravityRays(character)
  local overlap=OverlapParams.new()
  overlap.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
  overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances=rays.FilterDescendantsInstances
  overlap.RespectCanCollide=true;overlap.MaxParts=1
  local position=root.Position
  -- Blockcast omits an initial overlap. Do not pull an already embedded body
  -- through the obstacle to reach a clear endpoint.
  if #workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(position),root.Size,overlap)>0 then return nil end
  local height=2*(root.Size.Y/2.5) -- Existing ground clearance for the neutral rig.
  local function grounded(at:Vector3):Vector3?
   local ground=gravityGround(at,rays)
   if not ground or math.abs(ground.Position.Y+height-position.Y)>1.4 then return nil end
   return Vector3.new(at.X,ground.Position.Y+height,at.Z)
  end
  local function sweep(from:Vector3,step:Vector3):RaycastResult?
   return workspace:Blockcast(CFrame.new(from),root.Size,step,rays)
  end
  local function blocked(at:Vector3):boolean
   local found=grounded(at)
   return found==nil or (found-at).Magnitude>.15
    or #workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(found),root.Size,overlap)>0
  end
  local aimed=grounded(position+delta)
  if not aimed then return nil end
  local safe
  if straight then
   if sweep(position,aimed-position) or blocked(aimed) then return nil end
   safe=aimed
  else
   safe=GravityOrb.safeStep(position,aimed-position,sweep,blocked)
  end
  if not safe then return nil end
  model:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(safe,safe+root.CFrame.LookVector))
  return safe
 end

 api.trapperReversalReady=function(player:Player,avatar:Model,stage:number,energy:number,clocks:any):boolean

 api.trapperReversalCenter=function(player:Player,avatar:Model,root:BasePart,point:Vector3,radius:number):Vector3?

   or (point-root.Position).Magnitude>9 then return nil end
  local zone=spawnFloor.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(point)
  if math.abs(zone.X)+radius>spawnFloor.Size.X*.5 or math.abs(zone.Z)+radius>spawnFloor.Size.Z*.5 then return nil end
  local rays=gravityRays(avatar)
  local ground=gravityGround(point,rays)
  if not ground or math.abs(ground.Position.Y-root.Position.Y)>5 then return nil end
  local from=root.Position+Vector3.new(0,1,0)
  local at=ground.Position+Vector3.new(0,1.55,0)
  if workspace:Raycast(from,at-from,rays) then return nil end
  return ground.Position
 end

 api.reverseTrapperNeutrals=function(player:Player,avatar:Model,center:Vector3,radius:number,duration:number,
  cap:number,current:()->boolean,ended:(boolean)->(),register:(()->())->()):boolean
  if not reversalCaster(player,avatar) or not current() then return false end
  local now=os.clock()
  local rows={}
  local rays=gravityRays(avatar)
  for model,step in pairs(lastNeutralStep) do
   local h,root=live[model],model.PrimaryPart
   if model.Parent~=all or not root or root~=step.root or not h or h.Health<=0 or charmedByModel[model]
    or gravityHeld[model] or now-step.now>.55 or (root.Position-step.to).Magnitude>.14 then continue end
   local relative=root.Position-center
   local distance=Vector3.new(relative.X,0,relative.Z).Magnitude
   if distance>radius or math.abs(relative.Y)>4.5 then continue end
   local origin=Vector3.new(center.X,root.Position.Y,center.Z)
   local delta=root.Position-origin
   if delta.Magnitude>.02 and workspace:Raycast(origin,delta,rays) then continue end
   local id=model:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_NeutralInstanceId")
   if type(id)=="string" then table.insert(rows,{model=model,root=root,from=step.to,to=step.from,distance=distance,id=id}) end
  end
  table.sort(rows,function(a,b) return a.distance==b.distance and a.id<b.id or a.distance<b.distance end)
  if #rows==0 then return false end

  local lease={reversal=true,expires=now+duration+.12}
  local claimed={}
  for index,row in ipairs(rows) do
   if index>cap then break end
   gravityHeld[row.model]=lease
   lastNeutralStep[row.model]=nil
   row.last=row.from
   table.insert(claimed,row)
  end
  local canceled=false
  local function release()
   for _,row in ipairs(claimed) do
    if gravityHeld[row.model]==lease then gravityHeld[row.model]=nil end
   end
  end
  register(function() canceled=true;release() end)
  task.spawn(function()
   local completed=false
   repeat
    task.wait(.05)
    if canceled or not current() then break end
    local at=os.clock()
    local u=math.clamp((at-now)/duration,0,1)
    if u>.9999 then u=1 end
    for _,row in ipairs(claimed) do
     local model,root=row.model,row.root
     local h=live[model]
     if gravityHeld[model]~=lease then continue end
     local moved
     if h and h.Health>0 and model.Parent==all and model.PrimaryPart==root and not charmedByModel[model]
      and (root.Position-row.last).Magnitude<=.14 then
      local target=row.from+(row.to-row.from)*u
      local delta=target-root.Position
      if delta.Magnitude<=.013 then moved=root.Position
      else moved=gravityMove(model,Vector3.new(delta.X,0,delta.Z),avatar,true) end
      if moved and (moved-target).Magnitude<=.12 then
       row.last=moved
       if u==1 and (row.last-row.from).Magnitude>=.12 then completed=true end
       continue
      end
     end
     gravityHeld[model]=nil
    end
    if u==1 then break end
   until os.clock()>=lease.expires
   release()
   if not canceled then ended(completed and current()) end
  end)
  return true
 end

 api.pushMageGroundNeutral=function(player:Player,avatar:Model,target:Model,center:Vector3,heading:Vector3,id:string):Vector3?
  local kit=session.mageProjectiles and session.mageProjectiles[player.UserId]
  local ice=id=="MAGE-015"

   local stage=api.getRoleGrowthSnapshot(player)
   if kit~="MAGE_FIELD_ELEMENTS" or workspace:GetAttribute("P0D_ENABLE_PRIVATE_MAGE_FIELD_ARCS")==false
    or not stage or stage.stage~=4 then return nil end
  elseif (id~="MAGE-058" and id~="MAGE-069") or workspace:GetAttribute("P0D_ENABLE_PRIVATE_MAGE_GROUND_TELLS")==false
   or kit~="MAGE_GROUND_TELLS" then return nil end
  local root=target.PrimaryPart
  local h=live[target]
  local suction=gravityHeld[target]
  if target.Parent~=all or not root or not h or h.Health<=0 or charmedByModel[target]
   or (suction and suction.expires>os.clock()) then return nil end
  local heavy=target:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_NeutralSpecies")=="BABY_GOLEM"
  if heavy and (id=="MAGE-058" or ice) then return nil end
  local before=root.Position

 -- Only a currently registered neutral in this Swarm can exchange positions.
 local function exchangeCaster(player:Player,avatar:Model):boolean
  return workspace:GetAttribute("P0D_ENABLE_PRIVATE_TRAPPER_SWAP_HOVER")~=false
   and session.trapperSwapHoverLoadouts~=nil and session.trapperSwapHoverLoadouts[player.UserId]==true
   and api.isCurrentRoleCaster(player,avatar,"TRAPPER")
 end

 local function exchangeEndpoints(avatar:Model,heroRoot:BasePart,model:Model,neutralRoot:BasePart,range:number)
  local from,to=heroRoot.Position,neutralRoot.Position
  if (to-from).Magnitude>range or (to-from).Magnitude<2.1 then return nil end
  if not spawnFloor or spawnFloor.Parent~=session.world
   or not neutralWithinArena(from,spawnFloor) or not neutralWithinArena(to,spawnFloor) then return nil end
  local rays=RaycastParams.new()
  rays.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
  rays.FilterDescendantsInstances={avatar,model}
  rays.RespectCanCollide=true
  local overlap=OverlapParams.new()
  overlap.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
  overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances=rays.FilterDescendantsInstances
  overlap.RespectCanCollide=true
  overlap.MaxParts=1
  local a,b=gravityGround(from,rays),gravityGround(to,rays)
  if not a or not b then return nil end
  if not a.Instance.Anchored or not b.Instance.Anchored or a.Material==Enum.Material.Water
   or b.Material==Enum.Material.Water or math.abs(a.Position.Y-b.Position.Y)>1.25 then return nil end
  local heroAt=Vector3.new(to.X,b.Position.Y+from.Y-a.Position.Y,to.Z)
  local neutralAt=Vector3.new(from.X,a.Position.Y+to.Y-b.Position.Y,from.Z)
  local heroSize=Vector3.new(2.1,3.5,2.1)
  local heroCenter=Vector3.new(0,.23,0)
  local function traversable(origin:Vector3,destination:Vector3,body:Vector3)
   return #workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(origin),body,overlap)==0
    and not workspace:Blockcast(CFrame.new(origin),body,destination-origin,rays)
    and #workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(destination),body,overlap)==0
  end
  if not traversable(from+heroCenter,heroAt+heroCenter,heroSize)
   or not traversable(to,neutralAt,neutralRoot.Size) then return nil end
  for other,health in pairs(live) do
   local root=other.PrimaryPart
   if other~=model and root and other.Parent==all and health.Health>0
    and ((root.Position-heroAt).Magnitude<1.9 or (root.Position-neutralAt).Magnitude<1.9) then return nil end
  end
  return heroAt,neutralAt
 end

 local function exchangeNeutral(model:Model,avatar:Model)
  local health=live[model]
  local root=model.PrimaryPart
  if not health or health.Health<=0 or model.Parent~=all or not root or root.Parent~=model
   or model==avatar or charmedByModel[model] or gravityHeld[model]
   or model:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_IsBoss")==true then return nil end
  return root
 end

 api.planTrapperSwap=function(player:Player,avatar:Model,root:BasePart,range:number)
  if not exchangeCaster(player,avatar) or root.Parent~=avatar then return nil end
  local facing=root.CFrame.LookVector
  local best,nearest,key
  for _,choice in ipairs(api.projectileCandidates(root.Position,range)) do
   local delta=choice.center-root.Position
   local distance=delta.Magnitude
   if distance>=2.1 and distance<=range and delta.Unit:Dot(facing)>=.56
    and (not nearest or distance<nearest or distance==nearest and choice.id<key) then
    local target=choice.token
    local neutral=exchangeNeutral(target,avatar)
    if neutral then
     local heroAt,neutralAt=exchangeEndpoints(avatar,root,target,neutral,range)
     if heroAt and neutralAt then
      nearest,key=distance,choice.id
      best={target=target,neutral=neutral,from=root.Position,to=neutral.Position,
       heroAt=heroAt,neutralAt=neutralAt,range=range,match=session.world}
     end
    end
   end
  end
  return best
 end

 api.finishTrapperSwap=function(player:Player,avatar:Model,root:BasePart,plan:any,canLand:any)
  if not exchangeCaster(player,avatar) or plan.match~=session.world or root.Parent~=avatar
   or (root.Position-plan.from).Magnitude>1.05 then return false end
  local neutral=exchangeNeutral(plan.target,avatar)
  if not neutral or neutral~=plan.neutral or (neutral.Position-plan.to).Magnitude>1.05 then return false end
  local heroAt,neutralAt=exchangeEndpoints(avatar,root,plan.target,neutral,plan.range)
  if not heroAt or not neutralAt or (canLand and not canLand(heroAt)) then return false end
  -- Both collision sweeps succeeded, with no yield before committing both pivots.
  local heroBefore=avatar:GetPivot()
  local neutralBefore=plan.target:GetPivot()
  local committed=pcall(function()
   avatar:PivotTo(heroBefore+(heroAt-root.Position))
   plan.target:PivotTo(neutralBefore+(neutralAt-neutral.Position))
  end)
  if not committed then
   avatar:PivotTo(heroBefore)
   plan.target:PivotTo(neutralBefore)
   return false
  end
  return true
 end

 end

 api.gravityCenter=function(player:Player,avatar:Model,from:Vector3,at:Vector3):Vector3?
  if not gravityCaster(player,avatar) then return nil end

  local ground=gravityGround(at,rays)

  local center=ground.Position+Vector3.new(0,1.8,0)

  return center

 api.pullGravity=function(player:Player,avatar:Model,center:Vector3,stage:number,now:number,token:any):any
  local radius,limit=GravityOrb.radius[stage+1],GravityOrb.targets[stage+1]
  if not radius or not limit or token.world~=session.world or not gravityCaster(player,avatar) then return {} end
  local rays=gravityRays(avatar)
  local eligible={}
  for model,h in pairs(live) do
   local root=model.PrimaryPart
   local prior=gravityHeld[model]
   if model.Parent~=all or not root or h.Health<=0 or charmedByModel[model]
    or (prior and prior.expires>now) then continue end
   local offset=root.Position-center
   local distance=Vector3.new(offset.X,0,offset.Z).Magnitude
   local id=tonumber(model:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_NeutralInstanceId"))
   if id and distance<=radius and math.abs(offset.Y)<=3.5 and not workspace:Raycast(center,offset,rays) then
    table.insert(eligible,{model=model,position=root.Position,distance=distance,id=id})
   end
  end
  table.sort(eligible,function(a,b)
   if a.distance==b.distance then return a.id<b.id end
   return a.distance<b.distance
  end)
  local pulled={}
  for _,candidate in ipairs(eligible) do
   if #pulled>=limit then break end
   local inward,outward=GravityOrb.motion(candidate.position,center)
   if inward and outward then
    local at=gravityMove(candidate.model,inward,avatar)
    if at then
     gravityHeld[candidate.model]=token
     table.insert(pulled,{model=candidate.model,position=at,outward=outward,previous=candidate.position})
    end
   end
  end
  if #pulled>0 then
   local state,current=currentRoleGrowth(player,now)
   if state and current==avatar then MatchRoleGrowth.markAction(state,growthLease,now,avatar) end
  end
  return pulled
 end

 api.releaseGravity=function(player:Player,avatar:Model,pulled:any,token:any,now:number,allowed:boolean):number
  local released=0
  local canMove=allowed and token.world==session.world and now<=token.expires and gravityCaster(player,avatar)
  for _,capture in ipairs(pulled) do
   local model=capture.model
   if gravityHeld[model]~=token then continue end
   gravityHeld[model]=nil
   local h,root=live[model],model.PrimaryPart
   if canMove and model.Parent==all and h and h.Health>0 and root and not charmedByModel[model]
    and (root.Position-capture.position).Magnitude<=.15 then
    local before=root.Position
    local after=gravityMove(model,capture.outward,avatar)
    if after and (root.Position-after).Magnitude<=.08 and (root.Position-before).Magnitude>.01 then released+=1 end
   end
  end
  return released
 end

 local function gravityRays(character:Model):RaycastParams
  local rays=RaycastParams.new()
  rays.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
  rays.FilterDescendantsInstances={character,all}
  rays.RespectCanCollide=true
  return rays
 end

 local function gravityGround(at:Vector3,rays:RaycastParams):RaycastResult?
  if not spawnFloor or not spawnFloor:IsA("BasePart") or spawnFloor.Parent~=session.world
   or not neutralWithinArena(at,spawnFloor) then return nil end
  local ground=workspace:Raycast(at+Vector3.new(0,3,0),Vector3.new(0,-8,0),rays)
  if ground and ground.Normal.Y>=.72 and ground.Instance.CanCollide
   and ground.Instance:IsDescendantOf(session.world) then return ground end
  return nil
 end

 local function gravityMove(model:Model,delta:Vector3,character:Model,straight:boolean?):Vector3?
  local root=model.PrimaryPart
  if not root or model.Parent~=all then return nil end
  local rays=gravityRays(character)
  local overlap=OverlapParams.new()
  overlap.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
  overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances=rays.FilterDescendantsInstances
  overlap.RespectCanCollide=true;overlap.MaxParts=1
  local position=root.Position
  -- Blockcast omits an initial overlap. Do not pull an already embedded body
  -- through the obstacle to reach a clear endpoint.
  if #workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(position),root.Size,overlap)>0 then return nil end
  local height=2*(root.Size.Y/2.5) -- Existing ground clearance for the neutral rig.
  local function grounded(at:Vector3):Vector3?
   local ground=gravityGround(at,rays)
   if not ground or math.abs(ground.Position.Y+height-position.Y)>1.4 then return nil end
   return Vector3.new(at.X,ground.Position.Y+height,at.Z)
  end
  local function sweep(from:Vector3,step:Vector3):RaycastResult?
   return workspace:Blockcast(CFrame.new(from),root.Size,step,rays)
  end
  local function blocked(at:Vector3):boolean
   local found=grounded(at)
   return found==nil or (found-at).Magnitude>.15
    or #workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(found),root.Size,overlap)>0
  end
  local aimed=grounded(position+delta)
  if not aimed then return nil end
  local safe
  if straight then
   if sweep(position,aimed-position) or blocked(aimed) then return nil end
   safe=aimed
  else
   safe=GravityOrb.safeStep(position,aimed-position,sweep,blocked)
  end
  if not safe then return nil end
  model:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(safe,safe+root.CFrame.LookVector))
  return safe
 end

 api.reverseTrapperNeutrals=function(player:Player,avatar:Model,center:Vector3,radius:number,duration:number,
  cap:number,current:()->boolean,ended:(boolean)->(),register:(()->())->()):boolean
  if not reversalCaster(player,avatar) or not current() then return false end
  local now=os.clock()
  local rows={}
  local rays=gravityRays(avatar)
  for model,step in pairs(lastNeutralStep) do
   local h,root=live[model],model.PrimaryPart
   if model.Parent~=all or not root or root~=step.root or not h or h.Health<=0 or charmedByModel[model]
    or gravityHeld[model] or now-step.now>.55 or (root.Position-step.to).Magnitude>.14 then continue end
   local relative=root.Position-center
   local distance=Vector3.new(relative.X,0,relative.Z).Magnitude
   if distance>radius or math.abs(relative.Y)>4.5 then continue end
   local origin=Vector3.new(center.X,root.Position.Y,center.Z)
   local delta=root.Position-origin
   if delta.Magnitude>.02 and workspace:Raycast(origin,delta,rays) then continue end
   local id=model:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_NeutralInstanceId")
   if type(id)=="string" then table.insert(rows,{model=model,root=root,from=step.to,to=step.from,distance=distance,id=id}) end
  end
  table.sort(rows,function(a,b) return a.distance==b.distance and a.id<b.id or a.distance<b.distance end)
  if #rows==0 then return false end

  local lease={reversal=true,expires=now+duration+.12}
  local claimed={}
  for index,row in ipairs(rows) do
   if index>cap then break end
   gravityHeld[row.model]=lease
   lastNeutralStep[row.model]=nil
   row.last=row.from
   table.insert(claimed,row)
  end
  local canceled=false
  local function release()
   for _,row in ipairs(claimed) do
    if gravityHeld[row.model]==lease then gravityHeld[row.model]=nil end
   end
  end
  register(function() canceled=true;release() end)
  task.spawn(function()
   local completed=false
   repeat
    task.wait(.05)
    if canceled or not current() then break end
    local at=os.clock()
    local u=math.clamp((at-now)/duration,0,1)
    if u>.9999 then u=1 end
    for _,row in ipairs(claimed) do
     local model,root=row.model,row.root
     local h=live[model]
     if gravityHeld[model]~=lease then continue end
     local moved
     if h and h.Health>0 and model.Parent==all and model.PrimaryPart==root and not charmedByModel[model]
      and (root.Position-row.last).Magnitude<=.14 then
      local target=row.from+(row.to-row.from)*u
      local delta=target-root.Position
      if delta.Magnitude<=.013 then moved=root.Position
      else moved=gravityMove(model,Vector3.new(delta.X,0,delta.Z),avatar,true) end
      if moved and (moved-target).Magnitude<=.12 then
       row.last=moved
       if u==1 and (row.last-row.from).Magnitude>=.12 then completed=true end
       continue
      end
     end
     gravityHeld[model]=nil
    end
    if u==1 then break end
   until os.clock()>=lease.expires
   release()
   if not canceled then ended(completed and current()) end
  end)
  return true
 end
