end

function Combo.presentation(ability:string)
 if ability==BLINK then return Blink.config.name,Blink.config.energy,Blink.config.cd end
 if ability==SMOKE then return Smoke.name,Smoke.energy,Smoke.cd end
 if ability==ID then
  local plan=Recipes.resolve(ROLE,BLINK,SMOKE,0)
  return plan.name,plan.proposedEnergy,plan.proposedCooldownSec
 end
 return nil
end

local function clear(record)
 local occupied=active[record.player]
 if occupied and occupied[record.ability]==record then
  occupied[record.ability]=nil
  if next(occupied)==nil then active[record.player]=nil end
 end
 for _,connection in ipairs(record.connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
 table.clear(record.connections)
 if record.effect then record.effect:Destroy();record.effect=nil end
end

local function localPart(world:Instance,name:string,position:CFrame,size:Vector3,
        color:Color3,transparency:number):Part
 local part=Instance.new("Part")
 part.Name=name
 part.Anchored=true;part.CanCollide=false;part.CanTouch=false;part.CanQuery=false
 part.CastShadow=false
 part.Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
 part.CFrame=position
 part.Size=size
 part.Color=color
 part.Transparency=transparency
 part.Parent=world
 return part
end

local function supportAt(world:Instance,character:Model,target:Vector3,exactLanding:boolean):(Vector3?,BasePart?)
 local ray=RaycastParams.new()
 ray.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
 ray.FilterDescendantsInstances={character}
 ray.RespectCanCollide=true
 local hit=workspace:Raycast(target,Vector3.new(0,if exactLanding then -4 else -6,0),ray)
 if not hit or not hit.Instance:IsA("BasePart") or not hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(world)
  or not hit.Instance.Anchored or not hit.Instance.CanCollide or hit.Normal.Y<.65
  or (exactLanding and math.abs(target.Y-hit.Position.Y-3)>.02) then return nil,nil end
 return hit.Position,hit.Instance
end

local function smokeFits(arena:BasePart,character:Model,point:Vector3,support:BasePart,radius:number):boolean
 local relative=arena.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(point)
 if math.abs(relative.X)+radius>arena.Size.X*.5 or math.abs(relative.Z)+radius>arena.Size.Z*.5 then
  return false
 end
 local overlap=OverlapParams.new()
 overlap.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
 overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances={character,support}
 overlap.RespectCanCollide=true
 overlap.MaxParts=1
 return #workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(point+Vector3.new(0,.34,0)),
  Vector3.new(radius*2,.64,radius*2),overlap)==0
end

-- Called by authorized server Tool dispatch with its own registered ability ID.
function Combo.start(session,player:Player,character:Model,root:BasePart,hum:Humanoid,ability:string):boolean
 local moves=ability==BLINK or ability==ID
 local smokes=ability==SMOKE or ability==ID
 if not moves and not smokes then return false end
 if not Combo.enabled() then return false end
 local world=session.world
 local arena=world and world:FindFirstChild("TacticalBattlefield")
 local swarm=session.swarm
 local owner=session.rules.castles[tostring(player.UserId)]
 if not arena or not arena:IsA("BasePart") or not swarm or not owner
  or type(swarm.isCurrentRoleCaster)~="function" or type(swarm.getRoleGrowthSnapshot)~="function"
  or type(swarm.tryRoleGrowthCast)~="function" then return false end
 local function current():boolean
  return workspace:GetAttribute(FLAG)~=false and player.Parent==Players
   and session.world==world and session.swarm==swarm and arena.Parent==world
   and world:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and session.rules.phase=="ACTIVE" and session.rules.winner==nil
   and session.rules.castles[tostring(player.UserId)]==owner and owner.alive==true and (owner.heldEggs or 0)==0
   and player.Character==character and root.Parent==character and hum.Parent==character and hum.Health>0
   and swarm.isCurrentRoleCaster(player,character,ROLE) and Blink.isGrounded(hum)
 end
 if not current() then return false end
 local now=os.clock()
 if active[player] and active[player][ability] then return false end
 local snapshot=swarm.getRoleGrowthSnapshot(player)
 if not snapshot or snapshot.role~=ROLE then return false end
 local stage=snapshot.stage
 local index=stage+1
 local plan=if ability==ID then Recipes.resolve(ROLE,BLINK,SMOKE,stage) else nil
 if ability==ID and (not plan or plan.id~=ID or plan.flow~="MOVE_THEN_PLACE") then return false end
 local distance=if plan then plan.limits.distance else Blink.config.metrics[1].values[index]
 local moveTell=if plan then plan.telegraphMinSec else Blink.config.metrics[2].values[index]
 local radius=if plan then plan.limits.radius else Smoke.metrics[1].values[index]
 local life=if plan then plan.limits.life else Smoke.metrics[2].values[index]
 local cd=if plan then plan.proposedCooldownSec elseif moves then Blink.config.cd else Smoke.cd
 local energy=if plan then plan.proposedEnergy elseif moves then Blink.config.energy else Smoke.energy
 local deadlines=if plan then {[ID]=cd,[BLINK]=Blink.config.cd,[SMOKE]=Smoke.cd} else {[ability]=cd}
 local origin=root.Position
 local dir,standalonePoint,standaloneSupport
 if moves then
  dir=Blink.direction(root.CFrame.LookVector,root.AssemblyLinearVelocity,hum.WalkSpeed,stage)
  if not dir then return false end
  local reached=Blink.landing(arena,character,origin,dir,distance)
  if not reached or not supportAt(world,character,reached,true) then return false end
 else
  standalonePoint,standaloneSupport=supportAt(world,character,origin,false)
  if not standalonePoint or not standaloneSupport
   or not smokeFits(arena,character,standalonePoint,standaloneSupport,radius) then return false end
 end
 castSerial+=1
 local binding={actor=tostring(player.UserId),round=tostring(session),cast=tostring(castSerial)}
 local sequence=if plan then Sequence.open(plan,binding,now+moveTell+FLOOR_TELL+1,now) else nil
 if plan and not sequence then return false end
 local accepted=swarm.tryRoleGrowthCast(player,ROLE,cd,energy,deadlines)
 if accepted==nil then return false end
 if accepted~=stage then
  if sequence then sequence.abort("STAGE_CHANGED") end
  return true
 end
 local record={player=player,ability=ability,connections={},effect=nil}
 local occupied=active[player] or {}
 occupied[ability]=record
 active[player]=occupied
 local function alive():boolean
  return active[player]==occupied and occupied[ability]==record and current()
 end
 local function advance(phase:string,ok:boolean):boolean
  local valid=true
  if sequence then
   valid=sequence.advance({binding=binding,actor=binding.actor,round=binding.round,
    cast=binding.cast,receiptId=binding.cast..":"..phase,phase=phase,success=ok},os.clock())
  end
  if not valid or not ok then clear(record);return false end
  return true
 end
 local function retire()
  if sequence then sequence.abort("RETIRED") end
  clear(record)
 end
 table.insert(record.connections,hum.Died:Connect(retire))
 table.insert(record.connections,player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(removed)
  if removed==character then retire() end
 end))
 table.insert(record.connections,player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("EGGRUMBLE_Role"):Connect(function()
  if player:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_Role")~=ROLE then retire() end
 end))
 table.insert(record.connections,Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(leaving)
  if leaving==player then retire() end
 end))
 table.insert(record.connections,world.Destroying:Connect(retire))
 table.insert(record.connections,world:GetAttributeChangedSignal("EGGRUMBLE_MatchPhase"):Connect(function()
  if session.rules.phase~="ACTIVE" or world:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_MatchPhase")~="ACTIVE" then retire() end
 end))
 table.insert(record.connections,workspace:GetAttributeChangedSignal(FLAG):Connect(function()
  if workspace:GetAttribute(FLAG)==false then retire() end
 end))
 local function place(landing:Vector3,point:Vector3,support:BasePart)
  if not smokeFits(arena,character,point,support,radius) then
   advance("PLACEMENT_VALID",false);return
  end
  record.effect=localPart(world,"P0D_NINJA_COMBO_SMOKE_TELL",CFrame.new(point+Vector3.new(0,.07,0)),
   Vector3.new(1.2,.08,1.2),Color3.fromRGB(150,132,174),.45)
  task.delay(FLOOR_TELL,function()
   if not alive() then retire();return end
   if record.effect then record.effect:Destroy();record.effect=nil end
   local checkPoint,checkSupport=supportAt(world,character,landing,moves)
   if not checkPoint or checkSupport~=support or (checkPoint-point).Magnitude>.05
    or not smokeFits(arena,character,point,support,radius) then
    advance("PLACEMENT_VALID",false);return
   end
   -- The existing TwinBiomes translucency and a local low band leave warnings visible.
   local band=localPart(world,"P0D_NINJA_COMBO_LOW_SMOKE",CFrame.new(point+Vector3.new(0,.34,0)),
    Vector3.new(radius*2,.64,radius*2),Color3.fromRGB(139,136,151),.85)
   band.Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball
   record.effect=band
   if not advance("PLACEMENT_VALID",band.Parent==world) then return end
   task.delay(life,function() clear(record) end)
  end)
 end
 if standalonePoint and standaloneSupport then
  place(origin,standalonePoint,standaloneSupport)
  return true
 end
 if not dir then retire();return true end
 local warn=origin+dir*1.45-Vector3.new(0,1.25,0)
 record.effect=localPart(world,"P0D_NINJA_COMBO_BLINK_TELL",CFrame.lookAt(warn,warn+dir),
  Vector3.new(.72,.12,2.6),Color3.fromRGB(113,84,158),.2)
 task.delay(moveTell,function()
  if not alive() then retire();return end
  if record.effect then record.effect:Destroy();record.effect=nil end
  local drift=root.Position-origin
  if drift.Magnitude>4.5 or (drift-dir*drift:Dot(dir)).Magnitude>.6 then
   advance("MOVE_VALID",false);return
  end
  local landing=Blink.landing(arena,character,root.Position,dir,distance)
  local point,support
  if landing then point,support=supportAt(world,character,landing,true) end
  if not landing or not point or not support then advance("MOVE_VALID",false);return end
  for _,other in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
   local avatar=other.Character
   local otherRoot=avatar and avatar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
   local otherHum=avatar and avatar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
   if other~=player and otherRoot and otherRoot:IsA("BasePart") and otherHum and otherHum.Health>0
    and (otherRoot.Position-landing).Magnitude<3.2 then advance("MOVE_VALID",false);return end
  end
  -- Same PRIVATE pivot and actual post-pivot pose; no invisibility or damage writes.
  character:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(landing,landing+dir))
  root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero
  root.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero
  if not advance("MOVE_VALID",(root.Position-landing).Magnitude<=.1) then return end
  if smokes then place(landing,point,support) else clear(record) end
 end)
 return true
end
return table.freeze(Combo),Blink
end)()

local LandThenAttack=(function()
-- Private combat flight owns its avatar only during a checked, finite sweep.
local LandThenAttack={}
local flying=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
local BODY=Vector3.new(2.6,4.6,2.6) -- Existing checked Ninja body volume.
local BODY_CENTER=Vector3.new(0,.3,0)
local STEP=1/24

function LandThenAttack.active(actor:Player):boolean
 return flying[actor]~=nil
end

local function footprint(world:Instance,avatar:Model)
 local rays=RaycastParams.new()
 rays.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
 rays.FilterDescendantsInstances={avatar}
 rays.RespectCanCollide=true
 local overlap=OverlapParams.new()
 overlap.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
 overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances={avatar}
 overlap.RespectCanCollide=true
 overlap.MaxParts=1
 local function floor(at:Vector3,referenceY:number):Vector3?
  local beam=Vector3.new(at.X,referenceY+2.5,at.Z)
  local hit=workspace:Raycast(beam,Vector3.new(0,-5,0),rays)
  if not hit or not hit.Instance:IsA("BasePart") or not hit.Instance.Anchored or not hit.Instance.CanCollide
   or not hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(world) or hit.Normal.Y<.65 or math.abs(hit.Position.Y-referenceY)>1.2 then return nil end
  return hit.Position
 end
 local function sweep(a:Vector3,b:Vector3):boolean
  local change=b-a
  if change.Magnitude>.001 and workspace:Blockcast(CFrame.new(a+BODY_CENTER),BODY,change,rays) then return false end
  return #workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(b+BODY_CENTER),BODY,overlap)==0
 end
 return floor,sweep,rays
end

local function cuePart(world:Instance,name:string,size:Vector3,color:Color3):Part
 local part=Instance.new("Part")
 part.Name=name
 part.Size=size
 part.Anchored=true
 part.CanCollide=false
 part.CanTouch=false
 part.CanQuery=false
 part.CastShadow=false
 part.Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
 part.Transparency=.28
 part.Color=color
 part.Parent=world
 return part
end

local function placementCue(world:Instance,position:Vector3):Part
 local cue=cuePart(world,"EGGRUMBLE_WingLandingTell",Vector3.new(.075,3.7,3.7),Color3.fromRGB(164,205,224))
 cue.Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder
 cue.Transparency=.64
 cue.CFrame=CFrame.new(position+Vector3.new(0,.06,0))*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.pi/2)
 return cue
end

function LandThenAttack.landingRing(world:Instance,position:Vector3)
 local ring=placementCue(world,position)
 ring.Name="EGGRUMBLE_WingLandingRing"
 ring.Size=Vector3.new(.075,8,8)
 task.delay(.28,function() ring:Destroy() end)
end

-- A pinned arc with bounded server-observed steering; each proposed segment is
-- checked just like the existing traversal vehicle, before the avatar can move.
function LandThenAttack.start(ctx):boolean
 local actor,avatar,root,hum=ctx.actor,ctx.avatar,ctx.root,ctx.humanoid
 local world,arena=ctx.world,ctx.arena
 if flying[actor] or root.Anchored or not ctx.current() or not ctx.grounded(hum)
  or not ctx.inside(arena,root.Position) then return false end
 local base=root.Position
 local look=root.CFrame.LookVector
 local forward=Vector3.new(look.X,0,look.Z)
 if forward.Magnitude<.01 then return false end
 forward=forward.Unit
 local floor,sweep,rays=footprint(world,avatar)
 local start=workspace:Raycast(base,Vector3.new(0,-6,0),rays)
 if not start or not start.Instance:IsDescendantOf(world) then return false end
 local startGround=floor(base,start.Position.Y)
 if not startGround then return false end
 local rootHeight=base.Y-startGround.Y
 if rootHeight<2.3 or rootHeight>5.5 then return false end
 local function waypoint(xz:Vector3,u:number):(Vector3?,Vector3?)
  if not ctx.inside(arena,xz) then return nil,nil end
  local ground=floor(xz,startGround.Y)
  if not ground then return nil,nil end
  local y=math.min(base.Y+ctx.height,ground.Y+rootHeight+ctx.height*math.sin(math.pi*u))
  return Vector3.new(ground.X,y,ground.Z),ground
 end
 -- Avoid charging into a known wall/ceiling/illegal destination. The same
 -- checks run on every actual segment, including inputs after the warning.
 local previous=base
 local nominalLanding
 for index=1,8 do
  local u=index/8
  local at,under=waypoint(base+forward*(ctx.distance*u),u)
  if not at or not sweep(previous,at) then return false end
  previous,nominalLanding=at,under
 end
 local stage=ctx.authorize()
 if stage==nil then return false end
 local record={root=root}
 flying[actor]=record
 root.Anchored=true
 root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero
 root.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero
 local builder=ctx.flightSkin=="BUILDER"
 local warrior=ctx.flightSkin=="WARRIOR"
 local wingColor=if builder then Color3.fromRGB(228,194,112)
  elseif warrior then Color3.fromRGB(240,204,118) else Color3.fromRGB(159,186,218)
 local wingSize=if builder then Vector3.new(1.6,.24,1.65) else Vector3.new(1.48,.14,.67)
 local wings={cuePart(world,if builder then "EGGRUMBLE_BuilderThrusterLeft" elseif warrior then "EGGRUMBLE_WarriorWingLeft" else "EGGRUMBLE_WingLeft",wingSize,wingColor),
              cuePart(world,if builder then "EGGRUMBLE_BuilderThrusterRight" elseif warrior then "EGGRUMBLE_WarriorWingRight" else "EGGRUMBLE_WingRight",wingSize,wingColor)}
 local mark=placementCue(world,nominalLanding)
 local function moveWings()
  for i,wing in ipairs(wings) do
   local side=2*i-3
   local frame=if builder then CFrame.new(side*.85,-2.20,0) else CFrame.new(side*1.11,.75,.62)
   wing.CFrame=root.CFrame*frame*CFrame.Angles(0,side*.22,side*.27)
  end
 end
 moveWings()
 local function release()
  if flying[actor]~=record then return end
  flying[actor]=nil
  root.Anchored=false
  for _,wing in ipairs(wings) do wing:Destroy() end
  mark:Destroy()
 end
 local started=os.clock()
 local usedFlight=false
 task.spawn(function()
  local last,track,xz=base,forward,base
  local lastU=0
  while lastU<1 do
   task.wait(STEP)
   if not ctx.current() or not root.Anchored or (root.Position-last).Magnitude>.6 then
    release();ctx.abort();return
   end
   local input=hum.MoveDirection
   if input then
    local lateral=Vector3.new(input.X,0,input.Z)
    if lateral.Magnitude>.1 then
     local candidate=lateral.Unit
     if candidate:Dot(forward)>=.5 then track=candidate end
    end
   end
   local u=math.clamp((os.clock()-started)/ctx.duration,0,1)
   if 1-u<.00001 then u=1 end
   local traveled=ctx.distance*(u-lastU)
   -- A stalled frame must not skip the apex and cross an unchecked ceiling.
   if u-lastU>.35 then release();ctx.abort();return end
   xz+=track*traveled
   local aim,under=waypoint(xz,u)
   if not aim or not under or not sweep(last,aim) then release();ctx.abort();return end
   avatar:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(aim,aim+track))
   if (root.Position-aim).Magnitude>.08 then release();ctx.abort();return end
   if not usedFlight then
    usedFlight=ctx.trace("FLIGHT_VALID",true)
    if not usedFlight then release();ctx.abort();return end
   end
   moveWings()
   local projected=xz+track*(ctx.distance*(1-u))
   local _,atFoot=waypoint(projected,1)
   if atFoot then mark.CFrame=CFrame.new(atFoot+Vector3.new(0,.06,0))*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.pi/2) end
   last,lastU=aim,u
  end
  -- Geometry has already moved the actual avatar to the checked floor.
  -- Permit physics to ground it before attack and reject movement to another tile.
  root.Anchored=false
  root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero
  root.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero
  task.wait(STEP)
  local settled=floor(root.Position,startGround.Y)
  local stable=ctx.current() and not root.Anchored and settled and ctx.grounded(hum)
   and (root.Position-last).Magnitude<=.35 and math.abs(root.Position.Y-settled.Y-rootHeight)<=.35
  release()
  if not stable or not ctx.trace("LAND_VALID",true) then ctx.abort();return end
  ctx.onLand(settled,stage)
 end)
 return true
end

return table.freeze(LandThenAttack)
end)()
local WING_ID="MAGE-040"
local SPEAR_ID="MAGE-012"
local LAND_ID="COMBO-005"
local WING_FLAG="P0D_ENABLE_PRIVATE_MAGE_COMBO_005"

end

local function wingSlot(session:any,p:Player,role:string,slot:string):string?
 if role~="MAGE" or not HeroCombat.mageWingEnabled()
  or not session.mageProjectiles or session.mageProjectiles[p.UserId]~=WING_ID then return nil end
 if slot=="A" then return SPEAR_ID end
 if slot=="C" then return WING_ID end
 if slot=="D" then return LAND_ID end
 return nil
end

local function wingPresentation(id:string?)
 if id==WING_ID then return WingCatalog.name,WingCatalog.energy,WingCatalog.cd end
 if id==SPEAR_ID then
  local plan=MageProjectiles.plan(SPEAR_ID,0)
  return plan.name,plan.energy,plan.cooldown
 end
 if id==LAND_ID then
  local plan=ComboRecipes.resolve("MAGE",SPEAR_ID,WING_ID,0)
  return plan.name,plan.proposedEnergy,plan.proposedCooldownSec
 end
 return nil
end

local function wingCast(session:any,p:Player,avatar:Model,root:BasePart,h:Humanoid,owner:any,id:string):boolean
 local swarm,world=session.swarm,session.world
 local arena=world and world:FindFirstChild("TacticalBattlefield")
 if not arena or not arena:IsA("BasePart") or not swarm or type(swarm.isCurrentRoleCaster)~="function" then return false end
 local function current():boolean
  return wingSlot(session,p,"MAGE","C")==WING_ID and session.rules.phase=="ACTIVE" and session.rules.winner==nil
   and session.world==world and world:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and arena.Parent==world and session.swarm==swarm
   and session.rules.castles[tostring(p.UserId)]==owner and owner.alive==true and (owner.heldEggs or 0)==0
   and p.Character==avatar and root.Parent==avatar and h.Parent==avatar and h.Health>0
   and h.SeatPart==nil and not h.Sit and not h.PlatformStand and swarm.isCurrentRoleCaster(p,avatar,"MAGE")
 end
 if not current() then return false end
 local spearDamage=CombatBalance.skill("MAGE","A").damage
 if id==SPEAR_ID then return launchMageProjectile(session,p,avatar,root,h,owner,id,spearDamage,nil,current) end
 local growth=swarm.getRoleGrowthSnapshot(p)
 if not growth or growth.role~="MAGE" then return false end
 local stage=growth.stage
 local plan=if id==LAND_ID then ComboRecipes.resolve("MAGE",SPEAR_ID,WING_ID,stage) else nil
 if id==LAND_ID and (not plan or plan.flow~="LAND_THEN_ATTACK") then return false end
 local duration=WingCatalog.metrics[1].values[stage+1]
 local height=WingCatalog.metrics[2].values[stage+1]
 local spear=MageProjectiles.plan(SPEAR_ID,stage)

 local cooldown=if plan then plan.proposedCooldownSec else WingCatalog.cd

 })

local WarriorFire=(function()
 local ROLE,IGNITE,RING,COMBO="WARRIOR","WARRIOR-071","WARRIOR-016","COMBO-002"
 local FLAG="P0D_ENABLE_PRIVATE_WARRIOR_COMBO_002"
 local slots=table.freeze({B=IGNITE,C=RING,D=COMBO})
 local pending=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
 local M={}

 function M.enabled():boolean return workspace:GetAttribute(FLAG)~=false end

 function M.slot(session:any,p:Player,role:string,slot:string):string?
  if role==ROLE and M.enabled() and session.warriorLoadouts and session.warriorLoadouts[p.UserId] then
   return slots[slot]
  end
  return nil
 end

 local function plan(id:string,stage:number):any
  if type(stage)~="number" or stage~=math.floor(stage) or stage<0 or stage>4 then return nil end
  local index=stage+1
  if id==COMBO then
   local contract=ComboRecipes.resolve(ROLE,IGNITE,RING,stage)
   if not contract or contract.id~=COMBO or contract.flow~="ATTACK_UNIFIED" or contract.hold then return nil end
   return {name=contract.name,cd=contract.proposedCooldownSec,energy=contract.proposedEnergy,tell=contract.telegraphMinSec,
    reach=contract.limits.radius,maxTargets=contract.limits.neutralMax,burn=contract.limits.burnSec,contract=contract,
    deadlines={[IGNITE]=WarriorRows[IGNITE].cd,[RING]=WarriorRows[RING].cd,[COMBO]=contract.proposedCooldownSec}}
  end
  local row=WarriorRows[id]
  if not row then return nil end
  return {name=row.name,cd=row.cd,energy=row.energy,tell=if id==IGNITE then .18 else 0,
   reach=row.metrics[1].values[index],maxTargets=if id==RING then row.metrics[2].values[index] else 1,
   burn=if id==IGNITE then row.metrics[2].values[index] else nil,deadlines={[id]=row.cd}}
 end

 function M.presentation(id:string?):any if id then return plan(id,0) end;return nil end

 local function blades(world:Instance,id:string,origin:Vector3,direction:Vector3,reach:number,lifetime:number,warning:boolean):Folder
  local folder=Instance.new("Folder")
  folder.Name=if warning then "EGGRUMBLE_WarriorFireTell" else "EGGRUMBLE_WarriorFireCut"
  local isLine=id==IGNITE
  local count=if isLine then 3 else 8
  for i=1,count do
   local radial=if isLine then direction else Vector3.new(math.cos(i*math.pi*.25),0,math.sin(i*math.pi*.25))
   local at=origin+radial*(reach*(if isLine then i/3 else 1))+Vector3.new(0,-1.15,0)
   local blade=Instance.new("WedgePart")
   blade.Name="HeatCeramicBlade";blade.Anchored=true;blade.CanCollide=false;blade.CanTouch=false
   blade.CanQuery=false;blade.CastShadow=false;blade.Massless=true
   blade.Material=Enum.Material.Metal
   blade.Color=if warning then Color3.fromRGB(214,139,76) else Color3.fromRGB(188,74,46)
   blade.Transparency=if warning then .31 else .13
   blade.Size=Vector3.new(if isLine then .47 else reach*.31,.17,if warning then .28 else .48)
   blade.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(at,at+(if isLine then radial else Vector3.new(-radial.Z,0,radial.X)))
   blade.Parent=folder
  end
  folder.Parent=world
  Debris:AddItem(folder,lifetime)
  return folder
 end

 function M.cancel(p:Player)
  local work=pending[p]
  if not work then return end
  pending[p]=nil
  if work.timeline then work.timeline.abort("CANCELLED") end
  if work.cue.Parent then work.cue:Destroy() end
 end

 function M.start(session:any,p:Player,char:Model,root:BasePart,h:Humanoid,id:string,slot:string,serial:number):boolean
  local swarm=session.swarm
  local world=session.world
  local owner=session.rules.castles[tostring(p.UserId)]
  if not swarm or type(swarm.damageWarriorNeutral)~="function" or pending[p] then return false end
  local function current():boolean
   return M.slot(session,p,ROLE,slot)==id and currentHumanMember(session,p)
    and session.rules.phase=="ACTIVE" and session.rules.winner==nil and world~=nil and session.world==world and world.Parent~=nil
    and session.rules.castles[tostring(p.UserId)]==owner and owner~=nil and owner.alive
    and p.Character==char and root.Parent==char and h.Parent==char and h.Health>0 and h.SeatPart==nil
    and swarm.isCurrentRoleCaster(p,char,ROLE)
  end
  if not current() then return false end
  local stage=swarm.getRoleGrowthSnapshot(p)
  local choice=stage and plan(id,stage.stage)
  if not choice then return false end
  local look=root.CFrame.LookVector
  local heading=Vector3.new(look.X,0,look.Z)
  if heading.Magnitude<.001 then return false end
  heading=heading.Unit
  local origin=root.Position+Vector3.new(0,1,0)
  local began=os.clock()
  local binding={round=tostring(session),actor=tostring(p.UserId),cast=tostring(serial)}
  local timeline=if choice.contract then ComboSequence.open(choice.contract,binding,began+choice.tell+.65,began) else nil
  if choice.contract and not timeline then return false end
  if swarm.tryRoleGrowthCast(p,ROLE,choice.cd,choice.energy,choice.deadlines)~=stage.stage then return false end

  local function impact()
   local now=os.clock()
   if not current() or (root.Position+Vector3.new(0,1,0)-origin).Magnitude>3
    or now<began+choice.tell or (timeline and not timeline.expire(now)) then
    if timeline then timeline.abort("STALE_OR_MOVED") end
    return
   end
   local hits,registered=0,false
   local rows=swarm.projectileCandidates(origin,choice.reach)
   table.sort(rows,function(a,b)
    local first,second=(a.center-origin).Magnitude,(b.center-origin).Magnitude
    if first~=second then return first<second end
    return (tonumber(a.id) or math.huge)<(tonumber(b.id) or math.huge)
   end)
   local center=if id==IGNITE then origin+heading*choice.reach else origin
   -- One existing neutral HP budget per target. The compound never invokes the
   -- two component attacks independently. Its first eligible burn is the only one.
   local amount=CombatBalance.skill(ROLE,"A").damage
   for _,row in ipairs(rows) do
    if hits>=choice.maxTargets then break end
    if (row.center-origin).Magnitude<=choice.reach and AttackGeometry.allowed(origin,center,row.center,
        choice.reach,if id==IGNITE then "BLADE" else "CIRCLE") then
     local connected,lit=swarm.damageWarriorNeutral(p,char,row.token,origin,amount,
      if not registered then choice.burn else nil)
     if connected then hits+=1 end
     registered=registered or lit
    end
   end
   if timeline then
    local function receipt(phase:string,success:boolean)
     return timeline.advance({actor=binding.actor,round=binding.round,cast=binding.cast,binding=binding,
      phase=phase,receiptId=binding.cast..":"..phase,success=success},now)
    end
    if receipt("ATTACK_VALID",hits>0) and hits>0 then receipt("STATUS_VALID",registered) end
   end
   blades(world,id,origin,heading,choice.reach,.23,false)
   if hits>0 then ImpactFeedback.attacker(p,ROLE,slot,hits) end
  end

  if choice.tell==0 then impact();return true end
  local work={cue=blades(world,id,origin,heading,choice.reach,choice.tell+.1,true),timeline=timeline}
  pending[p]=work
  task.delay(choice.tell,function()
   if pending[p]~=work then return end
   pending[p]=nil
   if work.cue.Parent then work.cue:Destroy() end
   impact()
  end)
  return true
 end
 return M
end)()

local BuilderPrivateCannon=(function()
-- ACTIVE 0159bb3 supplies placement, timings, direction split and hit budget.
-- This adapter leaves PRIVATE Swarm as the only neutral HP and KO authority.
local BuilderPrivateCannon={}
local VOLUME=Vector3.new(4,5,4)
local DAMAGE=14
local MAX_Y=5

local function findPlacement(ctx,launch:Vector3,facing:Vector3)
 local ray=RaycastParams.new()
 ray.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
 ray.FilterDescendantsInstances={ctx.avatar,ctx.world:FindFirstChild("NeutralHorde")}
 ray.RespectCanCollide=true
 local forward=launch+facing*9
 if not ctx.inside(ctx.arena,forward) then return nil end
 local ground=workspace:Raycast(forward+Vector3.new(0,4,0),Vector3.new(0,-13,0),ray)
 if not ground or ground.Normal.Y<.65 or not ground.Instance:IsA("BasePart")
  or not ground.Instance.Anchored or not ground.Instance.CanCollide
  or ground.Instance.Parent~=ctx.world
  or (ground.Instance~=ctx.arena and not ground.Instance.Name:match("^TacticalRoute_"))
  or math.abs(ground.Position.Y-(launch.Y-3))>3.5 then return nil end
 local center=ground.Position+Vector3.new(0,2.55,0)
 if workspace:Raycast(launch,center-launch,ray) then return nil end
 local frame=CFrame.lookAt(center,center+facing)
 local overlap=OverlapParams.new()
 overlap.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
 overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances=ray.FilterDescendantsInstances
 overlap.RespectCanCollide=true
 overlap.MaxParts=1
 if #workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(frame,VOLUME,overlap)>0 then return nil end
 return frame,ground.Instance,ray
end

local function createRig(world:Instance,frame:CFrame,stage:number):BasePart
 local rig=Instance.new("Part")
 rig.Name="EGGRUMBLE_BuilderTwinCannon"
 rig.Size=VOLUME
 rig.Anchored=true
 rig.CanCollide=false
 rig.CanTouch=false
 rig.CanQuery=false
 rig.CastShadow=false
 rig.Material=Enum.Material.Slate
 rig.Color=Color3.fromRGB(228,194,112)
 rig.CFrame=frame
 rig:SetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_BuilderCannonStage",stage)
 rig.Parent=world
 return rig
end

local function beam(rig:BasePart,startAt:Vector3,stopAt:Vector3)
 local start=Instance.new("Attachment")
 local stop=Instance.new("Attachment")
 start.Position=rig.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(startAt);start.Parent=rig
 stop.Position=rig.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(stopAt);stop.Parent=rig
 local warning=Instance.new("Beam")
 warning.Attachment0=start
 warning.Attachment1=stop
 warning.Color=ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(246,174,76))
 warning.Transparency=NumberSequence.new(.55)
 warning.Width0=.14
 warning.Width1=.08
 warning.FaceCamera=true
 warning.Parent=rig
 return function() warning:Destroy();stop:Destroy();start:Destroy() end
end

function BuilderPrivateCannon.begin(ctx):boolean
 if not ctx.current() or not ctx.grounded(ctx.humanoid) then return false end
 local origin=ctx.root.Position
 local aim=ctx.root.CFrame.LookVector
 local facing=Vector3.new(aim.X,0,aim.Z)
 if facing.Magnitude<.01 then return false end
 facing=facing.Unit
 local frame,support,rays=findPlacement(ctx,origin,facing)
 if not frame or not support or not rays then return false end
 local stage=ctx.authorize()
 if stage==nil then return false end
 local range=CannonConfig.range[stage+1]
 local budget=CannonConfig.targets[stage+1]
 local used=0
 local seen={}
 local rig=createRig(ctx.world,frame,stage)
 local connections={}
 local retired=false
 local function retire()
  if retired then return end
  retired=true
  for _,connection in ipairs(connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
  rig:Destroy()
 end
 table.insert(connections,ctx.world.Destroying:Connect(retire))
 table.insert(connections,ctx.world:GetAttributeChangedSignal("EGGRUMBLE_MatchPhase"):Connect(function()
  if ctx.world:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_MatchPhase")~="ACTIVE" then retire() end
 end))
 table.insert(connections,ctx.humanoid.Died:Connect(retire))
 table.insert(connections,workspace:GetAttributeChangedSignal(ctx.flag):Connect(function()
  if workspace:GetAttribute(ctx.flag)==false then retire() end
 end))
 local muzzle=frame.Position+Vector3.new(0,1.1,0)
 local started=os.clock()
 local function clear(a:Vector3,b:Vector3):boolean
  return (b-a).Magnitude<=.001 or workspace:Raycast(a,b-a,rays)==nil
 end
 for index,direction in ipairs(CannonConfig.directions(facing)) do
  local delta=direction*range
  local obstacle=workspace:Raycast(muzzle,delta,rays)
  if obstacle then delta=obstacle.Position-muzzle end
  local endWarning=beam(rig,muzzle,muzzle+delta)
  task.delay(CannonConfig.shotTimes[index],function()
   if retired or rig.Parent~=ctx.world then return end
   endWarning()
   if os.clock()>=started+CannonConfig.lifetime or not ctx.current() or not ctx.grounded(ctx.humanoid)
    or (ctx.root.Position-origin).Magnitude>28 then retire();return end
   local currentFrame,currentSupport=findPlacement(ctx,origin,facing)
   if not currentFrame or currentSupport~=support or (currentFrame.Position-frame.Position).Magnitude>.05 then
    retire();return
   end
   local slots=math.min(budget-used,if index==1 then math.ceil(budget/2) else budget-used)
   if slots<=0 then return end
   local available={}
   local fromCaster=ctx.root.Position+Vector3.new(0,1,0)
   for _,target in ipairs(ctx.swarm.projectileCandidates(muzzle,range)) do
    local offset=target.center-muzzle
    local horizontal=Vector3.new(offset.X,0,offset.Z)
    local distance=offset.Magnitude
    if not seen[target.token] and horizontal.Magnitude>.001 and distance<=range
     and math.abs(offset.Y)<=MAX_Y and direction:Dot(horizontal.Unit)>=CannonConfig.aimDot
     and clear(muzzle,target.center) and clear(fromCaster,target.center) then
     table.insert(available,{target=target,distance=distance})
    end
   end
   table.sort(available,function(a,b)
    if a.distance==b.distance then return a.target.id<b.target.id end
    return a.distance<b.distance
   end)
   local hits=0
   for _,row in ipairs(available) do
    local target=row.target
    if ctx.swarm.damageFromPlayer(ctx.player,target.center,.02,DAMAGE,"CIRCLE",nil,target.token,muzzle)>0 then
     used+=1;hits+=1
     seen[target.token]=true
     if hits>=slots then break end
    end
   end
   if hits>0 then ctx.feedback(hits) end
  end)
 end
 task.delay(CannonConfig.lifetime,retire)
 return true
end

return table.freeze(BuilderPrivateCannon)
end)()

local TrapperGravity=(function()

local function orbVisual(world:Instance,center:Vector3,radius:number,stage:number,lifetime:number):Model
    local group=Instance.new("Model")
    group.Name="P0D_TRAPPER_GRAVITY_ORB"
    local function inert(part:BasePart,at:CFrame,size:Vector3,color:Color3,material:Enum.Material)
        part.Size=size
        part.CFrame=at
        part.Color=color
        part.Material=material
        part.Anchored=true
        part.CanCollide=false
        part.CanTouch=false
        part.CanQuery=false
        part.CastShadow=false
        part.Parent=group
    end
    local ring=Instance.new("Part")
    ring.Name="GravityRadiusTell"
    ring.Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder
    ring.Transparency=.78
    inert(ring,CFrame.new(center-Vector3.new(0,1.72,0))*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.pi*.5),
        Vector3.new(.10,radius*2,radius*2),Color3.fromRGB(106,119,177),Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
    for side=-1,1,2 do
        local facet=Instance.new("WedgePart")
        facet.Name="DarkOreFacet"
        inert(facet,CFrame.new(center+Vector3.new(side*.22,0,0))*CFrame.Angles(0,math.pi*(side+1)*.5,0),
            Vector3.new(.62,.84,.74),Color3.fromRGB(43,46,66),Enum.Material.Slate)
    end
    for i=1,stage+1 do
        local yaw=(i-1)*2*math.pi/(stage+1)
        local shard=Instance.new("WedgePart")
        shard.Name="SilverOrbitalShard"
        local offset=Vector3.new(math.cos(yaw)*.92,.18+math.sin(yaw)*.14,math.sin(yaw)*.92)
        inert(shard,CFrame.new(center+offset)*CFrame.Angles(.30,yaw,.22),
            Vector3.new(.23,.48,.30),Color3.fromRGB(155,169,196),Enum.Material.Metal)
    end
    group.Parent=world
    game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(group,lifetime)
    return group
end

 function M.cancel(p:Player)
  local work=pending[p]
  if not work then return end
  pending[p]=nil
  if work.pulled then work.swarm.releaseGravity(p,work.avatar,work.pulled,work.token,os.clock(),false) end
  if work.cue.Parent then work.cue:Destroy() end
 end

 function M.start(session:any,p:Player,char:Model,root:BasePart,h:Humanoid,owner:any):boolean
  local swarm=session.swarm
  local world=session.world
  if pending[p] or not swarm or type(swarm.gravityPlan)~="function" then return false end
  local function current():boolean
   return M.slot(session,p,"TRAPPER","B")==ID and currentHumanMember(session,p)
    and session.rules.phase=="ACTIVE" and session.rules.winner==nil and session.world==world and world.Parent~=nil
    and session.rules.castles[tostring(p.UserId)]==owner and owner.alive and (owner.heldEggs or 0)==0
    and p.Character==char and root.Parent==char and h.Parent==char and h.Health>0 and h.SeatPart==nil
    and swarm.isCurrentRoleCaster(p,char,"TRAPPER")
  end
  if not world or not current() then return false end
  local plan=swarm.gravityPlan(p,char)
  if not plan then return false end
  local initial=root.Position
  local look=root.CFrame.LookVector
  local flat=Vector3.new(look.X,0,look.Z)
  if flat.Magnitude<.001 then return false end
  local at=initial+flat.Unit*plan.placement
  local center=swarm.gravityCenter(p,char,initial,at)
  if not center or swarm.tryRoleGrowthCast(p,"TRAPPER",plan.cooldown,plan.energy,{[ID]=plan.cooldown})~=plan.stage then
   return false
  end
  local cue=orbVisual(world,center,plan.range,plan.stage,plan.tell+plan.release+.10)
  local work={cue=cue,swarm=swarm,avatar=char,pulled=nil,token=nil}
  pending[p]=work
  task.delay(plan.tell,function()
   if pending[p]~=work then return end
   local fresh=if current() and (root.Position-initial).Magnitude<=6 then swarm.gravityCenter(p,char,root.Position,at) else nil
   if not fresh or (fresh-center).Magnitude>.15 then M.cancel(p);return end
   local now=os.clock()
   local token={world=world,expires=now+plan.release+.15}
   work.token=token
   work.pulled=swarm.pullGravity(p,char,center,plan.stage,now,token)
   if #work.pulled==0 then pending[p]=nil;return end
   task.delay(plan.release,function()
    if pending[p]~=work then return end
    pending[p]=nil
    swarm.releaseGravity(p,char,work.pulled,token,os.clock(),current() and (root.Position-initial).Magnitude<=6)
   end)
  end)
  return true
 end
 return M
end)()

local function fanVisual(world:Instance,point:Vector3,direction:Vector3,reach:number,stage:number,warning:boolean):Folder
 local visual=Instance.new("Folder")
 visual.Name=if warning then "EGGRUMBLE_WarriorSkyFanTell" else "EGGRUMBLE_WarriorSkyRainCut"
 local count=if stage==0 then 3 else 5
 local lateral=Vector3.new(-direction.Z,0,direction.X)
 for index=1,count do
  local angle=((index-1)/(count-1)*2-1)*HALF_FAN
  local ray=direction*math.cos(angle)+lateral*math.sin(angle)
  local plank=Instance.new("WedgePart")
  plank.Name="SkyFanBlade"
  plank.Anchored=true;plank.CanCollide=false;plank.CanTouch=false;plank.CanQuery=false;plank.CastShadow=false
  plank.Material=Enum.Material.Metal
  plank.Color=if warning then Color3.fromRGB(229,193,115) else Color3.fromRGB(240,219,170)
  plank.Transparency=if warning then .34 else .15
  plank.Size=if warning then Vector3.new(.13,.065,reach) else Vector3.new(.23,1.05,.7)
  local center=point+Vector3.new(0,if warning then .07 else .60,0)+ray*(reach*(if warning then .5 else .8))
  plank.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(center,center+ray)
  plank.Parent=visual
 end
 visual.Parent=world
 return visual
end

function M.cancel(p:Player)

 pending[p]=nil
 for _,connection in ipairs(work.connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
 if work.timeline then work.timeline.abort("RETIRED") end
 work.visual:Destroy()
end

local function floorAt(world:Instance,avatar:Model,root:BasePart):Vector3?
 local params=RaycastParams.new()
 params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
 params.FilterDescendantsInstances={avatar}
 params.RespectCanCollide=true
 local under=workspace:Raycast(root.Position,Vector3.new(0,-6,0),params)
 if not under or not under.Instance:IsA("BasePart") or not under.Instance.Anchored
  or under.Instance.Parent~=world or under.Normal.Y<.65
  or (under.Instance.Name~="TacticalBattlefield" and not under.Instance.Name:match("^TacticalRoute_")) then return nil end
 return under.Position
end

local function fanDamage(swarm,p,origin:Vector3,heading:Vector3,reach:number,maxTargets:number,amount:number):number
 local rows=swarm.projectileCandidates(origin,reach)
 table.sort(rows,function(left,right)
  local a,b=(left.center-origin).Magnitude,(right.center-origin).Magnitude
  if a==b then return left.id<right.id end
  return a<b
 end)
 local hits=0
 for _,row in ipairs(rows) do
  local delta=row.center-origin
  local lateral=Vector3.new(delta.X,0,delta.Z)
  if lateral.Magnitude>.001 and math.abs(delta.Y)<=4 and heading:Dot(lateral.Unit)>=FAN_DOT
   and AttackGeometry.allowed(origin,origin,row.center,reach,"CIRCLE") then
   if swarm.damageFromPlayer(p,row.center,.02,amount,"CIRCLE",nil,row.token,origin)>0 then
    hits+=1
    if hits>=maxTargets then break end
   end
  end
 end
 return hits
end

 end

 local sample=swarm.getRoleGrowthSnapshot(p)

 local stage=sample.stage

 local plan=if ability==SKY_COMBO then ComboRecipes.resolve(SKY_ROLE,SKY_FLIGHT,SKY_RAIN,stage) else nil

 local binding={actor=tostring(p.UserId),round=tostring(session),cast=tostring((castSequence[p.UserId] or 0)+1)}

  end,

  trace=trace,
  onLand=function(point:Vector3, _acceptedStage:number)
   local dir=heading()
   if not dir or not current() then return end
   if plan then startRain(point,dir);return end
   local spec=CoreAction.SPECS.WARRIOR.basic

return M

local GravityOrb=(function()

local Orb = {}

function Orb.motion(at: Vector3, center: Vector3): (Vector3?, Vector3?)
    local radial = Vector3.new(at.X - center.X, 0, at.Z - center.Z)
    local gap = radial.Magnitude
    if gap <= 1.1 then return nil, nil end
    local outward = radial.Unit
    local tangent = Vector3.new(-outward.Z, 0, outward.X)
    local pull = math.min(3.25, gap - 1.1)
    return -outward * pull + tangent * math.min(.3, pull * .12), outward * 1.75
end

-- #796's continuous body sweep with a tangential retry and final overlap check.
-- This variant receives the existing neutral's body dimensions and world filters.
function Orb.safeStep(at: Vector3, step: Vector3, sweep: (Vector3, Vector3) -> RaycastResult?,
        blockedAt: (Vector3) -> boolean): Vector3?
    if step.Magnitude <= .01 then return nil end
    local hit = sweep(at, step)
    if hit then
        local outward = Vector3.new(hit.Normal.X, 0, hit.Normal.Z)
        if outward.Magnitude < .5 then return nil end
        outward = outward.Unit
        step -= outward * step:Dot(outward)
        if step.Magnitude <= .01 or sweep(at, step) then return nil end
    end
    local last = at + step
    if blockedAt(last) then return nil end
    return last
end

return table.freeze(Orb)
end)()

local ENERGY_PER_ACTIVE_SECOND = 4
local ACTION_ACTIVITY_SECONDS = 2
local MAX_SAMPLE_GAP = 1.5

type State = {
    round: {},
    activeSeconds: number,
    firstS4Activity: number?,
    energy: number,
    castReadyAt: number,
    componentReadyAt: {[string]:number}?,
    role: string?,

local function finite(number: any): boolean
    return type(number) == "number" and number == number and math.abs(number) < math.huge
end

function Growth.new(round: {}): State
    return {round=round,activeSeconds=0,energy=ENERGY_CAP,castReadyAt=-math.huge}
end

function Growth.pause(state: State)
    state.character=nil
    state.sampledAt=nil
    state.position=nil
    state.actionAt=nil
end

function Growth.hasCurrentSample(state: State, now: number, character: Model?): boolean
    local sampledAt=state.sampledAt
    return character~=nil and state.character==character and finite(now)
        and sampledAt~=nil and now>=sampledAt and now-sampledAt<=MAX_SAMPLE_GAP
end

-- Call only after the current Game has accepted a real objective or damage result.
function Growth.markAction(state: State, round: {}, now: number, character: Model?)
    if state.round==round and Growth.hasCurrentSample(state,now,character) then
        state.actionAt=math.max(now,state.actionAt or now)
    end
end

function Growth.sample(state: State, round: {}, now: number, character: Model?,
        position: Vector3?, walkSpeed: number)
    if state.round~=round then return end
    if character==nil or position==nil or not finite(now) or not finite(walkSpeed)
        or not finite(position.X) or not finite(position.Y) or not finite(position.Z) then
        Growth.pause(state)
        return
    end
    local previousAt, previous = state.sampledAt, state.position
    if state.character==character and previousAt~=nil and now<=previousAt then return end
    local sameCharacter=state.character==character
    if not sameCharacter then state.actionAt=nil end
    state.character=character
    state.sampledAt=now
    state.position=position
    if not sameCharacter or previousAt==nil or previous==nil then return end

    local dt=now-previousAt
    if dt>MAX_SAMPLE_GAP then
        state.actionAt=nil
        return

    local dx,dz=position.X-previous.X,position.Z-previous.Z
    local displacement=math.sqrt(dx*dx+dz*dz)

        qualified=math.max(qualified,actionSeconds)
    end
    if qualified<=0 then return end

    state.activeSeconds+=qualified
    state.energy=math.min(ENERGY_CAP,state.energy+qualified*ENERGY_PER_ACTIVE_SECOND)

local GravityOrb=(function()
--!strict
-- TRAPPER-015 target and motion limits. The existing Horde owns mob positions.
local Orb = {}

Orb.radius = table.freeze({5, 6, 7, 8, 9})
Orb.targets = table.freeze({2, 3, 4, 5, 6})
Orb.cooldown = 24
Orb.energy = 40
Orb.tellSeconds = .30
Orb.releaseSeconds = .32
Orb.placement = 5.5

function Orb.motion(at: Vector3, center: Vector3): (Vector3?, Vector3?)
    local radial = Vector3.new(at.X - center.X, 0, at.Z - center.Z)
    local gap = radial.Magnitude
    if gap <= 1.1 then return nil, nil end
    local outward = radial.Unit
    local tangent = Vector3.new(-outward.Z, 0, outward.X)
    local pull = math.min(3.25, gap - 1.1)
    return -outward * pull + tangent * math.min(.3, pull * .12), outward * 1.75
end

-- #796's continuous body sweep with a tangential retry and final overlap check.
-- This variant receives the existing neutral's body dimensions and world filters.
function Orb.safeStep(at: Vector3, step: Vector3, sweep: (Vector3, Vector3) -> RaycastResult?,
        blockedAt: (Vector3) -> boolean): Vector3?
    if step.Magnitude <= .01 then return nil end
    local hit = sweep(at, step)
    if hit then
        local outward = Vector3.new(hit.Normal.X, 0, hit.Normal.Z)
        if outward.Magnitude < .5 then return nil end
        outward = outward.Unit
        step -= outward * step:Dot(outward)
        if step.Magnitude <= .01 or sweep(at, step) then return nil end
    end
    local last = at + step
    if blockedAt(last) then return nil end
    return last
end

return table.freeze(Orb)
end)()

 local function closeWandTest(pose:CFrame?,center:Vector3,radius:number):((Vector3)->boolean)?
  if not pose or radius~=5 then return nil end
  local look=pose.LookVector
  local length=math.sqrt(look.X*look.X+look.Z*look.Z)
  if length<.01 then return nil end
  local ux,uz=look.X/length,look.Z/length
  local start=pose.Position
  -- At this point a level radius-five circle already covers the full two-stud half-width.
  -- The existing neutral-only weapon pickup adds at most 3.5 to the wand's 11-stud reach.
  local limit=math.min((center-start).Magnitude,14.5)-math.sqrt(21)
  return function(target:Vector3):boolean
   if math.abs(target.Y-start.Y)>5 then return false end
   local x,z=target.X-start.X,target.Z-start.Z
   local forward=x*ux+z*uz
   return forward>=1 and forward<=limit and math.abs(z*ux-x*uz)<=math.min(2,forward*.5)
  end
 end

 local function gravityGround(at:Vector3,rays:RaycastParams):RaycastResult?
  if not spawnFloor or not spawnFloor:IsA("BasePart") or spawnFloor.Parent~=session.world
   or not neutralWithinArena(at,spawnFloor) then return nil end
  local ground=workspace:Raycast(at+Vector3.new(0,3,0),Vector3.new(0,-8,0),rays)
  if ground and ground.Normal.Y>=.72 and ground.Instance.CanCollide
   and ground.Instance:IsDescendantOf(session.world) then return ground end
  return nil

 local function gravityMove(model:Model,delta:Vector3,character:Model):Vector3?
  local root=model.PrimaryPart
  if not root or model.Parent~=all then return nil end
  local rays=gravityRays(character)
  local overlap=OverlapParams.new()
  overlap.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
  overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances=rays.FilterDescendantsInstances
  overlap.RespectCanCollide=true;overlap.MaxParts=1
  local position=root.Position
  -- Blockcast omits an initial overlap. Do not pull an already embedded body
  -- through the obstacle to reach a clear endpoint.
  if #workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(position),root.Size,overlap)>0 then return nil end
  local height=2*(root.Size.Y/2.5) -- Existing ground clearance for the neutral rig.
  local function grounded(at:Vector3):Vector3?
   local ground=gravityGround(at,rays)
   if not ground or math.abs(ground.Position.Y+height-position.Y)>1.4 then return nil end
   return Vector3.new(at.X,ground.Position.Y+height,at.Z)
  end
  local function sweep(from:Vector3,step:Vector3):RaycastResult?
   return workspace:Blockcast(CFrame.new(from),root.Size,step,rays)
  end
  local function blocked(at:Vector3):boolean
   local found=grounded(at)
   return found==nil or (found-at).Magnitude>.15
    or #workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(found),root.Size,overlap)>0
  end
  local aimed=grounded(position+delta)
  if not aimed then return nil end
  local safe=GravityOrb.safeStep(position,aimed-position,sweep,blocked)
  if not safe then return nil end
  model:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(safe,safe+root.CFrame.LookVector))
  return safe
 end

local MageProjectiles=(function()
-- S0–S4 limits from #219 design 7207198342, 7207837903 and 7208243026.
-- Flight speed, width and star tell are tunable animation/gameplay parameters.
local MageProjectiles = {}
local REACH = table.freeze({8,10,12,14,16})
local LIMIT = table.freeze({1,1,2,2,3})
local EXTENDED_REACH=table.freeze({9,11,13,15,17})
local FIRE_DURATION=table.freeze({1,1.2,1.4,1.6,2})
local FROST_FRACTION=table.freeze({.08,.10,.12,.14,.16})
local NEEDLE_SPEED=table.freeze({22,25,28,31,34})
local RECIPES = table.freeze({
 ["MAGE-001"]=table.freeze({name="火種",cooldown=12,speed=30,width=.22,tell=.18}),
 ["MAGE-011"]=table.freeze({name="霜弾",cooldown=15,speed=32,width=.25,tell=0}),
 ["MAGE-012"]=table.freeze({name="氷槍",cooldown=17,speed=38,width=.21,tell=.20}),
 ["MAGE-026"]=table.freeze({name="雷針",cooldown=18,speed=22,width=.12,tell=.16}),
 ["MAGE-033"]=table.freeze({name="風切弾",cooldown=16,speed=40,width=.19,tell=0}),
 ["MAGE-051"]=table.freeze({name="石弾",cooldown=15,speed=34,width=.33,tell=0}),
 ["MAGE-071"]=table.freeze({name="星弾",cooldown=14,speed=36,width=.26,tell=.22}),
})
type Plan = {
 id: string, name: string, cooldown: number, energy: number, reach: number,
 limit: number, speed: number, width: number, tell: number,
 status: string?, statusDuration: number?, statusPotency: number?,
}
type Candidate = {
 id: string, center: Vector3, radius: number, token: any,
}
type Contact = {target: Candidate, distance: number}
type Flight = {
 plan: Plan, origin: Vector3, direction: Vector3, travelled: number,
 tried: {[any]: boolean}, hits: number, done: boolean,
}

function MageProjectiles.plan(id: any, stage: any): Plan?
 if type(id)~="string" or type(stage)~="number" or stage<0 or stage>4
  or stage~=math.floor(stage) then return nil end
 local recipe=RECIPES[id]
 if recipe==nil then return nil end
 local index=stage+1
 local fire=id=="MAGE-001"
 local frost=id=="MAGE-011"
 local needle=id=="MAGE-026"
 local extended=id=="MAGE-012" or needle
 return {
  id=id,name=recipe.name,cooldown=recipe.cooldown,energy=if extended then 35 else 30,
  reach=if extended then EXTENDED_REACH[index] else REACH[index],
  limit=if fire or frost or needle then 1 else LIMIT[index],
  speed=if needle then NEEDLE_SPEED[index] else recipe.speed,width=recipe.width,tell=recipe.tell,
  status=if fire then "BURN" elseif frost then "FROST" else nil,
  statusDuration=if fire then FIRE_DURATION[index] elseif frost then 1.4 else nil,
  statusPotency=if frost then FROST_FRACTION[index] else nil,
 }
end

-- Use the captured launch direction for the entire cast. The caller clamps
-- through the first world collision and only supplies current round neutrals.
function MageProjectiles.travel(plan: Plan, age: number): number
 if age>=plan.tell+plan.reach/plan.speed then return plan.reach end
 return math.max(0,(age-plan.tell)*plan.speed)
end

-- A root bounding sphere intersects this portion of the thin straight path.
-- Contact position, then the server neutral ID order, resolves an exact tie.
function MageProjectiles.contacts(origin: Vector3, direction: Vector3,
 first: number, last: number, width: number, candidates: {Candidate},
 tried: {[any]: boolean}): {Contact}
 local result: {Contact}={}
 if last<=first then return result end
 for _,target in ipairs(candidates) do
  if tried[target.token] then continue end
  local offset=target.center-origin
  local axis=offset:Dot(direction)
  local side=offset-direction*axis
  local thickness=target.radius+width
  local remainder=thickness*thickness-side:Dot(side)
  if remainder<-.000001 then continue end
  local halfSpan=math.sqrt(math.max(0,remainder))
  local entry=axis-halfSpan
  if axis+halfSpan>=first and entry<=last then
   table.insert(result,{target=target,distance=math.max(first,entry)})
  end
 end
 table.sort(result,function(a,b)
  if a.distance==b.distance then return a.target.id<b.target.id end
  return a.distance<b.distance
 end)
 return result
end

function MageProjectiles.newFlight(plan: Plan, origin: Vector3, direction: Vector3): Flight
 return {plan=plan,origin=origin,direction=direction,travelled=0,tried={},hits=0,done=false}
end

-- Use server HP confirmation from the existing swarm authority. World clipping
-- returns an absolute distance along the captured forward direction, if hit.
function MageProjectiles.step(flight: Flight, age: number, current: boolean,
 clip: (Vector3,Vector3,number,number)->number?,
 scan: ()->{Candidate}, hit: (Candidate)->boolean): number
 if flight.done then return 0 end
 if not current then flight.done=true;return 0 end
 local first=flight.travelled
 local last=MageProjectiles.travel(flight.plan,age)
 if last<=first then return 0 end
 local blockedAt=clip(flight.origin,flight.direction,first,last)
 if blockedAt then last=math.clamp(blockedAt,first,last) end
 local previousHits=flight.hits
 if last>first then
  local contacts=MageProjectiles.contacts(flight.origin,flight.direction,first,last,
   flight.plan.width,scan(),flight.tried)
  for _,contact in ipairs(contacts) do
   local target=contact.target
   -- Solid world geometry wins a tie, including the very end of a frame.
   if blockedAt and contact.distance>=last-.00001 then break end
   if flight.tried[target.token] then continue end
   flight.tried[target.token]=true
   if hit(target) then
    flight.hits+=1
    if flight.hits>=flight.plan.limit then
     last=contact.distance
     break
    end
   end
  end
 end
 flight.travelled=last
 flight.done=blockedAt~=nil or last>=flight.plan.reach or flight.hits>=flight.plan.limit
 return flight.hits-previousHits
end

return table.freeze(MageProjectiles)
end)()
local MageProjectileVisual=(function()
local Visual = {}
local WIND = Color3.fromRGB(163,220,225)
local STONE = Color3.fromRGB(95,83,75)
local STAR = Color3.fromRGB(204,185,111)
local TRIM = Color3.fromRGB(230,219,167)

local function facet(parent:Instance,class:string,name:string,size:Vector3,
 pose:CFrame,color:Color3):BasePart
 local part=Instance.new(class)::BasePart
 part.Name=name
 part.Size=size
 part.CFrame=pose
 part.Color=color
 part.Anchored=true
 part.CanCollide=false
 part.CanTouch=false
 part.CanQuery=false
 part.CastShadow=false
 part.Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
 part.Parent=parent
 return part
end

local function wind(model:Model,stage:number)
 facet(model,"WedgePart","LeadingFeather",Vector3.new(.10,.32,1.12),
  CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.rad(25)),WIND)
 if stage>=1 then
  facet(model,"WedgePart","SecondFeather",Vector3.new(.09,.24,.88),
   CFrame.new(-.13,.12,.19)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.rad(-26)),WIND)
 end
 if stage>=2 then
  facet(model,"WedgePart","CurvedTip",Vector3.new(.09,.24,.58),
   CFrame.new(.12,.06,-.30)*CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(18),math.rad(28)),TRIM)
 end
 if stage>=3 then
  facet(model,"WedgePart","TrailingVane",Vector3.new(.06,.17,.52),
   CFrame.new(-.14,-.07,.51)*CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(12),0),TRIM)
 end
 if stage>=4 then
  facet(model,"WedgePart","FeatherEdge",Vector3.new(.06,.15,.54),
   CFrame.new(.18,.03,.42)*CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(-17),0),WIND)
 end
end

local function stone(model:Model,stage:number)
 local span=.34+stage*.052
 facet(model,"WedgePart","RoughRock",Vector3.new(span,span*.74,span),
  CFrame.Angles(math.rad(34),math.rad(16),math.rad(-12)),STONE)
 if stage>=1 then
  facet(model,"WedgePart","BrokenFace",Vector3.new(span*.82,span*.53,span*.84),
   CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-41),math.rad(121),math.rad(12)),Color3.fromRGB(134,111,87))
 end
 if stage>=2 then
  facet(model,"WedgePart","Strata",Vector3.new(span*.90,.07,span),
   CFrame.new(0,.08,0)*CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(126),math.rad(17)),TRIM)
 end
 if stage>=3 then
  for side=-1,1,2 do
   facet(model,"WedgePart","WoodChute",Vector3.new(.08,span*.46,span*.80),
    CFrame.new(side*span*.45,-span*.25,0)*CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(12*side),0),Color3.fromRGB(111,76,47))
  end
 end
 if stage>=4 then
  facet(model,"WedgePart","StoneInscription",Vector3.new(span*.62,.04,span*.54),
   CFrame.new(0,span*.27,0)*CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(-22),0),TRIM)
 end
end

local elementalPalette=table.freeze({
 ["MAGE-001"]={main=Color3.fromRGB(194,80,39),edge=Color3.fromRGB(247,164,91),length=.62,name="Ember"},
 ["MAGE-011"]={main=Color3.fromRGB(158,201,220),edge=Color3.fromRGB(223,239,239),length=.47,name="Frost"},
 ["MAGE-012"]={main=Color3.fromRGB(161,196,224),edge=Color3.fromRGB(220,240,250),length=1.46,name="Icicle"},
 ["MAGE-026"]={main=Color3.fromRGB(144,141,106),edge=Color3.fromRGB(243,205,101),length=.98,name="Needle"},
})

local function elemental(model:Model,id:string,stage:number)
 local recipe=elementalPalette[id]
 local skewer=id=="MAGE-012" or id=="MAGE-026"
 local width=if skewer then .16 else .30
 local length=recipe.length+stage*(if skewer then .13 else .041)
 local count=if stage>=2 then 6 elseif stage==1 then 3 else 2
 for i=1,count do
  local step=(i-1)*math.pi*2/count
  local offset=if skewer then width*.24 else width*.4
  facet(model,"WedgePart",recipe.name.."Face",Vector3.new(width*.58,width,length),
   CFrame.Angles(0,0,step)*CFrame.new(0,offset,0)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.rad(26)),
   if i%2==0 then recipe.edge else recipe.main)
 end
 if stage>=4 then
  facet(model,"WedgePart",recipe.name.."Spine",Vector3.new(width*.26,width*.39,length*1.18),
   CFrame.new(0,-width*.17,-length*.08),recipe.edge)
 end
end

local function star(model:Model,stage:number)
 local count=if stage>=2 then 4 elseif stage==1 then 2 else 1
 for i=1,count do
  local turn=(i-1)*math.pi*2/count
  local outward=.17+stage*.049
  facet(model,"WedgePart","CrystalPoint",Vector3.new(.11,.17,outward+.16),
   CFrame.Angles(0,0,turn)*CFrame.new(0,outward*.42,0)*CFrame.Angles(math.rad(40),0,0),
   if i%2==0 then TRIM else STAR)
 end
 if stage>=3 then
  for i=1,4 do
   facet(model,"WedgePart","RigidOrbitFrame",Vector3.new(.075,.086,.26),
    CFrame.Angles(0,0,i*math.pi/2+math.pi/4)*CFrame.new(0,.29,.02),STAR)
  end
 end
 if stage>=4 then
  facet(model,"WedgePart","GiltCore",Vector3.new(.23,.20,.40),CFrame.Angles(0,math.pi/4,0),TRIM)
 end
end

type Bundle = {model:Model, world:Instance}
function Visual.begin(world:Instance,id:string,stage:number,origin:Vector3,
 direction:Vector3,reach:number,tell:number):(Bundle,BasePart?)
 local model=Instance.new("Model")
 model.Name="EGGRUMBLE_"..id
 if id=="MAGE-033" then wind(model,stage)
 elseif id=="MAGE-051" then stone(model,stage)
 elseif id=="MAGE-071" then star(model,stage)
 else elemental(model,id,stage) end
 model.WorldPivot=CFrame.identity
 model:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(origin,origin+direction))
 local warning=nil
 if tell>0 then
  if reach>0 then
   local center=origin+direction*(reach/2)
   local palette=elementalPalette[id]
   warning=facet(world,"Part",if palette then "EGGRUMBLE_"..id.."_Aim" else "EGGRUMBLE_StarAim",Vector3.new(.13,.07,reach),
    CFrame.lookAt(center,center+direction),if palette then palette.main else STAR)
   warning.Transparency=.36
  end
 else
  model.Parent=world
 end
 return {model=model,world=world},warning
end

function Visual.move(bundle:Bundle,warning:BasePart?,position:Vector3,direction:Vector3)
 if warning and warning.Parent then warning:Destroy() end
 if bundle.world.Parent==nil then return end
 bundle.model:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(position,position+direction))
 if bundle.model.Parent==nil then bundle.model.Parent=bundle.world end

local Chain=(function()
-- MAGE-025. Only server-owned neutral records are passed to these selectors.
local Chain = {}

Chain.cooldown = 20
Chain.energy = 40
Chain.tellSeconds = 0.24
Chain.targetsByStage = table.freeze({1, 2, 3, 4, 5})
Chain.hopByStage = table.freeze({4, 5, 6, 7, 8})

export type Neutral = {id: number, model: Model, pos: Vector3, hp: number}

function Chain.seed(origin: Vector3, mobs: {Neutral}, allowed: (Neutral) -> boolean): Neutral?
    local chosen: Neutral? = nil
    local nearest = math.huge
    for _, neutral in ipairs(mobs) do
        if neutral.hp <= 0 then continue end
        local distance = (neutral.pos - origin).Magnitude
        if (distance < nearest or (chosen and distance == nearest and neutral.id < chosen.id))
            and allowed(neutral) then
            chosen, nearest = neutral, distance
        end
    end
    return chosen
end

function Chain.path(first: Neutral, mobs: {Neutral}, stage: number,
        clear: (Vector3, Vector3) -> boolean, targetLimit: number?): {Neutral}
    local index = stage + 1
    local limit, reach = Chain.targetsByStage[index], Chain.hopByStage[index]
    if first.hp <= 0 or not limit or not reach then return {} end
    local selected = {first}
    local visited = {[first.model] = true}
    while #selected < math.min(limit,targetLimit or limit) do
        local origin = selected[#selected].pos
        local nextNeutral = Chain.seed(origin, mobs, function(candidate)
            return not visited[candidate.model] and (candidate.pos - origin).Magnitude <= reach
                and clear(origin, candidate.pos)
        end)
        if not nextNeutral then break end
        visited[nextNeutral.model] = true
        table.insert(selected, nextNeutral)
    end
    return selected
end

return table.freeze(Chain)
end)()

-- Only the existing authoritative server adapter may call open/advance/abort.

    return type(x) == "number" and x == x and x > -math.huge and x < math.huge
end
local function validId(x)

    if type(binding) ~= "table" or not validId(binding.actor) or not validId(binding.round) or not validId(binding.cast) then
        return nil, "BINDING"
    end
    if not finite(now) or not finite(deadline) or deadline <= now then return nil, "TIME" end
    if type(plan.receipts) ~= "table" or #plan.receipts < 1 or #plan.receipts > 4 then return nil, "PHASES" end
    local phases = {}
    for i, p in ipairs(plan.receipts) do
        if not validId(p) then return nil, "PHASES" end
        phases[i] = p
    end
    local actor, round, cast = binding.actor, binding.round, binding.cast
    local index, status, lastTime, reason = 1, "OPEN", now, nil
    local seen = {}
    local tracker = {}
    local function close(why)
        status, reason = "VOID", why
    end
    local function checkTime(t)
        if not finite(t) or t < lastTime then return false, "TIME" end
        lastTime = t
        if t >= deadline then close("EXPIRED"); return false, "EXPIRED" end
        return true
    end

        return status, status == "OPEN" and phases[index] or nil, index, reason
    end
    function tracker.abort(why)
        if status ~= "OPEN" then return false, "TERMINAL" end
        close(validId(why) and why or "ABORTED")
        return true
    end
    function tracker.advance(receipt, t)
        if status ~= "OPEN" then return false, "TERMINAL" end
        local ok, err = checkTime(t)
        if not ok then return false, err end
        if type(receipt) ~= "table" or receipt.binding ~= binding or receipt.actor ~= actor or receipt.round ~= round or receipt.cast ~= cast then
            return false, "BINDING"
        end
        if not validId(receipt.receiptId) or seen[receipt.receiptId] then return false, "REPLAY_OR_ID" end
        if receipt.phase ~= phases[index] then return false, "ORDER" end
        if type(receipt.success) ~= "boolean" then return false, "RESULT" end
        seen[receipt.receiptId] = true
        if not receipt.success then close("DEPENDENCY_FAILED"); return true, status end
        index = index + 1
        if index > #phases then status = "COMPLETE" end
        return true, status
    end
    function tracker.expire(t)
        if status ~= "OPEN" then return false, "TERMINAL" end
        return checkTime(t)
    end
    return tracker
end

 WIND={ja="風",icon="🌀",shape="spiral",palette="mint"},
 EARTH={ja="土",icon="◆",shape="shard",palette="umber"},
 LIGHTNING={ja="雷",icon="⚡",shape="zigzag",palette="yellow"},

  local deadlines=if abilityId=="MAGE-012" then {[abilityId]=plan.cooldown} else nil
  stage=swarm.tryRoleGrowthCast(p,"MAGE",plan.cooldown,plan.energy,deadlines)

  local wall=workspace:Raycast(start+facing*a,facing*(b-a),params)

function Blink.direction(forward: Vector3,velocity: Vector3,walkSpeed: number,stage: number): Vector3?
    local flat=Vector3.new(forward.X,0,forward.Z)
    flat=if flat.Magnitude>.01 then flat.Unit else Vector3.new(1,0,0)
    local movement=Vector3.new(velocity.X,0,velocity.Z)

function Blink.landing(arena: BasePart,character: Model,origin: Vector3,facing: Vector3,amount: number): Vector3?

    ray.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    ray.FilterDescendantsInstances={character}
    ray.RespectCanCollide=true

    -- It catches torso, low and overhead obstructions and narrow gate jambs.
    local right=Vector3.new(-facing.Z,0,facing.X)
    local distance=amount
    for _,height in ipairs({-1.1,2,4.6}) do

    local body=Vector3.new(3.2,4.5,3.2)
    local sweep=workspace:Blockcast(CFrame.new(origin),body,facing*distance,ray)
    if sweep then distance=math.min(distance,math.max(0,sweep.Distance-.35)) end
    if distance<3 then return nil end
    local projected=origin+facing*distance
    if not Blink.inside(arena,projected) then return nil end
    local ground=workspace:Raycast(projected+Vector3.new(0,6,0),Vector3.new(0,-17,0),ray)
    if not ground or not ground.Instance:IsA("BasePart") or not ground.Instance.Anchored
        or not ground.Instance.CanCollide or ground.Normal.Y<.65 then return nil end

    overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances={character}

local LandThenAttack=(function()
-- Private combat flight owns its avatar only during a checked, finite sweep.
local LandThenAttack={}
local flying=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
local BODY=Vector3.new(2.6,4.6,2.6) -- Existing checked Ninja body volume.
local BODY_CENTER=Vector3.new(0,.3,0)
local STEP=1/24

function LandThenAttack.active(actor:Player):boolean

local function footprint(world:Instance,avatar:Model)
 local rays=RaycastParams.new()
 rays.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
 rays.FilterDescendantsInstances={avatar}
 rays.RespectCanCollide=true
 local overlap=OverlapParams.new()

 overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances={avatar}
 overlap.RespectCanCollide=true
 overlap.MaxParts=1
 local function floor(at:Vector3,referenceY:number):Vector3?
  local beam=Vector3.new(at.X,referenceY+2.5,at.Z)
  local hit=workspace:Raycast(beam,Vector3.new(0,-5,0),rays)
  if not hit or not hit.Instance:IsA("BasePart") or not hit.Instance.Anchored or not hit.Instance.CanCollide
   or not hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(world) or hit.Normal.Y<.65 or math.abs(hit.Position.Y-referenceY)>1.2 then return nil end
  return hit.Position
 end
 local function sweep(a:Vector3,b:Vector3):boolean
  local change=b-a
  if change.Magnitude>.001 and workspace:Blockcast(CFrame.new(a+BODY_CENTER),BODY,change,rays) then return false end
  return #workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(b+BODY_CENTER),BODY,overlap)==0
 end
 return floor,sweep,rays
end

 part.Size=size
 part.Anchored=true

 part.CanTouch=false
 part.CanQuery=false

 part.Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
 part.Transparency=.28
 part.Color=color

 -- checks run on every actual segment, including inputs after the warning.

 for index=1,8 do

   if not aim or not under or not sweep(last,aim) then release();ctx.abort();return end

   if (root.Position-aim).Magnitude>.08 then release();ctx.abort();return end
   if not usedFlight then
    usedFlight=ctx.trace("FLIGHT_VALID",true)
    if not usedFlight then release();ctx.abort();return end
   end
   moveWings()
   local projected=xz+track*(ctx.distance*(1-u))
   local _,atFoot=waypoint(projected,1)
   if atFoot then mark.CFrame=CFrame.new(atFoot+Vector3.new(0,.06,0))*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.pi/2) end
   last,lastU=aim,u
  end

  -- Permit physics to ground it before attack and reject movement to another tile.
  root.Anchored=false
  root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero
  root.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero

   and (root.Position-last).Magnitude<=.35 and math.abs(root.Position.Y-settled.Y-rootHeight)<=.35

  if not stable or not ctx.trace("LAND_VALID",true) then ctx.abort();return end
  ctx.onLand(settled,stage)

end

local WarriorFire=(function()
 local ROLE,IGNITE,RING,COMBO="WARRIOR","WARRIOR-071","WARRIOR-016","COMBO-002"
 local FLAG="P0D_ENABLE_PRIVATE_WARRIOR_COMBO_002"
 local slots=table.freeze({B=IGNITE,C=RING,D=COMBO})
 local pending=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
 local M={}

 function M.enabled():boolean return workspace:GetAttribute(FLAG)~=false end

 function M.slot(session:any,p:Player,role:string,slot:string):string?
  if role==ROLE and M.enabled() and session.warriorLoadouts and session.warriorLoadouts[p.UserId] then
   return slots[slot]
  end
  return nil
 end

 local function plan(id:string,stage:number):any
  if type(stage)~="number" or stage~=math.floor(stage) or stage<0 or stage>4 then return nil end
  local index=stage+1
  if id==COMBO then
   local contract=ComboRecipes.resolve(ROLE,IGNITE,RING,stage)
   if not contract or contract.id~=COMBO or contract.flow~="ATTACK_UNIFIED" or contract.hold then return nil end
   return {name=contract.name,cd=contract.proposedCooldownSec,energy=contract.proposedEnergy,tell=contract.telegraphMinSec,
    reach=contract.limits.radius,maxTargets=contract.limits.neutralMax,burn=contract.limits.burnSec,contract=contract,
    deadlines={[IGNITE]=WarriorRows[IGNITE].cd,[RING]=WarriorRows[RING].cd,[COMBO]=contract.proposedCooldownSec}}
  end
  local row=WarriorRows[id]
  if not row then return nil end
  return {name=row.name,cd=row.cd,energy=row.energy,tell=if id==IGNITE then .18 else 0,
   reach=row.metrics[1].values[index],maxTargets=if id==RING then row.metrics[2].values[index] else 1,
   burn=if id==IGNITE then row.metrics[2].values[index] else nil,deadlines={[id]=row.cd}}
 end

 function M.presentation(id:string?):any if id then return plan(id,0) end;return nil end

 local function blades(world:Instance,id:string,origin:Vector3,direction:Vector3,reach:number,lifetime:number,warning:boolean):Folder
  local folder=Instance.new("Folder")
  folder.Name=if warning then "EGGRUMBLE_WarriorFireTell" else "EGGRUMBLE_WarriorFireCut"
  local isLine=id==IGNITE
  local count=if isLine then 3 else 8
  for i=1,count do
   local radial=if isLine then direction else Vector3.new(math.cos(i*math.pi*.25),0,math.sin(i*math.pi*.25))
   local at=origin+radial*(reach*(if isLine then i/3 else 1))+Vector3.new(0,-1.15,0)
   local blade=Instance.new("WedgePart")
   blade.Name="HeatCeramicBlade";blade.Anchored=true;blade.CanCollide=false;blade.CanTouch=false
   blade.CanQuery=false;blade.CastShadow=false;blade.Massless=true
   blade.Material=Enum.Material.Metal
   blade.Color=if warning then Color3.fromRGB(214,139,76) else Color3.fromRGB(188,74,46)
   blade.Transparency=if warning then .31 else .13
   blade.Size=Vector3.new(if isLine then .47 else reach*.31,.17,if warning then .28 else .48)
   blade.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(at,at+(if isLine then radial else Vector3.new(-radial.Z,0,radial.X)))
   blade.Parent=folder
  end
  folder.Parent=world
  Debris:AddItem(folder,lifetime)
  return folder
 end

 function M.cancel(p:Player)
  local work=pending[p]
  if not work then return end
  pending[p]=nil
  if work.timeline then work.timeline.abort("CANCELLED") end
  if work.cue.Parent then work.cue:Destroy() end
 end

 function M.start(session:any,p:Player,char:Model,root:BasePart,h:Humanoid,id:string,slot:string,serial:number):boolean
  local swarm=session.swarm
  local world=session.world
  local owner=session.rules.castles[tostring(p.UserId)]
  if not swarm or type(swarm.damageWarriorNeutral)~="function" or pending[p] then return false end
  local function current():boolean
   return M.slot(session,p,ROLE,slot)==id and currentHumanMember(session,p)
    and session.rules.phase=="ACTIVE" and session.rules.winner==nil and world~=nil and session.world==world and world.Parent~=nil
    and session.rules.castles[tostring(p.UserId)]==owner and owner~=nil and owner.alive
    and p.Character==char and root.Parent==char and h.Parent==char and h.Health>0 and h.SeatPart==nil
    and swarm.isCurrentRoleCaster(p,char,ROLE)
  end
  if not current() then return false end
  local stage=swarm.getRoleGrowthSnapshot(p)
  local choice=stage and plan(id,stage.stage)
  if not choice then return false end
  local look=root.CFrame.LookVector
  local heading=Vector3.new(look.X,0,look.Z)
  if heading.Magnitude<.001 then return false end
  heading=heading.Unit
  local origin=root.Position+Vector3.new(0,1,0)
  local began=os.clock()
  local binding={round=tostring(session),actor=tostring(p.UserId),cast=tostring(serial)}
  local timeline=if choice.contract then ComboSequence.open(choice.contract,binding,began+choice.tell+.65,began) else nil
  if choice.contract and not timeline then return false end
  if swarm.tryRoleGrowthCast(p,ROLE,choice.cd,choice.energy,choice.deadlines)~=stage.stage then return false end

  local function impact()
   local now=os.clock()
   if not current() or (root.Position+Vector3.new(0,1,0)-origin).Magnitude>3
    or now<began+choice.tell or (timeline and not timeline.expire(now)) then
    if timeline then timeline.abort("STALE_OR_MOVED") end
    return
   end
   local hits,registered=0,false
   local rows=swarm.projectileCandidates(origin,choice.reach)
   table.sort(rows,function(a,b)
    local first,second=(a.center-origin).Magnitude,(b.center-origin).Magnitude
    if first~=second then return first<second end
    return (tonumber(a.id) or math.huge)<(tonumber(b.id) or math.huge)
   end)
   local center=if id==IGNITE then origin+heading*choice.reach else origin
   -- One existing neutral HP budget per target. The compound never invokes the
   -- two component attacks independently. Its first eligible burn is the only one.
   local amount=CombatBalance.skill(ROLE,"A").damage
   for _,row in ipairs(rows) do
    if hits>=choice.maxTargets then break end
    if (row.center-origin).Magnitude<=choice.reach and AttackGeometry.allowed(origin,center,row.center,
        choice.reach,if id==IGNITE then "BLADE" else "CIRCLE") then
     local connected,lit=swarm.damageWarriorNeutral(p,char,row.token,origin,amount,
      if not registered then choice.burn else nil)
     if connected then hits+=1 end
     registered=registered or lit
    end
   end
   if timeline then
    local function receipt(phase:string,success:boolean)
     return timeline.advance({actor=binding.actor,round=binding.round,cast=binding.cast,binding=binding,
      phase=phase,receiptId=binding.cast..":"..phase,success=success},now)
    end
    if receipt("ATTACK_VALID",hits>0) and hits>0 then receipt("STATUS_VALID",registered) end
   end
   blades(world,id,origin,heading,choice.reach,.23,false)
   if hits>0 then ImpactFeedback.attacker(p,ROLE,slot,hits) end
  end

  if choice.tell==0 then impact();return true end
  local work={cue=blades(world,id,origin,heading,choice.reach,choice.tell+.1,true),timeline=timeline}
  pending[p]=work
  task.delay(choice.tell,function()
   if pending[p]~=work then return end
   pending[p]=nil
   if work.cue.Parent then work.cue:Destroy() end
   impact()
  end)
  return true
 end
 return M
end)()

local CannonConfig=(function()
-- Fixed #219 BUILDER-018. Damage is handled by the existing neutral Horde.
local Cannon = {
    cooldown = 24,
    energy = 40,
    range = table.freeze({10, 12, 14, 16, 18}),
    targets = table.freeze({2, 2, 3, 4, 5}),
    shotTimes = table.freeze({.7, 1.4}),
    lifetime = 4,
    aimDot = math.cos(math.rad(20)),
}

function Cannon.directions(facing: Vector3): {Vector3}
    local angle = math.rad(15)
    local lateral = Vector3.new(-facing.Z, 0, facing.X)
    local forward = facing * math.cos(angle)
    local split = lateral * math.sin(angle)
    return {forward - split, forward + split}
end

return table.freeze(Cannon)
end)()
