local SKY_ROLE="WARRIOR"
local SKY_FLIGHT="WARRIOR-060"
local SKY_RAIN="WARRIOR-020"
local SKY_COMBO="COMBO-001"
local SKY_FLAG="P0D_ENABLE_PRIVATE_WARRIOR_COMBO_001"
local RAIN_TELL=1
local HALF_FAN=math.rad(44)
local FAN_DOT=math.cos(HALF_FAN)
local slots=table.freeze({B=SKY_RAIN,C=SKY_FLIGHT,D=SKY_COMBO})
local pending=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
local M={}

function M.enabled():boolean
 return RunService:IsStudio() and workspace:GetAttribute(SKY_FLAG)~=false
end

function M.slot(session:any,p:Player,role:string,slot:string):string?
 if role==SKY_ROLE and M.enabled() and session.warriorSkyLoadouts and session.warriorSkyLoadouts[p.UserId] then
  return slots[slot]
 end
 return nil
end

function M.presentation(ability:string?):any
 if ability==SKY_COMBO then
  local recipe=ComboRecipes.resolve(SKY_ROLE,SKY_FLIGHT,SKY_RAIN,0)
  return {name=recipe.name,energy=recipe.proposedEnergy,cd=recipe.proposedCooldownSec}
 end
 return ability and SkyCatalog[ability] or nil
end

local function fanVisual(world:Instance,point:Vector3,direction:Vector3,reach:number,stage:number,warning:boolean):Folder
 local visual=Instance.new("Folder")
 visual.Name=if warning then "EGGRUMBLE_WarriorSkyFanTell" else "EGGRUMBLE_WarriorSkyRainCut"
 local count=if stage==0 then 3 else 5
 local lateral=Vector3.new(-direction.Z,0,direction.X)
 for index=1,count do
  local angle=((index-1)/(count-1)*2-1)*HALF_FAN
  local ray=direction*math.cos(angle)+lateral*math.sin(angle)
  local plank=Instance.new("WedgePart")
  plank.Name="SkyFanBlade"
  plank.Anchored=true;plank.CanCollide=false;plank.CanTouch=false;plank.CanQuery=false;plank.CastShadow=false
  plank.Material=Enum.Material.Metal
  plank.Color=if warning then Color3.fromRGB(229,193,115) else Color3.fromRGB(240,219,170)
  plank.Transparency=if warning then .34 else .15
  plank.Size=if warning then Vector3.new(.13,.065,reach) else Vector3.new(.23,1.05,.7)
  local center=point+Vector3.new(0,if warning then .07 else .60,0)+ray*(reach*(if warning then .5 else .8))
  plank.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(center,center+ray)
  plank.Parent=visual
 end
 visual.Parent=world
 return visual
end

function M.cancel(p:Player)
 local work=pending[p]
 if not work then return end
 pending[p]=nil
 for _,connection in ipairs(work.connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
 if work.timeline then work.timeline.abort("RETIRED") end
 work.visual:Destroy()
end

local function floorAt(world:Instance,avatar:Model,root:BasePart):Vector3?
 local params=RaycastParams.new()
 params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
 params.FilterDescendantsInstances={avatar}
 params.RespectCanCollide=true
 local under=workspace:Raycast(root.Position,Vector3.new(0,-6,0),params)
 if not under or not under.Instance:IsA("BasePart") or not under.Instance.Anchored
  or under.Instance.Parent~=world or under.Normal.Y<.65
  or (under.Instance.Name~="TacticalBattlefield" and not under.Instance.Name:match("^TacticalRoute_")) then return nil end
 return under.Position
end

local function fanDamage(swarm,p,origin:Vector3,heading:Vector3,reach:number,maxTargets:number,amount:number):number
 local rows=swarm.projectileCandidates(origin,reach)
 table.sort(rows,function(left,right)
  local a,b=(left.center-origin).Magnitude,(right.center-origin).Magnitude
  if a==b then return left.id<right.id end
  return a<b
 end)
 local hits=0
 for _,row in ipairs(rows) do
  local delta=row.center-origin
  local lateral=Vector3.new(delta.X,0,delta.Z)
  if lateral.Magnitude>.001 and math.abs(delta.Y)<=4 and heading:Dot(lateral.Unit)>=FAN_DOT
   and AttackGeometry.allowed(origin,origin,row.center,reach,"CIRCLE") then
   if swarm.damageFromPlayer(p,row.center,.02,amount,"CIRCLE",nil,row.token,origin)>0 then
    hits+=1
    if hits>=maxTargets then break end
   end
  end
 end
 return hits
end

function M.cast(session:any,p:Player,avatar:Model,root:BasePart,h:Humanoid,owner:any,ability:string,slot:string):boolean
 local world,swarm=session.world,session.swarm
 local arena=world and world:FindFirstChild("TacticalBattlefield")
 if not arena or not arena:IsA("BasePart") or not swarm or type(swarm.isCurrentRoleCaster)~="function"
  or type(swarm.projectileCandidates)~="function" or type(swarm.damageFromPlayer)~="function" or pending[p] then return false end
 local function current():boolean
  return M.slot(session,p,SKY_ROLE,slot)==ability and session.rules.phase=="ACTIVE" and session.rules.winner==nil
   and session.world==world and world:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and arena.Parent==world and session.swarm==swarm
   and session.rules.castles[tostring(p.UserId)]==owner and owner.alive==true and (owner.heldEggs or 0)==0
   and p.Character==avatar and root.Parent==avatar and h.Parent==avatar and h.Health>0
   and h.SeatPart==nil and not h.Sit and not h.PlatformStand and swarm.isCurrentRoleCaster(p,avatar,SKY_ROLE)
 end
 if not current() then return false end
 local sample=swarm.getRoleGrowthSnapshot(p)
 if not sample or sample.role~=SKY_ROLE then return false end
 local stage=sample.stage
 local flight,rain=SkyCatalog[SKY_FLIGHT],SkyCatalog[SKY_RAIN]
 local plan=if ability==SKY_COMBO then ComboRecipes.resolve(SKY_ROLE,SKY_FLIGHT,SKY_RAIN,stage) else nil
 local cap=rain.metrics[1].values[stage+1]
 local reach=rain.metrics[2].values[stage+1]
 if ability==SKY_COMBO and (not plan or plan.flow~="LAND_THEN_ATTACK" or plan.limits.neutralMax~=cap) then return false end
 local tell=if plan then math.max(RAIN_TELL,plan.telegraphMinSec) else RAIN_TELL
 local duration=flight.metrics[1].values[stage+1]
 local binding={actor=tostring(p.UserId),round=tostring(session),cast=tostring((castSequence[p.UserId] or 0)+1)}
 local now=os.clock()
 local sequence=if plan then ComboSequence.open(plan,binding,now+duration+tell+.75,now) else nil
 if plan and not sequence then return false end
 local function trace(phase:string,success:boolean):boolean
  if not sequence then return success end
  return sequence.advance({binding=binding,actor=binding.actor,round=binding.round,cast=binding.cast,
   phase=phase,success=success,receiptId=binding.cast..":"..phase},os.clock())
 end
 local function heading():Vector3?
  local aim=root.CFrame.LookVector
  local dir=Vector3.new(aim.X,0,aim.Z)
  return if dir.Magnitude>.001 then dir.Unit else nil
 end
 local function startRain(point:Vector3,direction:Vector3)
  local origin=root.Position+Vector3.new(0,1,0)
  local commenced=os.clock()
  local work={visual=fanVisual(world,point,direction,reach,stage,true),timeline=sequence,connections={}}
  pending[p]=work
  local function cancel() if pending[p]==work then M.cancel(p) end end
  table.insert(work.connections,h.Died:Connect(cancel))
  table.insert(work.connections,p.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(leaving) if leaving==avatar then cancel() end end))
  table.insert(work.connections,world.Destroying:Connect(cancel))
  table.insert(work.connections,world:GetAttributeChangedSignal("EGGRUMBLE_MatchPhase"):Connect(function()
   if world:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_MatchPhase")~="ACTIVE" then cancel() end
  end))
  table.insert(work.connections,workspace:GetAttributeChangedSignal(SKY_FLAG):Connect(function()
   if not M.enabled() then cancel() end
  end))
  task.delay(tell,function()
   if pending[p]~=work then return end
   local grounded=GroundMovement.isGrounded(h) and floorAt(world,avatar,root)
   if not current() or not grounded or (root.Position+Vector3.new(0,1,0)-origin).Magnitude>3
    or os.clock()<commenced+tell or not trace("ATTACK_VALID",true) then cancel();return end
   work.timeline=nil
   cancel()
   local hits=fanDamage(swarm,p,origin,direction,reach,cap,CombatBalance.skill(SKY_ROLE,"A").damage)
   Debris:AddItem(fanVisual(world,point,direction,reach,stage,false),.23)
   if hits>0 then ImpactFeedback.attacker(p,SKY_ROLE,slot,hits) end
  end)
 end
 if ability==SKY_RAIN then
  local dir=heading()
  local point=GroundMovement.isGrounded(h) and floorAt(world,avatar,root)
  if not point or not dir or not GroundMovement.inside(arena,root.Position) then return false end
  if swarm.tryRoleGrowthCast(p,SKY_ROLE,rain.cd,rain.energy,{[SKY_RAIN]=rain.cd})~=stage then return false end
  startRain(point,dir)
  return true
 end
 local cooldown=if plan then plan.proposedCooldownSec else flight.cd
 local energy=if plan then plan.proposedEnergy else flight.energy
 local deadlines=if plan then {[SKY_COMBO]=cooldown,[SKY_FLIGHT]=flight.cd,[SKY_RAIN]=rain.cd} else {[SKY_FLIGHT]=flight.cd}
 return LandThenAttack.start({actor=p,avatar=avatar,root=root,humanoid=h,world=world,arena=arena,
  current=current,grounded=GroundMovement.isGrounded,inside=GroundMovement.inside,flightSkin="WARRIOR",
  duration=duration,height=flight.metrics[2].values[stage+1],distance=math.min(CoreAction.SPECS.WARRIOR.dodge.distance,6*duration),
  authorize=function()
   local accepted=swarm.tryRoleGrowthCast(p,SKY_ROLE,cooldown,energy,deadlines)
   return if accepted==stage then accepted else nil
  end,
  abort=function() if sequence then sequence.abort("FLIGHT_INTERRUPTED") end end,
  trace=trace,
  onLand=function(point:Vector3, _acceptedStage:number)
   local dir=heading()
   if not dir or not current() then return end
   if plan then startRain(point,dir);return end
   local spec=CoreAction.SPECS.WARRIOR.basic
   local origin=root.Position+Vector3.new(0,1,0)
   local hits=fanDamage(swarm,p,origin,dir,spec.reach,1,spec.damage)
   Debris:AddItem(fanVisual(world,point,dir,spec.reach,stage,false),.23)
   if hits>0 then ImpactFeedback.attacker(p,SKY_ROLE,slot,hits) end
  end,
 })
end

return M
end)()

function M.cast(session:any,p:Player,char:Model,root:BasePart,id:string,serial:number):boolean
 local swarm=session.swarm
 local status=swarm and swarm.getRoleGrowthSnapshot(p)
 if not status or status.role~="ZOMBIE" or not swarm.isCurrentRoleCaster(p,char,"ZOMBIE")
  or p:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_CarryingEgg")==true then return false end
 local stage=status.stage
 local plan=if id==COMBO then ComboRecipes.resolve("ZOMBIE",MARK,COMMAND,stage) else nil
 if id==COMBO and (not plan or plan.hold or plan.flow~="CONVERT_THEN_COMMAND") then return false end
 local spec=M.presentation(id)
 local mark,command=Data[MARK],Data[COMMAND]
 local markRange,markTTL=mark.metrics[1].values[stage+1],mark.metrics[2].values[stage+1]
 local cmdTTL,cmdRange=command.metrics[1].values[stage+1],command.metrics[2].values[stage+1]
 if not (spec and markRange and markTTL and cmdTTL and cmdRange) then return false end
 local origin=root.Position+Vector3.new(0,1,0)
 local now=os.clock()
 local targets=if id==COMMAND then swarm.zombieOwned(p,char,origin,cmdRange)
  else swarm.zombieCandidates(p,char,origin,markRange,if plan then plan.limits.neutralMax else 1,id==COMBO)
 if #targets==0 then return false end
 local binding={actor=tostring(p.UserId),round=tostring(session.world),cast="ZOMBIE:"..tostring(serial)}
 local deadline=now+markTTL
 local sequence=if plan then ComboSequence.open(plan,binding,deadline,now) else nil
 if plan and not sequence then return false end
 local component=if plan then deadlines else {[id]=spec.cd}
 if swarm.tryRoleGrowthCast(p,"ZOMBIE",spec.cd,spec.energy,component)~=stage then return false end
 if id==COMMAND then
  return swarm.orderCharmed(p,"GUARD",nil,{avatar=char,origin=origin,range=cmdRange,duration=cmdTTL,models=targets})
 end

  swarm.markZombieCandidates(p,char,targets,deadline,nil)

 end

  return sequence.advance({binding=binding,actor=binding.actor,round=binding.round,cast=binding.cast,
   phase=phase,receiptId=binding.cast..":"..phase,success=success},at)
 end

 local commandCount=0
 swarm.markZombieCandidates(p,char,targets,deadline,function(model:Model,at:number)
  -- Only the existing Swarm CHARM decision calls here, once for each chosen same-round Model.
  if p.Character~=char or at>=deadline or commandCount>=plan.limits.neutralMax then return end
  local currentOrigin=root.Position+Vector3.new(0,1,0)

  if ordered then commandCount+=1 end

  reach=if exactRange then row.metrics[1].values[index] else RANGE[index],

 end
 part.Parent=world

 pending[p]=nil
 for _,connection in ipairs(work.connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
 work.cue:Destroy()
end

  or type(swarm.projectileCandidates)~="function" or type(swarm.damageFromPlayer)~="function" or pending[p] then return false end

  return M.slot(session,p,"MAGE",slot)==id and session.world==world and world:IsDescendantOf(workspace)
   and arena.Parent==world and session.swarm==swarm and session.rules.phase=="ACTIVE" and session.rules.winner==nil
   and session.rules.castles[tostring(p.UserId)]==owner and owner.alive==true and (owner.heldEggs or 0)==0
   and p.Character==avatar and root.Parent==avatar and h.Parent==avatar and h.Health>0

 local origin=root.Position

 heading=heading.Unit

  return (to-from).Magnitude<.02 or workspace:Raycast(from,to-from,rays)==nil
 end
 local function terrain(at:Vector3,rootAt:Vector3):(Vector3?,BasePart?)
  if not GroundMovement.inside(arena,at) then return nil,nil end
  local offset=arena.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(at)
  if math.abs(offset.X)+choice.radius>arena.Size.X*.5 or math.abs(offset.Z)+choice.radius>arena.Size.Z*.5 then return nil,nil end
  local ground=workspace:Raycast(at+Vector3.new(0,4,0),Vector3.new(0,-12,0),rays)
  if not ground or not ground.Instance:IsA("BasePart") or not ground.Instance.Anchored or not ground.Instance.CanCollide
   or ground.Instance.Parent~=world or ground.Normal.Y<.65
   or (ground.Instance~=arena and (choice.earthOnly or not ground.Instance.Name:match("^TacticalRoute_")))
   or math.abs(rootAt.Y-ground.Position.Y)>5 then return nil,nil end
  local above=ground.Position+Vector3.new(0,1.65,0)
  if not clear(rootAt+Vector3.new(0,1,0),above) then return nil,nil end
  local overlap=OverlapParams.new()
  overlap.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
  overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances={ground.Instance,avatar}
  overlap.RespectCanCollide=true;overlap.MaxParts=1
  if #workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(above),Vector3.new(.7,2.8,.7),overlap)>0 then return nil,nil end
  return ground.Position,ground.Instance
 end
 local aim=origin+heading*choice.reach

 if not point or not support then return false end
 if swarm.tryRoleGrowthCast(p,"MAGE",choice.cd,choice.energy,{[id]=choice.cd})~=snapshot.stage then return false end
 local started=os.clock()
 local work={cue=cue(world,id,point,choice.radius,true),connections={}}
 pending[p]=work

 end))

  local start=point+Vector3.new(0,1.65,0)

  end
  table.sort(rows,function(a,b)
   if a.distance==b.distance then return a.target.id<b.target.id end
   return a.distance<b.distance
  end)
  local actual={}
  for _,row in ipairs(rows) do

     if swarm.damageFromPlayer(p,target.center,.02,amount,"CIRCLE",nil,target.token,start)>0 then
      table.insert(actual,target.center)
      if choice.icePush then swarm.pushMageGroundNeutral(p,avatar,target.token,point,heading,id) end
     end
    end
    if #actual>=choice.cap then break end
   end
  end
  if #actual>0 then
   Debris:AddItem(cue(world,id,point,choice.radius,false),.23)

   end
   ImpactFeedback.attacker(p,"MAGE",slot,#actual)

local function decorativePart(source:BasePart?,name:string):BasePart
  local part:BasePart=if source and source:IsA("WedgePart") then Instance.new("WedgePart") else Instance.new("Part")
  if source and source:IsA("Part") and part:IsA("Part") then part.Shape=source.Shape end
  part.Name=name;part.Anchored=true;part.CanCollide=false;part.CanTouch=false
  part.CanQuery=false;part.CastShadow=false;part.Massless=true
  part.Material=Enum.Material.Glass;part.Color=Color3.fromRGB(162,181,199)
  part.Transparency=.54
  return part
 end

 local function makeDecoy(char:Model,root:BasePart,at:Vector3,role:string):Folder?
  -- Copy supported poses and sizes only. No cloned object, Tool, script,
  -- Humanoid, inherited tag, or model for any AI or hit query to target.
  local folder=Instance.new("Folder")
  folder.Name="EGGRUMBLE_NinjaMovingDecoy"
  folder:SetAttribute("FixedDecoyId",DECOY)
  folder:SetAttribute("VisualRole",role)
  local translate=CFrame.new(at-root.Position)
  local count=0
  local function add(source:Instance?)
   if count>=11 or not source or not source:IsA("BasePart") then return end
   count+=1
   local piece=decorativePart(source,"Mirror_"..source.Name)
   piece.Size=source.Size;piece.CFrame=translate*source.CFrame;piece.Parent=folder
  end
  for _,name in ipairs(BODY) do add(char:FindFirstChild(name)) end
  if count==0 then folder:Destroy();return nil end
  local roleArt=char:FindFirstChild("EGGRUMBLE_RoleVisuals")
  if roleArt and roleArt:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_VisualRole")==role then
   for _,piece in ipairs(roleArt:GetChildren()) do add(piece) end
  end
  -- Four silver gaps at the feet distinguish the illusion from the real body.
  for i=1,4 do
   local shard=decorativePart(nil,"MirrorFootShard"..i)
   local angle=i*math.pi*.5
   shard.Size=Vector3.new(.92,.075,.16)
   shard.CFrame=CFrame.new(at+Vector3.new(math.cos(angle)*1.3,-2.92,math.sin(angle)*1.3))
    *CFrame.Angles(0,angle+math.pi*.25,0)
   shard.Parent=folder
  end
  return folder
 end

local function visualRoute(world:Instance,arena:BasePart,avatar:Model,base:Vector3)
 if not GroundMovement.inside(arena,base) then return nil,nil end
 local filter={avatar}
 local neutrals=world:FindFirstChild("NeutralHorde")
 if neutrals then table.insert(filter,neutrals) end
 local ray=RaycastParams.new()
 ray.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
 ray.FilterDescendantsInstances=filter
 ray.RespectCanCollide=true
 local function support(position:Vector3):Vector3?
  if not GroundMovement.inside(arena,position) then return nil end
  local hit=workspace:Raycast(position+Vector3.new(0,2,0),Vector3.new(0,-8,0),ray)
  if not hit or not hit.Instance:IsA("BasePart") or not hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(world)
   or not hit.Instance.Anchored or not hit.Instance.CanCollide or hit.Normal.Y<.65 then return nil end
  return hit.Position
 end
 local startFloor=support(base)
 if not startFloor or base.Y-startFloor.Y<2.3 or base.Y-startFloor.Y>5.5 then return nil,nil end
 local overlap=OverlapParams.new()
 overlap.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
 overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances=filter
 overlap.RespectCanCollide=true
 overlap.MaxParts=1
 local box=CFrame.new(base)
 if #workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(box,SWEEP_BOX,overlap)>0 then return nil,nil end
 return ray,support
end

local function createVisual(p:Player,avatar:Model,root:BasePart,world:Instance,arena:BasePart,
 distance:number,life:number,current:()->boolean,direction:Vector3,authorize:(()->number?)?):boolean
 if active[p] or not current() then return false end
 local base=root.Position
 local ray,support=visualRoute(world,arena,avatar,base)
 if not ray or not support then return false end
 local startFloor=support(base)
 if not startFloor then return false end
 local folder=makeDecoy(avatar,root,base,ROLE)
 if not folder then return false end
 if authorize and authorize()==nil then folder:Destroy();return false end
 local pieces={}
 for _,part in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do table.insert(pieces,{part=part,frame=part.CFrame}) end
 local rec={folder=folder}
 active[p]=rec
 folder.Parent=world
 local began=os.clock()
 task.spawn(function()
  local currentPoint,blocked=base,false
  while active[p]==rec do
   task.wait(STEP)
   local now=os.clock()
   if active[p]~=rec then return end
   if not current() or folder.Parent~=world or now-began>=life then M.clear(p);return end
   if blocked then continue end
   local targetDistance=math.min(distance,(now-began)*distance/(life-STEP))
   local nextHorizontal=base+direction*targetDistance
   local ground=support(nextHorizontal)
   if not ground or math.abs(ground.Y-startFloor.Y)>1.2 then blocked=true;continue end
   local destination=nextHorizontal+Vector3.new(0,ground.Y-startFloor.Y,0)
   local delta=destination-currentPoint
   if delta.Magnitude<=.001 then continue end
   local hit=workspace:Blockcast(CFrame.new(currentPoint),SWEEP_BOX,delta,ray)
   if hit then
    blocked=true
    destination=currentPoint+delta.Unit*math.max(0,hit.Distance-.08)
   end
   local translate=CFrame.new(destination-base)
   for _,piece in ipairs(pieces) do piece.part.CFrame=translate*piece.frame end
   currentPoint=destination
  end
 end)
 task.delay(life,function() if active[p]==rec then M.clear(p) end end)
 return true
end

function M.cast(session:any,p:Player,avatar:Model,root:BasePart,h:Humanoid,owner:any,id:string,serial:number):boolean
 local world,swarm=session.world,session.swarm
 local arena=world and world:FindFirstChild("TacticalBattlefield")
 if not arena or not arena:IsA("BasePart") or not swarm then return false end
 local function current():boolean
  return M.slot(session,p,ROLE,"B")==DECOY and p.Parent==Players
   and session.rules.phase=="ACTIVE" and session.rules.winner==nil
   and session.world==world and arena.Parent==world and world:IsDescendantOf(workspace)
   and session.swarm==swarm and session.rules.castles[tostring(p.UserId)]==owner
   and owner.alive==true and (owner.heldEggs or 0)==0 and p:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_CarryingEgg")~=true
   and p.Character==avatar and root.Parent==avatar and h.Parent==avatar and h.Health>0
   and avatar:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_Downed")~=true and p:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_Eliminated")~=true
   and h.SeatPart==nil and not h.Sit and not h.PlatformStand and swarm.isCurrentRoleCaster(p,avatar,ROLE)
 end
 if not current() or (id~=FLIGHT and active[p]) then return false end
 local snapshot=swarm.getRoleGrowthSnapshot(p)
 local stage=snapshot and snapshot.stage
 if stage==nil or snapshot.role~=ROLE then return false end
 local decoy,flight=Catalog[DECOY],Catalog[FLIGHT]
 local distance,life=decoy.metrics[1].values[stage+1],decoy.metrics[2].values[stage+1]
 local duration,height=flight.metrics[1].values[stage+1],flight.metrics[2].values[stage+1]
 local spec=M.presentation(id)
 local plan=if id==COMBO then ComboRecipes.resolve(ROLE,FLIGHT,DECOY,stage) else nil
 if id==COMBO and (not plan or plan.id~=COMBO or plan.flow~="FLIGHT_VISUAL_DECOY"
  or plan.limits.decoyDist~=distance or plan.limits.decoyLife~=life
  or plan.limits.flightSec~=duration or plan.limits.height~=height) then return false end
 if not spec or not GroundMovement.isGrounded(h) then return false end
 local function direction():Vector3?
  local look=root.CFrame.LookVector
  local flat=Vector3.new(look.X,0,look.Z)
  return if flat.Magnitude>.01 then flat.Unit else nil
 end
 local cd,energy=if plan then plan.proposedCooldownSec else spec.cd,if plan then plan.proposedEnergy else spec.energy
 local clocks=if plan then {[FLIGHT]=flight.cd,[DECOY]=decoy.cd,[COMBO]=cd} else {[id]=cd}
 local function authorize():number?
  local accepted=swarm.tryRoleGrowthCast(p,ROLE,cd,energy,clocks)
  return if accepted==stage then accepted else nil
 end
 if id==DECOY then
  local dir=direction()
  if root.Anchored or not dir then return false end
  return createVisual(p,avatar,root,world,arena,distance,life,current,dir,authorize)
 end
 local now=os.clock()
 local binding={actor=tostring(p.UserId),round=tostring(session),cast="NINJA-009:"..tostring(serial)}
 local sequence=if plan then ComboSequence.open(plan,binding,now+duration+life+.55,now) else nil
 if plan and not sequence then return false end
 local function trace(phase:string,ok:boolean):boolean
  -- The motor verifies LAND_VALID before it calls onLand. Only catalog receipts advance the combo.
  if not sequence or phase=="LAND_VALID" then return ok end
  local valid=sequence.advance({binding=binding,actor=binding.actor,round=binding.round,cast=binding.cast,
   receiptId=binding.cast..":"..phase,phase=phase,success=ok},os.clock())
  return valid and ok
 end
 return LandThenAttack.start({actor=p,avatar=avatar,root=root,humanoid=h,world=world,arena=arena,
  current=current,grounded=GroundMovement.isGrounded,inside=GroundMovement.inside,
  duration=duration,height=height,distance=math.min(CoreAction.SPECS.NINJA.dodge.distance,6*duration),flightSkin="NINJA",
  authorize=authorize,trace=trace,abort=function() if sequence then sequence.abort("FLIGHT_INTERRUPTED") end end,
  onLand=function(_point:Vector3,_stage:number)
   if not sequence or not sequence.expire(os.clock()) then return end
   local dir=direction()
   local created=dir~=nil and createVisual(p,avatar,root,world,arena,distance,life,current,dir,nil)
   if not trace("DECOY_VALID",created) and created then M.clear(p) end
  end,
 })
end

return M
end)()

})
type Plan = {
 id: string, name: string, cooldown: number, energy: number, reach: number,
 limit: number, speed: number, width: number, tell: number,
 status: string?, statusDuration: number?, statusPotency: number?,
 shape: string?, element: string?, turn: number?,
}
type Candidate = {
 id: string, center: Vector3, radius: number, token: any,
}
type Contact = {target: Candidate, distance: number}
type Flight = {
 plan: Plan, origin: Vector3, direction: Vector3, travelled: number,
 tried: {[any]: boolean}, hits: number, done: boolean,
}

function MageProjectiles.plan(id: any, stage: any): Plan?
 if type(id)~="string" or type(stage)~="number" or stage<0 or stage>4
  or stage~=math.floor(stage) then return nil end
 local recipe=RECIPES[id]
 if recipe==nil then return MageFieldBatch.flightPlan(id,stage) end
 local index=stage+1
 local fire=id=="MAGE-001"
 local frost=id=="MAGE-011"
 local needle=id=="MAGE-026"
 local extended=id=="MAGE-012" or needle
 return {
  id=id,name=recipe.name,cooldown=recipe.cooldown,energy=if extended then 35 else 30,
  reach=if extended then EXTENDED_REACH[index] else REACH[index],
  limit=if fire or frost or needle then 1 else LIMIT[index],
  speed=if needle then NEEDLE_SPEED[index] else recipe.speed,width=recipe.width,tell=recipe.tell,
  status=if fire then "BURN" elseif frost then "FROST" else nil,
  statusDuration=if fire then FIRE_DURATION[index] elseif frost then 1.4 else nil,
  statusPotency=if frost then FROST_FRACTION[index] else nil,
 }
end

-- Use the captured launch direction for the entire cast. The caller clamps
-- through the first world collision and only supplies current round neutrals.
function MageProjectiles.travel(plan: Plan, age: number): number
 if age>=plan.tell+plan.reach/plan.speed then return plan.reach end
 return math.max(0,(age-plan.tell)*plan.speed)
end

-- A root bounding sphere intersects this portion of the thin straight path.
-- Contact position, then the server neutral ID order, resolves an exact tie.
function MageProjectiles.contacts(origin: Vector3, direction: Vector3,
 first: number, last: number, width: number, candidates: {Candidate},
 tried: {[any]: boolean}): {Contact}
 local result: {Contact}={}
 if last<=first then return result end
 for _,target in ipairs(candidates) do
  if tried[target.token] then continue end
  local offset=target.center-origin
  local axis=offset:Dot(direction)
  local side=offset-direction*axis
  local thickness=target.radius+width
  local remainder=thickness*thickness-side:Dot(side)
  if remainder<-.000001 then continue end
  local halfSpan=math.sqrt(math.max(0,remainder))
  local entry=axis-halfSpan
  if axis+halfSpan>=first and entry<=last then
   table.insert(result,{target=target,distance=math.max(first,entry)})
  end
 end
 table.sort(result,function(a,b)
  if a.distance==b.distance then return a.target.id<b.target.id end
  return a.distance<b.distance
 end)
 return result
end

function MageProjectiles.newFlight(plan: Plan, origin: Vector3, direction: Vector3): Flight
 return {plan=plan,origin=origin,direction=direction,travelled=0,tried={},hits=0,done=false}
end

-- Use server HP confirmation from the existing swarm authority. World clipping
-- returns an absolute distance along the captured forward direction, if hit.
function MageProjectiles.resolveSegment(flight:Flight,origin:Vector3,direction:Vector3,first:number,last:number,
 blockedAt:boolean,candidates:{Candidate},hit:(Candidate,Vector3)->boolean):number
 if last>first then
  local contacts=MageProjectiles.contacts(origin,direction,first,last,
   flight.plan.width,candidates,flight.tried)
  for _,contact in ipairs(contacts) do
   local target=contact.target
   -- Solid world geometry wins a tie, including the very end of a frame.
   if blockedAt and contact.distance>=last-.00001 then break end
   if flight.tried[target.token] then continue end
   flight.tried[target.token]=true
   if hit(target,origin) then
    flight.hits+=1
    if flight.hits>=flight.plan.limit then
     last=contact.distance
     break
    end
   end
  end
 end
 return last
end

function MageProjectiles.step(flight: Flight, age: number, current: boolean,
 clip: (Vector3,Vector3,number,number)->number?,
 scan: ()->{Candidate}, hit: (Candidate,Vector3)->boolean): number
 if flight.done then return 0 end
 if not current then flight.done=true;return 0 end
 local first=flight.travelled
 local last=MageProjectiles.travel(flight.plan,age)
 if last<=first then return 0 end
 local blockedAt=clip(flight.origin,flight.direction,first,last)
 if blockedAt then last=math.clamp(blockedAt,first,last) end
 local previousHits=flight.hits
 if last>first then last=MageProjectiles.resolveSegment(flight,flight.origin,flight.direction,first,last,blockedAt~=nil,scan(),hit) end
 flight.travelled=last
 flight.done=blockedAt~=nil or last>=flight.plan.reach or flight.hits>=flight.plan.limit
 return flight.hits-previousHits
end

return table.freeze(MageProjectiles)
end)()

local function horizontal(v:Vector3):Vector3
 return Vector3.new(v.X,0,v.Z)
end

local function current(bit):boolean
 local session,p,avatar=bit.session,bit.owner,bit.avatar
 local pet=bit.pet.humanoid
 return M.slot(session,p,"BEAST","A")==CHASE and session.swarm==bit.swarm
  and session.rules.castles[tostring(p.UserId)]==bit.ownerState and bit.arena.Parent==session.world
  and p:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_CarryingEgg")~=true and avatar:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_Downed")~=true
  and bit.avatarRoot.Parent==avatar and avatar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")==bit.avatarRoot
  and pet.SeatPart==nil and pet.FloorMaterial~=Enum.Material.Air and pet.FloorMaterial~=Enum.Material.Water
  and ownedThunderState(session,p,avatar,bit.human,bit.ownerState)==bit.pet
  and bit.swarm.isCurrentRoleCaster(p,avatar,"BEAST")
end

local function sightFilter(bit, target:Model?)
 local actor,pet=bit.avatar,bit.pet.model
 local ray=RaycastParams.new()
 ray.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
 ray.FilterDescendantsInstances=if target then {actor,pet,target} else {actor,pet}
 ray.RespectCanCollide=true
 return ray
end

local function legalFloor(bit, at:Vector3, ray:RaycastParams):Vector3?
 local arena=bit.arena
 local localPoint=arena.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(at)
 if math.abs(localPoint.X)>arena.Size.X*.5-2 or math.abs(localPoint.Z)>arena.Size.Z*.5-2 then return nil end
 local hit=workspace:Raycast(at+UP*2,UP*-8,ray)
 if not hit or hit.Normal.Y<.68 then return nil end
 local surface=hit.Instance
 if not surface:IsA("BasePart") or not surface.Anchored or not surface.CanCollide
  or surface.Parent~=bit.session.world or (surface~=arena and not surface.Name:match("^TacticalRoute_")) then return nil end
 return hit.Position
end

local function destination(bit,wanted:Vector3,target:Model?):Vector3?
 local root=bit.pet.root
 local ray=sightFilter(bit,target)
 local startFloor=legalFloor(bit,root.Position,ray)
 if not startFloor then return nil end
 local height=root.Position.Y-startFloor.Y
 if height<1.1 or height>3.4 then return nil end
 local drift=horizontal(wanted-root.Position)
 if drift.Magnitude>LEASH then return nil end
 local steps=math.max(1,math.ceil(drift.Magnitude/2.4))
 local previous,previousGround=root.Position,startFloor
 local body=Vector3.new(root.Size.X*.83,2.1,root.Size.Z*.83)
 for step=1,steps do
  local check=previous+drift/steps
  local ground=legalFloor(bit,check,ray)
  if not ground or math.abs(ground.Y-previousGround.Y)>.85 then return nil end
  local nextPoint=ground+UP*height
  local nextDelta=nextPoint-previous
  if nextDelta.Magnitude>.05 and workspace:Blockcast(CFrame.new(previous),body,nextDelta,ray) then return nil end
  previous,previousGround=nextPoint,ground
 end
 return previous
end

local function neutralDestination(bit,target:Model?):Vector3?
 local horde=bit.session.world:FindFirstChild("NeutralHorde")
 local root=target and target.PrimaryPart
 local human=target and target:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 if not target or target.Parent~=horde or not root or not human or human.Health<=0
  or target:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_NeutralFriendlyOwnerId")~=nil then return nil end
 local caster=bit.avatarRoot
 local delta=root.Position-caster.Position
 if delta.Magnitude>bit.reach or math.abs(delta.Y)>4 then return nil end
 local origin=caster.Position+UP
 if workspace:Raycast(origin,root.Position+UP-origin,sightFilter(bit,target)) then return nil end
 local away=horizontal(bit.pet.root.Position-root.Position)
 local wanted=if away.Magnitude>2.7 then root.Position+away.Unit*2.7 else bit.pet.root.Position
 return destination(bit,wanted,target)
end

local function acquireTarget(bit): (Model?,Vector3?)
 local caster=bit.avatarRoot
 local look=horizontal(caster.CFrame.LookVector)
 if look.Magnitude<.01 then return nil,nil end
 look=look.Unit
 local matches={}
 for _,candidate in ipairs(bit.swarm.projectileCandidates(caster.Position,bit.reach)) do
  local delta=horizontal(candidate.center-caster.Position)
  if delta.Magnitude>.1 and delta.Magnitude<=bit.reach and delta.Unit:Dot(look)>=.58 then
   table.insert(matches,{row=candidate,distance=delta.Magnitude})
  end
 end
 table.sort(matches,function(a,b)
  return a.distance==b.distance and a.row.id<b.row.id or a.distance<b.distance
 end)
 for index,match in ipairs(matches) do
  if index>MAX_ORDERS_TO_CHECK then break end
  local model=match.row.token
  local point=neutralDestination(bit,model)
  if point then return model,point end
 end
 return nil,nil
end

local function rally(bit):Vector3
 local caster=bit.avatarRoot
 local distance=if bit.id==RETURN then 2.25 else math.min(bit.reach*.66,3.8)
 local heading=horizontal(caster.CFrame.RightVector)
 if heading.Magnitude<.01 then return caster.Position end
 return caster.Position+heading.Unit*distance
end

local function cue(bit,text:string):BillboardGui
 local board=Instance.new("BillboardGui")
 board.Name="EGGRUMBLE_BeastOrderCue"
 board.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(92,24)
 board.StudsOffset=Vector3.new(0,3.35,0)
 board.MaxDistance=32
 board.AlwaysOnTop=false
 local label=Instance.new("TextLabel")
 label.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
 label.BackgroundTransparency=.28
 label.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(42,36,25)
 label.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(251,231,174)
 label.TextScaled=true
 label.Text=text
 label.Parent=board
 board.Parent=bit.pet.root
 return board
end

local function clear(state:any)
 local bit=state.command
 if not bit then return end
 state.command=nil
 if bit.cue then bit.cue:Destroy() end
 if state.root.Parent==state.model and state.humanoid.Parent==state.model then
  state.humanoid:MoveTo(state.root.Position)
 end
end

function M.cancel(player:Player)
 local state=active[player.UserId]
 if state and state.owner==player then clear(state) end
end

M.stop=clear
M.floorAt=legalFloor
M.routeTo=destination

-- The escort's existing movement loop owns every MoveTo. Orders pause autonomous
-- reactions while active; its original attack, cooldown, and lifetime are untouched.
function M.step(state:any):boolean
 local bit=state.command
 if not bit then return false end
 if os.clock()>=bit.untilAt or not current(bit) then clear(state);return true end
 local goal
 if bit.id==CHASE then
  goal=neutralDestination(bit,bit.target)
 elseif bit.id==RETURN then
  if (state.root.Position-bit.avatarRoot.Position).Magnitude<=bit.reach then goal=destination(bit,rally(bit),nil) end
 elseif (bit.avatarRoot.Position-bit.center).Magnitude<=bit.reach and
  horizontal(state.root.Position-bit.center).Magnitude<=bit.reach then
  goal=destination(bit,bit.guardPoint,nil)
 end
 if not goal then clear(state);return true end
 state.humanoid:MoveTo(goal)
 return true
end

function M.cast(session:any,player:Player,avatar:Model,root:BasePart,h:Humanoid,owner:any,id:string):boolean
 local row=Catalog[id]
 local swarm=session.swarm
 local state=ownedThunderState(session,player,avatar,h,owner)
 local arena=session.world:FindFirstChild("TacticalBattlefield")
 if not row or not state or state.pendingThunder or not swarm or not arena or not arena:IsA("BasePart") then return false end
 local now=os.clock()
 if state.expires-now<=.35 then return false end
 local bit={id=id,session=session,owner=player,avatar=avatar,avatarRoot=root,human=h,pet=state,arena=arena,swarm=swarm,ownerState=owner}
 if not current(bit) then return false end
 local snap=swarm.getRoleGrowthSnapshot(player)
 if not snap or snap.role~="BEAST" then return false end
 local index=snap.stage+1
 bit.reach=row.metrics[1].values[index]
 bit.untilAt=math.min(state.expires,now+row.metrics[2].values[index])
 local goal
 if id==CHASE then
  bit.target,goal=acquireTarget(bit)
 elseif id==RETURN then
  if (root.Position-state.root.Position).Magnitude<=bit.reach then goal=destination(bit,rally(bit),nil) end
 else
  bit.center=root.Position
  bit.guardPoint=rally(bit)
  if horizontal(state.root.Position-bit.center).Magnitude<=bit.reach then goal=destination(bit,bit.guardPoint,nil) end
 end
 if not goal or swarm.tryRoleGrowthCast(player,"BEAST",row.cd,row.energy,{[id]=row.cd})~=snap.stage then return false end
 clear(state)
 bit.cue=cue(bit,row.name)
 state.command=bit
 state.humanoid:MoveTo(goal)
 task.delay(bit.untilAt-now,function()
  if state.command==bit then clear(state) end
 end)
 return true
end

return M
end)()

local M={}
local CHARGE,GUARD,COMBO="BEAST-020","BEAST-095","COMBO-017"
local FLAG="P0D_ENABLE_PRIVATE_BEAST_MOON"
local SLOT=table.freeze({A=CHARGE,C=GUARD,D=COMBO})
local UP=Vector3.new(0,1,0)
local TELL=.40
local STEP=.05
local MOTION_SPEED=20
local CONTACT_RADIUS=2.1
local MAX_CHECKED_NEUTRALS=18

function M.enabled():boolean
 return RunService:IsStudio() and workspace:GetAttribute(FLAG)~=false
end

function M.slot(s:any,p:Player,role:string,slot:string):string?
 if role~="BEAST" or not M.enabled() or not s.beastMoonLoadouts or s.beastMoonLoadouts[p.UserId]~=true then return nil end
 return SLOT[slot]
end

function M.presentation(id:string?,recipes:any):any
 if id==COMBO then
  local spec=recipes.resolve("BEAST",CHARGE,GUARD,0)
  return {name=spec.name,description="実際に突進して止まると円陣",energy=spec.proposedEnergy,cd=spec.proposedCooldownSec}
 end
 return id and Catalog[id] or nil
end

local function flat(delta:Vector3):Vector3
 return Vector3.new(delta.X,0,delta.Z)
end

local function current(bit):boolean
 local s,p,avatar=bit.session,bit.owner,bit.avatar
 return M.slot(s,p,"BEAST","A")==CHARGE and s.world==bit.world and s.swarm==bit.swarm
  and s.rules.castles[tostring(p.UserId)]==bit.ownerState and bit.arena.Parent==bit.world
  and p:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_CarryingEgg")~=true and avatar:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_Downed")~=true
  and bit.casterRoot.Parent==avatar and avatar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")==bit.casterRoot
  and ownedThunderState(s,p,avatar,bit.human,bit.ownerState)==bit.pet
  and bit.swarm.isCurrentRoleCaster(p,avatar,"BEAST")
end

local function cue(bit,name:string,size:Vector3,frame:CFrame,color:Color3,shape:Enum.PartType):Part
 local part=Instance.new("Part")
 part.Name=name
 part.Size=size;part.CFrame=frame;part.Color=color;part.Shape=shape
 part.Anchored=true;part.CanCollide=false;part.CanTouch=false;part.CanQuery=false;part.CastShadow=false
 part.Transparency=.60;part.Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
 part.Parent=bit.world
 return part
end

local function releaseMotion(bit)
 if not bit.ownsAnchor then return end
 bit.ownsAnchor=false
 local root=bit.pet.root
 if root.Parent==bit.pet.model then
  root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero
  root.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero
  root.Anchored=false
 end
end

local function clear(state:any)
 local bit=state.moon
 if not bit then return end
 state.moon=nil
 if bit.marker then bit.marker:Destroy();bit.marker=nil end
 if bit.sequence then bit.sequence.abort("ESCORT_RETIRED") end
 releaseMotion(bit)
 if state.root.Parent==state.model and state.humanoid.Parent==state.model and state.humanoid.Health>0 then
  state.humanoid:MoveTo(state.root.Position)
 end
end
M.stop=clear

function M.cancel(p:Player)
 local state=active[p.UserId]
 if state and state.owner==p then clear(state) end
end

local function trace(bit,step:string,result:boolean):boolean
 if not bit.sequence then return result end
 local b=bit.binding
 local ok=bit.sequence.advance({binding=b,actor=b.actor,round=b.round,cast=b.cast,phase=step,
  receiptId=b.cast..":"..step,success=result},os.clock())
 return ok and result
end

local function validNeutral(bit,target:Model?):BasePart?
 local horde=bit.world:FindFirstChild("NeutralHorde")
 local root=target and target.PrimaryPart
 local human=target and target:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 if not horde or not target or target.Parent~=horde or not root or not human or human.Health<=0
  or target:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_NeutralFriendlyOwnerId")~=nil then return nil end
 return root
end

local function attack(bit,target:Model,root:BasePart):boolean
 local state=bit.pet
 if not lineClear(state.root.Position+UP*1.85,root.Position+UP,state.model,target) then return false end
 return state.hit(state.root,state.model,root.Position,target)>0
end

local function sweep(bit,from:Vector3,to:Vector3):boolean
 local pet=bit.pet.root
 local body=Vector3.new(pet.Size.X*.88,2.15,pet.Size.Z*.90)
 local change=to-from
 return change.Magnitude>.002 and not workspace:Blockcast(CFrame.new(from+UP*.1),body,change,bit.ray)
end

local function stillGrounded(bit):boolean
 local pet=bit.pet
 return pet.humanoid.SeatPart==nil and pet.humanoid.FloorMaterial~=Enum.Material.Air
  and pet.humanoid.FloorMaterial~=Enum.Material.Water
end

local function formation(bit,point:Vector3):boolean
 local state=bit.pet
 local root=state.root
 if not current(bit) or root.Anchored or not stillGrounded(bit) then return false end
 local floor=Commands.floorAt(bit,point,bit.ray)
 if not floor or (root.Position-point).Magnitude>.44 then return false end
 if bit.marker then bit.marker:Destroy() end
 bit.point=point
 bit.untilAt=math.min(state.expires,os.clock()+bit.guardSec)
 if bit.untilAt<=os.clock() then return false end
 bit.marker=cue(bit,"EGGRUMBLE_BeastMoonFormation",Vector3.new(.075,bit.guardRadius*2,bit.guardRadius*2),
  CFrame.new(floor+UP*.055)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.pi/2),Color3.fromRGB(161,149,206),Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
 bit.phase="GUARD"
 state.humanoid:MoveTo(point)
 local published=trace(bit,"FORMATION_VALID",bit.marker.Parent==bit.world)
 if not published then return false end
 task.delay(bit.untilAt-os.clock(),function() if state.moon==bit then clear(state) end end)
 return true
end

function M.step(state:any):boolean
 local bit=state.moon
 if not bit then return false end
 if not current(bit) then clear(state);return true end
 if bit.phase~="GUARD" then return true end
 if os.clock()>=bit.untilAt or not stillGrounded(bit) or flat(state.root.Position-bit.point).Magnitude>bit.guardRadius then
  clear(state);return true
 end
 if (state.root.Position-bit.point).Magnitude>.20 then
  local goal=Commands.routeTo(bit,bit.point,nil)
  if not goal then clear(state);return true end
  state.humanoid:MoveTo(goal)
 end
 if os.clock()-state.lastHit>=ATTACK_COOLDOWN then
  local candidates=bit.swarm.projectileCandidates(state.root.Position,math.min(4,bit.guardRadius))
  table.sort(candidates,function(a,b)
   local origin=state.root.Position
   local left,right=(a.center-origin).Magnitude,(b.center-origin).Magnitude
   return left==right and a.id<b.id or left<right
  end)
  for i,row in ipairs(candidates) do
   if i>MAX_CHECKED_NEUTRALS then break end
   local root=validNeutral(bit,row.token)
   if root and (root.Position-state.root.Position).Magnitude<=4
    and flat(root.Position-bit.point).Magnitude<=bit.guardRadius and attack(bit,row.token,root) then
    state.lastHit=os.clock()
    break
   end
  end
 end
 return true
end

local function aim(bit,origin:Vector3,distance:number): (Vector3?,{any})
 local heading=flat(bit.casterRoot.CFrame.LookVector)
 if heading.Magnitude<.01 then return nil,{} end
 heading=heading.Unit
 local chosen,candidates=nil,{}
 for _,row in ipairs(bit.swarm.projectileCandidates(origin,distance+CONTACT_RADIUS)) do
  local root=validNeutral(bit,row.token)
  if root then
   local delta=flat(root.Position-origin)
   if delta.Magnitude>1 and delta.Magnitude<=distance and delta.Unit:Dot(heading)>=.58
    and math.abs(root.Position.Y-origin.Y)<=4 then
    table.insert(candidates,{row=row,delta=delta})
   end
  end
 end
 table.sort(candidates,function(a,b)
  local left,right=a.delta.Magnitude,b.delta.Magnitude
  return left==right and a.row.id<b.row.id or left<right
 end)
 for i,item in ipairs(candidates) do
  if i>MAX_CHECKED_NEUTRALS then break end
  local root=validNeutral(bit,item.row.token)
  if root and lineClear(origin+UP*1.85,root.Position+UP,bit.pet.model,item.row.token) then
   chosen=item.delta.Unit;break
  end
 end
 return chosen,candidates
end

local function charge(bit)
 local state=bit.pet
 local root=state.root
 task.wait(TELL)
 if state.moon~=bit then return end
 if not current(bit) or not stillGrounded(bit) or root.Anchored
  or (root.Position-bit.origin).Magnitude>.3 then clear(state);return end
 -- The same bound lane is checked again when the tell ends.
 if not Commands.routeTo(bit,bit.origin+bit.direction*bit.distance,nil) then clear(state);return end
 if bit.marker then bit.marker:Destroy();bit.marker=nil end
 bit.phase="CHARGE"
 bit.ownsAnchor=true
 root.Anchored=true
 root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero
 root.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero
 local at=bit.origin
 local floor=Commands.floorAt(bit,at,bit.ray)
 if not floor then clear(state);return end
 local height=at.Y-floor.Y
 local started=os.clock()
 local traveled=0
 local attempted={}
 local hits=0
 local readyToHit=os.clock()-state.lastHit>=ATTACK_COOLDOWN
 local didCharge=false
 while traveled<bit.distance do
  task.wait(STEP)
  if state.moon~=bit then return end
  if not current(bit) or not root.Anchored or (root.Position-at).Magnitude>.26 then clear(state);return end
  local nextDistance=math.min(bit.distance,math.max(traveled, (os.clock()-started)*MOTION_SPEED))
  if bit.distance-nextDistance<.001 then nextDistance=bit.distance end
  if nextDistance-traveled>2.4 then clear(state);return end
  local wanted=bit.origin+bit.direction*nextDistance
  local ground=Commands.floorAt(bit,wanted,bit.ray)
  if not ground or math.abs(ground.Y-floor.Y)>.8 then clear(state);return end
  local nextPoint=ground+UP*height
  if not sweep(bit,at,nextPoint) then clear(state);return end
  state.model:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(nextPoint,nextPoint+bit.direction))
  if (root.Position-nextPoint).Magnitude>.09 then clear(state);return end
  if not didCharge then
   didCharge=trace(bit,"CHARGE_VALID",(nextPoint-at).Magnitude>.02)
   if not didCharge then clear(state);return end
  end
  at,floor,traveled=nextPoint,ground,nextDistance
  if readyToHit and hits<bit.neutralMax then
   for i,item in ipairs(bit.candidates) do
    if i>MAX_CHECKED_NEUTRALS then break end
    local token=item.row.token
    local aimRoot=not attempted[token] and validNeutral(bit,token)
    if aimRoot and flat(aimRoot.Position-at).Magnitude<=CONTACT_RADIUS
     and math.abs(aimRoot.Position.Y-at.Y)<=3 then
     attempted[token]=true
     if attack(bit,token,aimRoot) then
      hits+=1;state.lastHit=os.clock()
      if hits>=bit.neutralMax then break end
     end
    end
   end
  end
 end
 releaseMotion(bit)
 state.humanoid:MoveTo(at)
 task.wait(STEP)
 if state.moon~=bit then return end
 local stable=current(bit) and not root.Anchored and stillGrounded(bit)
  and (root.Position-at).Magnitude<=.35 and root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude<=2
 if not trace(bit,"STOP_VALID",stable==true) then clear(state);return end
 if not bit.sequence or not formation(bit,at) then clear(state) end
end

function M.cast(session:any,p:Player,avatar:Model,casterRoot:BasePart,h:Humanoid,owner:any,id:string,
 recipes:any,sequenceType:any,serial:number):boolean
 local state=ownedThunderState(session,p,avatar,h,owner)
 local swarm,world=session.swarm,session.world
 local arena=world and world:FindFirstChild("TacticalBattlefield")
 if not state or state.pendingThunder or state.moon or state.command or not swarm
  or not arena or not arena:IsA("BasePart") or state.root.Anchored then return false end
 local ray=RaycastParams.new()
 ray.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude;ray.FilterDescendantsInstances={state.model};ray.RespectCanCollide=true
 local bit={session=session,world=world,arena=arena,swarm=swarm,owner=p,ownerState=owner,avatar=avatar,casterRoot=casterRoot,

-- MAGE-025. Only server-owned neutral records are passed to these selectors.
local Chain = {}

Chain.cooldown = 20
Chain.energy = 40
Chain.tellSeconds = 0.24
Chain.targetsByStage = table.freeze({1, 2, 3, 4, 5})
Chain.hopByStage = table.freeze({4, 5, 6, 7, 8})

export type Neutral = {id: number, model: Model, pos: Vector3, hp: number}

function Chain.seed(origin: Vector3, mobs: {Neutral}, allowed: (Neutral) -> boolean): Neutral?
    local chosen: Neutral? = nil
    local nearest = math.huge
    for _, neutral in ipairs(mobs) do
        if neutral.hp <= 0 then continue end
        local distance = (neutral.pos - origin).Magnitude
        if (distance < nearest or (chosen and distance == nearest and neutral.id < chosen.id))
            and allowed(neutral) then
            chosen, nearest = neutral, distance
        end
    end
    return chosen
end

function Chain.path(first: Neutral, mobs: {Neutral}, stage: number,
        clear: (Vector3, Vector3) -> boolean, targetLimit: number?): {Neutral}
    local index = stage + 1
    local limit, reach = Chain.targetsByStage[index], Chain.hopByStage[index]
    if first.hp <= 0 or not limit or not reach then return {} end
    local selected = {first}
    local visited = {[first.model] = true}
    while #selected < math.min(limit,targetLimit or limit) do
        local origin = selected[#selected].pos
        local nextNeutral = Chain.seed(origin, mobs, function(candidate)
            return not visited[candidate.model] and (candidate.pos - origin).Magnitude <= reach
                and clear(origin, candidate.pos)
        end)
        if not nextNeutral then break end
        visited[nextNeutral.model] = true
        table.insert(selected, nextNeutral)
    end
    return selected
end

return table.freeze(Chain)
end)()

 if current=="MAGE-041" then return nil,"氷弾" end
 if mageProjectilesEnabled() then
  local index=if current then table.find(mageSlots,current) else 0
  local nextId=mageSlots[(index or 0)+1]
  local plan=MageProjectiles.plan(nextId,0)
  if plan then return nextId,plan.name end
 end
 if water then return "MAGE-041","水弾＋連鎖雷" end
 return nil,"氷弾"
end

function HeroCombat.nextMageElemental(current:string?):(string?,string)
 if not mageProjectileEnabled(elementalMageSlots[1]) then return nil,"氷弾" end
 local index=if current then table.find(elementalMageSlots,current) else 0
 local nextId=elementalMageSlots[(index or 0)+1]
 local plan=MageProjectiles.plan(nextId,0)
 return nextId,if plan then plan.name else "氷弾"
end

local function mageSlotId(session:any,p:Player,role:string,slot:string):string?
 if role~="MAGE" or slot~="A" or not mageProjectilesEnabled() then return nil end
 local selected=session.mageProjectiles and session.mageProjectiles[p.UserId]
 return if selected and selected~="MAGE-041" and selected~="MAGE-040" and selected~="MAGE_GROUND_TELLS" and not MageFieldBatch.isKit(selected) and mageProjectileEnabled(selected) then selected else nil
end

local function mageWorldRay(session:any,char:Model):RaycastParams
 local filters={char,session.world:FindFirstChild("NeutralHorde")}
 for _, other in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
  if other~=p and other.Character then table.insert(filters,other.Character) end
 end
 for _, bot in pairs(session.botActors or {}) do table.insert(filters,bot) end
 local params=RaycastParams.new()
 params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
 params.FilterDescendantsInstances=filters
 params.RespectCanCollide=true
 return params
end

local function launchFieldArc(session:any,p:Player,plan:any,stage:number,origin:Vector3,direction:Vector3,params:RaycastParams,
 current:()->boolean,swarm:any,avatar:Model,damage:number,slot:string):()
 local world=session.world
 local path=if plan.shape=="TRACK" then nil else MageFieldBatch.route(origin,direction,plan.reach,plan.shape)
 local aimParts=Instance.new("Folder")
 aimParts.Name="EGGRUMBLE_"..plan.id.."_Preview"
 local color=if plan.element=="FIRE" then Color3.fromRGB(236,120,65) else Color3.fromRGB(230,205,129)
 local function castRay(from:Vector3,delta:Vector3):RaycastResult?
  return workspace:Raycast(from,delta,params)
 end
 local function previewSegment(from:Vector3,to:Vector3):boolean
  local ray=castRay(from,to-from)
  local endAt=if ray then ray.Position else to
  local length=(endAt-from).Magnitude
  if length>.03 then
   local segment=Instance.new("Part")
   segment.Name="PathSegment";segment.Anchored=true
   segment.CanCollide=false;segment.CanTouch=false;segment.CanQuery=false;segment.CastShadow=false
   segment.Color=color;segment.Transparency=.52
   segment.Size=Vector3.new(.10,.10,length)
   segment.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt((endAt+from)*.5,endAt)
   segment.Parent=aimParts
  end
  return ray==nil
 end
 if path then
  for i=2,#path do
   if not previewSegment(path[i-1].point,path[i].point) then break end
  end
 else
  previewSegment(origin,origin+direction*plan.reach)
 end
 aimParts.Parent=world
 local visual=MageProjectileVisual.begin(world,plan.id,stage,origin,direction,0,plan.tell)
 local flight=MageProjectiles.newFlight(plan,origin,direction)
 local track=plan.turn and MageFieldBatch.chooseTrack(origin,direction,plan.turn,
  swarm.projectileCandidates(origin,plan.reach),function(from,to) return castRay(from,to-from)==nil end)
 local pos=origin
 local segment=2
 local started=os.clock()
 local function hit(target,from:Vector3):boolean
  local species=target.token:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_NeutralSpecies")
  local defense=if species=="BABY_GOLEM" then "EARTH" elseif species=="ICE_SLIME" then "ICE" else "NONE"
  return swarm.damageProjectileTarget(p,avatar,target.token,from,
   math.floor(damage*MageAffinity.matchup(plan.element,defense)))
 end
 task.spawn(function()
  while not flight.done do
   RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
   if not current() then break end
   local age=os.clock()-started
   if age<plan.tell then continue end
   if aimParts.Parent then aimParts:Destroy() end
   local targetDistance=MageProjectiles.travel(plan,age)
   local forward=direction
   local hitsBefore=flight.hits
   while targetDistance-flight.travelled>.00001 and not flight.done do
    local length=targetDistance-flight.travelled
    local nextNode=nil
    if path then
     nextNode=path[segment]
     if not nextNode then break end
     local delta=nextNode.point-pos
     if delta.Magnitude<.00001 then segment+=1;continue end
     forward=delta.Unit
     length=math.min(length,delta.Magnitude)
    end
    local candidates=swarm.projectileCandidates(pos,length+1.75)
    if track and not path then
     for _,candidate in ipairs(swarm.projectileCandidates(origin,plan.reach)) do
      if candidate.token==track and castRay(pos,candidate.center-pos)==nil then
       forward=MageFieldBatch.turn(direction,candidate.center-pos,plan.turn)
       break
      end
     end
    end
    local ray=castRay(pos,forward*length)
    local used=MageProjectiles.resolveSegment(flight,pos,forward,0,if ray then ray.Distance else length,ray~=nil,candidates,hit)
    pos+=forward*used
    flight.travelled+=used
    if nextNode and (pos-nextNode.point).Magnitude<.00002 then segment+=1 end
    flight.done=ray~=nil or flight.hits>=plan.limit or flight.travelled>=plan.reach-.00002
    if path and segment>#path then flight.done=true end
   end
   if flight.hits>hitsBefore then ImpactFeedback.attacker(p,"MAGE",slot,flight.hits-hitsBefore) end
   if not flight.done then MageProjectileVisual.move(visual,nil,pos,forward) end
  end
  if aimParts.Parent then aimParts:Destroy() end
  MageProjectileVisual.finish(visual,nil)
 end)
end

local function launchMageProjectile(session:any,p:Player,char:Model,root:BasePart,h:Humanoid,
 owner:any,abilityId:string,damage:number,settledStage:number?,wingCurrent:(()->boolean)?,fieldSlot:string?):boolean
 local swarm=session.swarm
 if not swarm or type(swarm.getRoleGrowthSnapshot)~="function"
  or type(swarm.tryRoleGrowthCast)~="function" or type(swarm.projectileCandidates)~="function"
  or type(swarm.damageProjectileTarget)~="function" or type(swarm.isCurrentRoleCaster)~="function" then return false end
 local fieldArc=MageFieldBatch.flightPlan(abilityId,0)~=nil
 local function current():boolean
  return (if fieldArc then MageFieldBatch.ownsFlight(session,p,abilityId) else mageProjectileEnabled(abilityId))
   and (not fieldArc or (owner.heldEggs or 0)==0 and not h.Sit and not h.PlatformStand)
   and session.rules.phase=="ACTIVE" and session.rules.winner==nil
   and (not HeroCombat.roleFlightActive or not HeroCombat.roleFlightActive(p))
   and (not wingCurrent or wingCurrent())
   and session.world.Parent~=nil and session.rules.castles[tostring(p.UserId)]==owner
   and root.Parent==char and h.Parent==char and h.SeatPart==nil
   and swarm.isCurrentRoleCaster(p,char,"MAGE")
 end
 if not current() then return false end
 local growth=swarm.getRoleGrowthSnapshot(p)
 local plan=MageProjectiles.plan(abilityId,settledStage or (growth and growth.stage))
 if not plan or growth.role~="MAGE" then return false end
 local forward=root.CFrame.LookVector
 local horizontal=Vector3.new(forward.X,0,forward.Z)
 if horizontal.Magnitude<.001 then return false end
 local params=mageWorldRay(session,char)
 local origin=root.Position+Vector3.new(0,1,0)
 if fieldArc then
  if h.FloorMaterial==Enum.Material.Air then return false end
  local floor=workspace:Raycast(origin,Vector3.new(0,-7,0),params)
  if not floor or floor.Instance.Parent~=session.world or not floor.Instance:IsA("BasePart")
   or not floor.Instance.Anchored or floor.Normal.Y<.65
   or (floor.Instance.Name~="TacticalBattlefield" and not floor.Instance.Name:match("^TacticalRoute_")) then return false end
  origin=floor.Position+Vector3.new(0,2,0)
 end
 local stage=settledStage
 if stage==nil then
  local deadlines=if abilityId=="MAGE-012" or fieldArc then {[abilityId]=plan.cooldown} else nil
  stage=swarm.tryRoleGrowthCast(p,"MAGE",plan.cooldown,plan.energy,deadlines)
 end
 if stage==nil then return false end
 local direction=horizontal.Unit
 if fieldArc then
  launchFieldArc(session,p,plan,stage,origin,direction,params,current,swarm,char,damage,fieldSlot or "A")
  return true
 end
 local flight=MageProjectiles.newFlight(plan,origin,direction)
 local started=os.clock()
 local function clip(start:Vector3,facing:Vector3,a:number,b:number):number?
  local wall=workspace:Raycast(start+facing*a,facing*(b-a),params)
  return if wall then a+wall.Distance else nil
 end
 local cueReach=if plan.tell>0 then (clip(origin,direction,0,plan.reach) or plan.reach) else 0
 local visual,cue=MageProjectileVisual.begin(session.world,plan.id,stage,origin,direction,cueReach,plan.tell)
 local function scan()
  return swarm.projectileCandidates(origin,plan.reach)
 end
 local permittedStatus=if settledStage~=nil then (MageProjectiles.plan("MAGE-011",stage) or plan) else plan
 local function hit(target):boolean
  return swarm.damageProjectileTarget(p,char,target.token,origin,damage,
   permittedStatus.status,permittedStatus.statusDuration,permittedStatus.statusPotency)
 end
 task.spawn(function()
  while not flight.done do
   RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
   local age=os.clock()-started
   local hits=MageProjectiles.step(flight,age,current(),clip,scan,hit)
   if hits>0 then ImpactFeedback.attacker(p,"MAGE","A",hits) end
   if not flight.done and age>=plan.tell then
    MageProjectileVisual.move(visual,cue,origin+direction*flight.travelled,direction)
   end
  end
  MageProjectileVisual.finish(visual,cue)
 end)
 return true
end

local mageWaterLightning= MageWaterLightning.new()
local WATER="MAGE-041"
local CHAIN="MAGE-025"
local COMBO="COMBO-004"
local WATER_CHAIN_DAMAGE=16 -- Existing ACTIVE MAGE damage used by MAGE-041/025 and COMBO-004.
local WATER_CHAIN_FLAG="P0D_ENABLE_PRIVATE_MAGE_WATER_CHAIN"

local function mageWaterChainSelected(session:any,p:Player):boolean
 return workspace:GetAttribute(WATER_CHAIN_FLAG)~=false and session.mageProjectiles~=nil
  and session.mageProjectiles[p.UserId]==WATER and p:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_Role")=="MAGE"
end

local function waterChainAbility(session:any,p:Player,slot:string):string?
 if not mageWaterChainSelected(session,p) then return nil end
 if slot=="A" then return WATER end
 if slot=="C" then return CHAIN end
 if slot=="D" then return COMBO end
 return nil
end

local function useMageWaterChain(session:any,p:Player,char:Model,root:BasePart,h:Humanoid,
 owner:any,ability:string,serial:number):boolean
 local swarm=session.swarm
 if not swarm or type(swarm.isCurrentRoleCaster)~="function" then return false end
 local parameters=mageWorldRay(session,char)
 local function current():boolean
  return mageWaterChainSelected(session,p) and session.rules.phase=="ACTIVE" and session.rules.winner==nil
   and session.rules.castles[tostring(p.UserId)]==owner and root.Parent==char
   and h.Parent==char and h.SeatPart==nil and swarm.isCurrentRoleCaster(p,char,"MAGE")
 end
 if not current() then return false end
 local function visible(a:Vector3,b:Vector3):boolean
  local ray=b-a
  return ray.Magnitude<.001 or workspace:Raycast(a,ray,parameters)==nil
 end
 local function capture()
  local stage=swarm.getRoleGrowthSnapshot(p)
  if not stage then return nil end
  return {
   actor=p, avatar=char, round=session, role="MAGE", stage=stage.stage, now=os.clock(),
   origin=root.Position+Vector3.new(0,1,0), direction=root.CFrame.LookVector,
   damage=WATER_CHAIN_DAMAGE,current=current,visible=visible,
   scan=swarm.projectileCandidates,
   hit=function(target,from,damage)
    return swarm.damageProjectileTarget(p,char,target,from,damage)
   end,
   tryCast=function(cooldown,energy,deadlines)
    return swarm.tryRoleGrowthCast(p,"MAGE",cooldown,energy,deadlines)
   end,
  }
 end
 local cast=capture()
 if not cast then return false end
 local work=mageWaterLightning.begin(cast,ability,serial)
 if not work then return false end
 if work.hits>0 then ImpactFeedback.attacker(p,"MAGE","A",work.hits) end
 if ability~=CHAIN then
  MageWaterChainVisual.updateMark(session.world,swarm,mageWaterLightning,cast)
 end
 if work.ticket then
  MageWaterChainVisual.arc(session.world,cast.origin,{work.first},true)
  task.delay(work.tell,function()
   if not current() then return end
   local impact=capture()
   if not impact then return end
   local hits,positions=mageWaterLightning.impact(impact,work.ticket)
   if hits>0 then
    MageWaterChainVisual.arc(session.world,impact.origin,positions,false)
    ImpactFeedback.attacker(p,"MAGE",if ability==CHAIN then "C" else "D",hits)
   end
   if ability==COMBO then
    MageWaterChainVisual.updateMark(session.world,swarm,mageWaterLightning,impact)
   end
  end)
 end
 return true
end

function Blink.isGrounded(hum: Humanoid): boolean
    return hum.SeatPart==nil and not hum.Sit and not hum.PlatformStand
        and hum.FloorMaterial~=Enum.Material.Air and hum.FloorMaterial~=Enum.Material.Water
end

function Blink.direction(forward: Vector3,velocity: Vector3,walkSpeed: number,stage: number): Vector3?
    local flat=Vector3.new(forward.X,0,forward.Z)
    flat=if flat.Magnitude>.01 then flat.Unit else Vector3.new(1,0,0)
    local movement=Vector3.new(velocity.X,0,velocity.Z)
    local speed=movement.Magnitude
    if speed<2 then return flat end
    if speed>math.clamp(walkSpeed,0,64)*1.5 then return nil end
    if stage<2 then
        local cross=movement-flat*movement:Dot(flat)
        local tell=Blink.config.metrics[2].values[stage+1]
        return if cross.Magnitude*tell<=.6 then flat else nil
    end
    -- Keep a promised forward diagonal aligned with the movement already held.
    local track=movement.Unit
    return if track:Dot(flat)>=.5 then track else nil
end

function Blink.inside(arena: BasePart,position: Vector3): boolean
    return math.abs(position.X-arena.Position.X)<=arena.Size.X*.5-4.5
        and math.abs(position.Z-arena.Position.Z)<=arena.Size.Z*.5-4.5
end

function Blink.landing(arena: BasePart,character: Model,origin: Vector3,facing: Vector3,amount: number): Vector3?
    if not arena.Parent or not arena.Anchored or not arena.CanCollide or not Blink.inside(arena,origin) then
        return nil
    end
    local ray=RaycastParams.new()
    ray.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    ray.FilterDescendantsInstances={character}
    ray.RespectCanCollide=true
    -- Retain the existing SevenRoleCombat safeMove nine-ray cross-section.
    -- It catches torso, low and overhead obstructions and narrow gate jambs.
    local right=Vector3.new(-facing.Z,0,facing.X)
    local distance=amount
    for _,height in ipairs({-1.1,2,4.6}) do
        for _,side in ipairs({-1.3,0,1.3}) do
            local eye=origin+Vector3.new(0,height,0)+right*side
            local hit=workspace:Raycast(eye,facing*amount,ray)
            if hit then distance=math.min(distance,math.max(0,hit.Distance-3)) end
        end
    end
    if distance<3 then return nil end
    -- Reuse the guardian's continuous body sweep between the sampled rays.
    local body=Vector3.new(3.2,4.5,3.2)
    local sweep=workspace:Blockcast(CFrame.new(origin),body,facing*distance,ray)
    if sweep then distance=math.min(distance,math.max(0,sweep.Distance-.35)) end
    if distance<3 then return nil end
    local projected=origin+facing*distance
    if not Blink.inside(arena,projected) then return nil end
    local ground=workspace:Raycast(projected+Vector3.new(0,6,0),Vector3.new(0,-17,0),ray)
    if not ground or not ground.Instance:IsA("BasePart") or not ground.Instance.Anchored
        or not ground.Instance.CanCollide or ground.Normal.Y<.65 then return nil end
    local target=ground.Position+Vector3.new(0,3,0)
    if math.abs(target.Y-origin.Y)>3.5 then return nil end
    local overlap=OverlapParams.new()
    overlap.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances={character}
    overlap.RespectCanCollide=true
    if #workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(target),body,overlap)>0 then return nil end
    return target
end

return table.freeze(Blink)
end)()

local Recipes,Sequence=ComboRecipes,ComboSequence
-- Isolated PRIVATE NINJA-031, NINJA-061 and COMBO-008 donor for HeroCombat.
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")

local Combo={}
local FLAG="P0D_ENABLE_PRIVATE_NINJA_COMBO_008"
local ROLE="NINJA"
local BLINK="NINJA-031"
local SMOKE="NINJA-061"
local ID="COMBO-008"
local FLOOR_TELL=.10 -- local presentation tuning, outside the fixed blink tell
local active=setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
local castSerial=0

function Combo.enabled():boolean
 return RunService:IsStudio() and workspace:GetAttribute(FLAG)~=false
end

function Combo.presentation(ability:string)
 if ability==BLINK then return Blink.config.name,Blink.config.energy,Blink.config.cd end
 if ability==SMOKE then return Smoke.name,Smoke.energy,Smoke.cd end
 if ability==ID then
  local plan=Recipes.resolve(ROLE,BLINK,SMOKE,0)
  return plan.name,plan.proposedEnergy,plan.proposedCooldownSec
 end
 return nil
end

local function clear(record)
 local occupied=active[record.player]
 if occupied and occupied[record.ability]==record then
  occupied[record.ability]=nil
  if next(occupied)==nil then active[record.player]=nil end
 end
 for _,connection in ipairs(record.connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
 table.clear(record.connections)
 if record.effect then record.effect:Destroy();record.effect=nil end
end

local function localPart(world:Instance,name:string,position:CFrame,size:Vector3,
        color:Color3,transparency:number):Part
 local part=Instance.new("Part")
 part.Name=name
 part.Anchored=true;part.CanCollide=false;part.CanTouch=false;part.CanQuery=false
 part.CastShadow=false
 part.Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
 part.CFrame=position
 part.Size=size
 part.Color=color
 part.Transparency=transparency
 part.Parent=world
 return part
end

local function supportAt(world:Instance,character:Model,target:Vector3,exactLanding:boolean):(Vector3?,BasePart?)
 local ray=RaycastParams.new()
 ray.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
 ray.FilterDescendantsInstances={character}
 ray.RespectCanCollide=true
 local hit=workspace:Raycast(target,Vector3.new(0,if exactLanding then -4 else -6,0),ray)
 if not hit or not hit.Instance:IsA("BasePart") or not hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(world)
  or not hit.Instance.Anchored or not hit.Instance.CanCollide or hit.Normal.Y<.65
  or (exactLanding and math.abs(target.Y-hit.Position.Y-3)>.02) then return nil,nil end
 return hit.Position,hit.Instance
end

local function smokeFits(arena:BasePart,character:Model,point:Vector3,support:BasePart,radius:number):boolean
 local relative=arena.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(point)
 if math.abs(relative.X)+radius>arena.Size.X*.5 or math.abs(relative.Z)+radius>arena.Size.Z*.5 then
  return false
 end
 local overlap=OverlapParams.new()
 overlap.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
 overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances={character,support}
 overlap.RespectCanCollide=true
 overlap.MaxParts=1
 return #workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(point+Vector3.new(0,.34,0)),
  Vector3.new(radius*2,.64,radius*2),overlap)==0
end

function Combo.start(session,player:Player,character:Model,root:BasePart,hum:Humanoid,ability:string):boolean
 local moves=ability==BLINK or ability==ID
 local smokes=ability==SMOKE or ability==ID
 if not moves and not smokes then return false end
 if not Combo.enabled() then return false end
 local world=session.world
 local arena=world and world:FindFirstChild("TacticalBattlefield")
 local swarm=session.swarm
 local owner=session.rules.castles[tostring(player.UserId)]
 if not arena or not arena:IsA("BasePart") or not swarm or not owner
  or type(swarm.isCurrentRoleCaster)~="function" or type(swarm.getRoleGrowthSnapshot)~="function"
  or type(swarm.tryRoleGrowthCast)~="function" then return false end
 local function current():boolean

local LandThenAttack=(function()
-- Private combat flight owns its avatar only during a checked, finite sweep.
local LandThenAttack={}
local flying=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
local BODY=Vector3.new(2.6,4.6,2.6) -- Existing checked Ninja body volume.
local BODY_CENTER=Vector3.new(0,.3,0)
local STEP=1/24

function LandThenAttack.active(actor:Player):boolean
 return flying[actor]~=nil
end

local function footprint(world:Instance,avatar:Model)
 local rays=RaycastParams.new()
 rays.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
 rays.FilterDescendantsInstances={avatar}
 rays.RespectCanCollide=true
 local overlap=OverlapParams.new()
 overlap.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
 overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances={avatar}
 overlap.RespectCanCollide=true
 overlap.MaxParts=1
 local function floor(at:Vector3,referenceY:number):Vector3?
  local beam=Vector3.new(at.X,referenceY+2.5,at.Z)
  local hit=workspace:Raycast(beam,Vector3.new(0,-5,0),rays)
  if not hit or not hit.Instance:IsA("BasePart") or not hit.Instance.Anchored or not hit.Instance.CanCollide
   or not hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(world) or hit.Normal.Y<.65 or math.abs(hit.Position.Y-referenceY)>1.2 then return nil end
  return hit.Position
 end
 local function sweep(a:Vector3,b:Vector3):boolean
  local change=b-a
  if change.Magnitude>.001 and workspace:Blockcast(CFrame.new(a+BODY_CENTER),BODY,change,rays) then return false end
  return #workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(b+BODY_CENTER),BODY,overlap)==0
 end
 return floor,sweep,rays
end

local function cuePart(world:Instance,name:string,size:Vector3,color:Color3):Part
 local part=Instance.new("Part")
 part.Name=name
 part.Size=size
 part.Anchored=true
 part.CanCollide=false
 part.CanTouch=false
 part.CanQuery=false
 part.CastShadow=false
 part.Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
 part.Transparency=.28
 part.Color=color
 part.Parent=world
 return part
end

local function placementCue(world:Instance,position:Vector3):Part

 cue.Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder
 cue.Transparency=.64

function LandThenAttack.landingRing(world:Instance,position:Vector3)

end

-- A pinned arc with bounded server-observed steering; each proposed segment is
-- checked just like the existing traversal vehicle, before the avatar can move.
function LandThenAttack.start(ctx):boolean

  or not ctx.inside(arena,root.Position) then return false end
 local base=root.Position
 local look=root.CFrame.LookVector
 local forward=Vector3.new(look.X,0,look.Z)
 if forward.Magnitude<.01 then return false end
 forward=forward.Unit
 local floor,sweep,rays=footprint(world,avatar)
 local start=workspace:Raycast(base,Vector3.new(0,-6,0),rays)
 if not start or not start.Instance:IsDescendantOf(world) then return false end
 local startGround=floor(base,start.Position.Y)
 if not startGround then return false end
 local rootHeight=base.Y-startGround.Y
 if rootHeight<2.3 or rootHeight>5.5 then return false end
 local function waypoint(xz:Vector3,u:number):(Vector3?,Vector3?)
  if not ctx.inside(arena,xz) then return nil,nil end
  local ground=floor(xz,startGround.Y)
  if not ground then return nil,nil end
  local y=math.min(base.Y+ctx.height,ground.Y+rootHeight+ctx.height*math.sin(math.pi*u))

 end
 -- Avoid charging into a known wall/ceiling/illegal destination. The same
 -- checks run on every actual segment, including inputs after the warning.
 local previous=base
 local nominalLanding
 for index=1,8 do
  local u=index/8
  local at,under=waypoint(base+forward*(ctx.distance*u),u)
  if not at or not sweep(previous,at) then return false end
  previous,nominalLanding=at,under
 end
 local stage=ctx.authorize()
 if stage==nil then return false end
 local record={root=root}
 flying[actor]=record
 root.Anchored=true
 root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero
 root.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero
 local builder=ctx.flightSkin=="BUILDER"
 local warrior=ctx.flightSkin=="WARRIOR"
 local ninja=ctx.flightSkin=="NINJA"
 local wingColor=if builder then Color3.fromRGB(228,194,112)
  elseif warrior then Color3.fromRGB(240,204,118) elseif ninja then Color3.fromRGB(87,77,115) else Color3.fromRGB(159,186,218)
 local wingSize=if builder then Vector3.new(1.6,.24,1.65) else Vector3.new(1.48,.14,.67)
 local wings={cuePart(world,if builder then "EGGRUMBLE_BuilderThrusterLeft" elseif warrior then "EGGRUMBLE_WarriorWingLeft" elseif ninja then "EGGRUMBLE_NinjaWingLeft" else "EGGRUMBLE_WingLeft",wingSize,wingColor),
              cuePart(world,if builder then "EGGRUMBLE_BuilderThrusterRight" elseif warrior then "EGGRUMBLE_WarriorWingRight" elseif ninja then "EGGRUMBLE_NinjaWingRight" else "EGGRUMBLE_WingRight",wingSize,wingColor)}

 local function moveWings()
  for i,wing in ipairs(wings) do
   local side=2*i-3
   local frame=if builder then CFrame.new(side*.85,-2.20,0) else CFrame.new(side*1.11,.75,.62)
   wing.CFrame=root.CFrame*frame*CFrame.Angles(0,side*.22,side*.27)

  if flying[actor]~=record then return end
  flying[actor]=nil

 local usedFlight=false
 task.spawn(function()
  local last,track,xz=base,forward,base
  local lastU=0
  while lastU<1 do
   task.wait(STEP)
   if not ctx.current() or not root.Anchored or (root.Position-last).Magnitude>.6 then
    release();ctx.abort();return
   end
   local input=hum.MoveDirection
   if input then
    local lateral=Vector3.new(input.X,0,input.Z)
    if lateral.Magnitude>.1 then
     local candidate=lateral.Unit
     if candidate:Dot(forward)>=.5 then track=candidate end
    end
   end
   local u=math.clamp((os.clock()-started)/ctx.duration,0,1)
   if 1-u<.00001 then u=1 end
   local traveled=ctx.distance*(u-lastU)
   -- A stalled frame must not skip the apex and cross an unchecked ceiling.
   if u-lastU>.35 then release();ctx.abort();return end
   xz+=track*traveled
   local aim,under=waypoint(xz,u)
   if not aim or not under or not sweep(last,aim) then release();ctx.abort();return end
   avatar:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(aim,aim+track))
   if (root.Position-aim).Magnitude>.08 then release();ctx.abort();return end
   if not usedFlight then
    usedFlight=ctx.trace("FLIGHT_VALID",true)
    if not usedFlight then release();ctx.abort();return end
   end
   moveWings()
   local projected=xz+track*(ctx.distance*(1-u))
   local _,atFoot=waypoint(projected,1)
   if atFoot then mark.CFrame=CFrame.new(atFoot+Vector3.new(0,.06,0))*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.pi/2) end
   last,lastU=aim,u
  end
  -- Geometry has already moved the actual avatar to the checked floor.
  -- Permit physics to ground it before attack and reject movement to another tile.
  root.Anchored=false
  root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero
  root.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero
  task.wait(STEP)
  local settled=floor(root.Position,startGround.Y)
  local stable=ctx.current() and not root.Anchored and settled and ctx.grounded(hum)
   and (root.Position-last).Magnitude<=.35 and math.abs(root.Position.Y-settled.Y-rootHeight)<=.35
  release()
  if not stable or not ctx.trace("LAND_VALID",true) then ctx.abort();return end
  ctx.onLand(settled,stage)
 end)
 return true
end

return table.freeze(LandThenAttack)
end)()
